$comment: 由 src/ 分块拼成，不要手改本文件。改分块后运行 python docs/json-schema/build.py。给出 format 时，ops 只接受该格式的动作；xlsm 与 xlsx 同一份。省略 format 时，ops 接受任一已登记动作的形状。与 docs/json-contract.md 及分册冲突时以 Markdown 为准。
title: ooxp 领域请求

docxDocument.description: 新建文档时的正文，只在 create 里使用。
docxDocument.descriptionEn: Body of a new document. Use it only with create.
docxDocument.limits: 不要把它当成 apply 的补丁。
docxDocument.limitsEn: Do not send it as an apply patch.

after.description: 从 1 起，表插在该段之后。0 表示插在第一段之前。省略则插在全部段落之后。
after.descriptionEn: Starts at 1. The table is inserted after that paragraph. 0 means before the first paragraph. When omitted, the table goes after every paragraph.

style.description: 值是 style: 加上 styleId，不是样式的显示名。
style.descriptionEn: The value is style: plus the styleId, not the style's display name.

num.description: 从 1 起，指向 document.numberings 的下标，不是 num:{n}。
num.descriptionEn: Starts at 1. It is an index into document.numberings, not num:{n}.

num.description: 从 1 起，指向 document.numberings 的下标，不是 num:{n}。
num.descriptionEn: Starts at 1. It is an index into document.numberings, not num:{n}.

kind.description: 省略时为 anchor，绕排为 square。
kind.descriptionEn: When omitted, kind is anchor and wrap is square.

docxDrawingHyperlink.description: inspect 图 / 文本框上的 DrawingML 链。
docxDrawingHyperlink.descriptionEn: Inspect DrawingML links on pictures and text boxes.
docxDrawingHyperlink.limits: 没有链则为 null。这是 inspect 读回的形状。create 用自己的 hyperlink 对象写入。
docxDrawingHyperlink.limitsEn: Null when there is no link. This is the shape inspect returns. create writes links with its own hyperlink object.

setPictureWrapOp.descriptionEn: Switch between inline and floating, or the reverse.
setPictureWrapOp.limits: 位置只支持相对页边（wp:positionH/@relativeFrom 与 wp:positionV/@relativeFrom 都写 margin），不做任意 Dist，也不写其它 relativeFrom。改成浮动且没给对齐或偏移时，水平默认 alignH: "left"，垂直默认 alignV: "top"。已经是浮动、只改 wrap 时，未点名的位置属性原样留下。behindDoc：wrap 为 none 时写成 1（衬于文字下方），其余为 0。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setPictureWrapOp.limitsEn: Position is only relative to the page margin (both wp:positionH/@relativeFrom and wp:positionV/@relativeFrom are margin). Arbitrary Dist and other relativeFrom values are not written. When switching to floating without align or offset, the default is alignH "left" and alignV "top". If it is already floating and only wrap changes, unnamed position attributes stay. behindDoc is 1 when wrap is none (behind text), otherwise 0. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTextBoxWrapOp.description: 字段与 setPictureWrap 相同，id 必须是框 id。
setTextBoxWrapOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureWrap. id must be a text box id.
setTextBoxWrapOp.limits: 行内 / 浮动与绕排规则同图片。
setTextBoxWrapOp.limitsEn: Inline, floating, and wrap follow the same rules as pictures.

setTextBoxFillOp.description: 写入 wps:spPr 的 a:solidFill/a:srgbClr；color 为 null 时写成 a:noFill。
setTextBoxFillOp.descriptionEn: Writes a:solidFill/a:srgbClr on wps:spPr. A null color becomes a:noFill.
setTextBoxFillOp.limits: 不要 theme 色。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxFillOp.limitsEn: Do not use a theme color. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTextBoxLineOp.description: color 为 null 时写成 a:ln/a:noFill。
setTextBoxLineOp.descriptionEn: A null color is written as a:ln/a:noFill.
setTextBoxLineOp.limits: 有颜色时写成 a:ln 加 a:solidFill。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxLineOp.limitsEn: A color is written as a:ln plus a:solidFill. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTextBoxDirectionOp.description: horizontal 对应横排（去掉或写成从左到右）；vertical 对应竖排，写入 wps:bodyPr/@vert 为 eaVert。
setTextBoxDirectionOp.descriptionEn: horizontal is horizontal text (omit vert, or left-to-right). vertical is vertical text, wps:bodyPr/@vert = eaVert.
setTextBoxDirectionOp.limits: xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxDirectionOp.limitsEn: This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTextBoxTextAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Writes wps:bodyPr/@anchor on that text box.
setTextBoxTextAnchorOp.limits: 这是框内文字相对框的上下锚点，不是框相对页边的 setPictureWrap.alignV，也不是格级 w:vAlign。不要和 xlsx 的 setTextBoxAnchor（改绘图锚点）混。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。xlsx / pptx 框内垂直仍用已有 setShapeFormat.textAnchor。
setTextBoxTextAnchorOp.limitsEn: This anchors text inside the box, not the box against the page (setPictureWrap.alignV) and not cell w:vAlign. Do not confuse it with xlsx setTextBoxAnchor, which moves the drawing anchor. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. For vertical text inside an xlsx / pptx box, use setShapeFormat.textAnchor.

setTextBoxLinkOp.description: 把 id 接到 next 前面，或断开。
setTextBoxLinkOp.descriptionEn: Link id in front of next, or break the link.
setTextBoxLinkOp.limits: 两框必须在同一部件（同一主文档，或同一页眉页脚部件）。跨部件链接报 InvalidField。断开时后一框变成独立故事（自己的 wps:txbx）。next 可以是没有 w:txbxContent 的溢出后继框（Word 常只留 wps:linkedTxbx）。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxLinkOp.limitsEn: Both boxes must be in the same part (the main document, or the same header/footer part). A cross-part link returns InvalidField. After a break, the following box is its own story (its own wps:txbx). next may be an overflow box with no w:txbxContent (Word often leaves only wps:linkedTxbx). This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setChartWrapOp.description: 字段与 setPictureWrap 相同，id 为图表 id。
setChartWrapOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureWrap. id is a chart id.
setChartWrapOp.limits: 改宿主 wp:inline / wp:anchor 与绕排，规则与图相同。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。xlsx 改锚点请用 setChartAnchor。
setChartWrapOp.limitsEn: Changes the host wp:inline / wp:anchor and wrap, same rules as pictures. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. To move an xlsx anchor, use setChartAnchor.

docxInsertOleOp.description: 把本地文件作为嵌入对象写入目标段落。
docxInsertOleOp.descriptionEn: Embed a local file as an OLE object in the target paragraph.
docxInsertOleOp.limits: 不在库里启动 OLE 服务器，不生成真实预览图（写入一张最小 PNG 占位）。
docxInsertOleOp.limitsEn: This library does not start an OLE server and does not draw a real preview (it writes a minimal PNG placeholder).

docxDeleteOleOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。删掉整棵 w:object（含预览 markup），去掉 oleObject / package 关系与 embeddings 部件；预览图若无其它关系再指向则一并去掉。 xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx 上的语义见 [json-contract-pptx.md](json-contract-pptx.md#deleteole)。
docxDeleteOleOp.limitsEn: Missing id returns IdNotFound. Removes the whole w:object (including preview markup), the oleObject / package relationship, and the embeddings part. The preview image is removed if nothing else points at it. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. For pptx, see json-contract-pptx.md deleteOle.

docxSetOleSizeOp.description: 写入 v:shape/@style 的 width / height（12700 EMU 为 1 pt）。
docxSetOleSizeOp.descriptionEn: Writes width / height on v:shape/@style (12700 EMU = 1 pt).
docxSetOleSizeOp.limits: 若对象上已有 wp:extent 或带 cx 的 a:ext，一并改。已有的 w:dxaOrig / w:dyaOrig 按 635 EMU 一缇同步。不改 embeddings，不启动 OLE 服务器。出现 to 报 InvalidField。对段落 id 发此 op 报 InvalidId。找不到报 IdNotFound。xlsx 见 [xlsx 分册](json-contract-xlsx.md#setolesize)。
docxSetOleSizeOp.limitsEn: Also updates an existing wp:extent or a:ext with cx. Existing w:dxaOrig / w:dyaOrig stay in sync at 635 EMU per twip. Embeddings are not changed and no OLE server is started. to returns InvalidField. A paragraph id returns InvalidId. A missing id returns IdNotFound. For xlsx, see json-contract-xlsx.md setOleSize.

insertInkCanvasOp.description: 把本地 InkML 作为墨迹画布写入目标段落。
insertInkCanvasOp.descriptionEn: Write a local InkML file as an ink canvas in the target paragraph.
insertInkCanvasOp.limits: 不把手写识别成字。不写独立 wpi 画布。
insertInkCanvasOp.limitsEn: Handwriting is not recognized as text. A standalone wpi canvas is not written.

replaceInkCanvasOp.description: 换 InkML 字节，保留 drawing 与关系 id。
replaceInkCanvasOp.descriptionEn: Replace the InkML bytes. Keep the drawing and the relationship id.
replaceInkCanvasOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。坏 InkML 报 InvalidField。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
replaceInkCanvasOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not ink returns InvalidId. Bad InkML returns InvalidField. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteInkCanvasOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。删掉该 contentPart；若宿主 wpc 只剩 bg / whole 则删整段 drawing / AlternateContent。 关系无人引用则删部件与 Override。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteInkCanvasOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. Removes that contentPart. If the host wpc has only bg / whole left, the whole drawing / AlternateContent is removed. An unreferenced relationship drops the part and its Override. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setInkCanvasSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 docx 一侧相同。
setInkCanvasSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the docx side of setPictureSize.
setInkCanvasSizeOp.limits: id 必须是墨迹画布 id。
setInkCanvasSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an ink-canvas id.

setInkCanvasWrapOp.description: 字段与 setPictureWrap 相同，id 必须是墨迹画布 id。
setInkCanvasWrapOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureWrap. id must be an ink-canvas id.
setInkCanvasWrapOp.limits: 行内 / 浮动与绕排规则同图片。位置只支持相对页边。replaceInkCanvas 仍不改几何。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setInkCanvasWrapOp.limitsEn: Inline, floating, and wrap follow pictures. Position is only relative to the page margin. replaceInkCanvas still does not change geometry. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

docxInsertModel3dOp.description: 把本地 GLB 作为 3D 模型写入目标段落。
docxInsertModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Write a local GLB as a 3D model in the target paragraph.
docxInsertModel3dOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不栅格化模型。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。id 可以是正文、页眉页脚、脚注、尾注或批注段落。省略 kind 时写 wp:inline。kind 为 anchor 时按 setModel3dWrap 写浮动。脚注、尾注和批注上 kind 为 anchor 报 InvalidField。
docxInsertModel3dOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. The model is not rasterized. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder. id may be a body, header, footer, footnote, endnote, or comment paragraph. Omitting kind writes wp:inline. kind anchor follows setModel3dWrap. kind anchor on a footnote, endnote, or comment is InvalidField.

docxReplaceModel3dOp.description: 换 GLB 字节，保留 wp:inline 与关系 id。
docxReplaceModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Replace the GLB bytes. Keep wp:inline and the relationship id.
docxReplaceModel3dOp.limits: 海报仍写成 1×1 PNG。不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。不是 3D id 报 InvalidId。不是 GLB 报 InvalidField。xlsx / pptx 见各自分册。
docxReplaceModel3dOp.limitsEn: The poster stays a 1×1 PNG. Position and size are unchanged. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not 3D returns InvalidId. A non-GLB file returns InvalidField. See the xlsx and pptx books.

docxDeleteModel3dOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。删掉该 AlternateContent。GLB 与海报无人引用则删。xlsx / pptx 见各自分册。
docxDeleteModel3dOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. Removes that AlternateContent. The GLB and the poster are deleted if nothing else references them. See the xlsx and pptx books.

setModel3dWrapOp.description: 字段与 setPictureWrap 相同，id 必须是 3D 模型 id。
setModel3dWrapOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureWrap. id must be a 3D model id.
setModel3dWrapOp.limits: 行内 / 浮动与绕排规则同图片。位置只支持相对页边。Fallback 海报 drawing 同步改绕排。replaceModel3d 仍不改几何。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。xlsx 改锚点请用 setModel3dAnchor。pptx 改画布坐标请用 setModel3dPos。
setModel3dWrapOp.limitsEn: Inline, floating, and wrap follow the same rules as pictures. Position is only relative to the page margin. The Fallback poster drawing's wrap is updated together. replaceModel3d still does not change geometry. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. To move an xlsx anchor, use setModel3dAnchor. To change pptx canvas coordinates, use setModel3dPos.

setSmartArtWrapOp.description: 字段与 setPictureWrap 相同，id 为图示 id。
setSmartArtWrapOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureWrap. id is a SmartArt id.
setSmartArtWrapOp.limits: 改宿主 wp:inline / wp:anchor 与绕排，规则与图相同。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx 改画布坐标请用 setSmartArtPos。
setSmartArtWrapOp.limitsEn: Changes the host wp:inline / wp:anchor and wrap, same rules as pictures. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. To change pptx canvas coordinates, use setSmartArtPos.

insertWatermarkOp.description: 把文字或图片水印写入页眉 DrawingML。
insertWatermarkOp.descriptionEn: Write a text or picture watermark into the header DrawingML.

deleteWatermarkOp.description: docx:document 删掉所有页眉里的 DrawingML 水印；没有水印则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied。
deleteWatermarkOp.descriptionEn: docx:document removes DrawingML watermarks from every header. If there is no watermark, this is a no-op and is still counted in opsApplied.
deleteWatermarkOp.limits: 水印 id 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是水印 id 也不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。不删 VML。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。图片水印删掉后，若媒体没有其它关系再指向则去掉该部件。
deleteWatermarkOp.limitsEn: A missing watermark id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a watermark id nor docx:document returns InvalidId. VML is not removed. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. After a picture watermark is removed, the media part is dropped if no other relationship still points at it.

docxInsertMathOp.description: 在 Word 段落里插入公式。
docxInsertMathOp.descriptionEn: Insert an equation into a Word paragraph.
docxInsertMathOp.limits: text 和 expr 恰好给一个，不能同时给。kind 缺省是 inline，display 才单独成段。不要套用 xlsx 或 pptx 的坐标字段。
docxInsertMathOp.limitsEn: Provide exactly one of text and expr; do not provide both. kind defaults to inline; only display stands as its own paragraph. Do not reuse coordinate fields from xlsx or pptx.

docxSetMathOp.description: 改 Word 段落里已有的公式。
docxSetMathOp.descriptionEn: Change an existing equation in a Word paragraph.
docxSetMathOp.limits: text 和 expr 恰好给一个；只改对齐时可以只给 jc。不改 kind。不要套用 xlsx 或 pptx 的公式框字段。
docxSetMathOp.limitsEn: Provide exactly one of text and expr. To change only alignment, jc alone is enough. kind is not changed. Do not reuse formula-box fields from xlsx or pptx.

insertRubyOp.description: 在点名段末尾追加一个 w:r，里面是 w:ruby（rubyPr + rt + rubyBase）。
insertRubyOp.descriptionEn: Append a w:r at the end of the named paragraph, containing w:ruby (rubyPr + rt + rubyBase).
insertRubyOp.limits: id 为 docx:document 时在正文末尾、sectPr 之前新插一个只含该拼音的 w:p。框内、注内、批注内的段落，以及拼音 id、容器 id、表 id、run id、section:{n}，一律报 InvalidId。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。空 base / rt、空 lid、不认识的 align、或 hps / hpsRaise / hpsBaseText 越界，报 InvalidField。
insertRubyOp.limitsEn: When id is docx:document, insert a new w:p that contains only this ruby at the end of the body, before sectPr. Paragraphs inside a text box, note, or comment, and a ruby id, container id, table id, run id, or section:{n}, all return InvalidId. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An empty base / rt, an empty lid, an unrecognized align, or hps / hpsRaise / hpsBaseText out of range returns InvalidField.

setRubyOp.limits: base、rt、align、hps、hpsRaise、hpsBaseText、lid 至少给一个。只改被点名的那一个 w:ruby。 空 base / rt / lid、不认识的 align、或字号越界报 InvalidField。找不到报 IdNotFound。 id 不是拼音 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setRubyOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of base, rt, align, hps, hpsRaise, hpsBaseText, and lid. Only the named w:ruby is changed. An empty base / rt / lid, an unrecognized align, or a font size out of range returns InvalidField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a ruby id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteRubyOp.limits: 若宿主 w:r 里除 w:rPr 外只剩这一份拼音，连该 run 一起删。不因此删掉空段。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是拼音 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteRubyOp.limitsEn: If the host w:r contains only this ruby besides w:rPr, delete that run as well. An empty paragraph is not deleted because of this. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a ruby id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setEastAsianSettingsOp.description: 改文档的东亚排版设置。
setEastAsianSettingsOp.descriptionEn: Change the document's East Asian typography settings.
setEastAsianSettingsOp.limits: 五个字段至少给一个。禁则对象必须同时有非空 lang 与非空 chars。 themeFontLang 对象只认 val / eastAsia / bidi，值为字符串或 null。空串报 InvalidField。写入时整份替换该元素，只写出非 null 的属性。 不认识的 characterSpacingControl 报 InvalidField。 id 不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。没有 settings 且要写入时新建 /word/settings.xml 与主文档 settings 关系。
setEastAsianSettingsOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of the five fields. A kinsoku object must have both a non-empty lang and non-empty chars. A themeFontLang object accepts only val / eastAsia / bidi, each a string or null. An empty string returns InvalidField. On write, the element is replaced as a whole, and only non-null attributes are written. An unrecognized characterSpacingControl returns InvalidField. An id that is not docx:document returns InvalidId. If settings is missing and a write is required, create /word/settings.xml and the main document's settings relationship.

docxDeleteMathOp.description: 删掉该 oMath；若父 oMathPara 里已经没有 oMath，连 oMathPara 一起删。
docxDeleteMathOp.descriptionEn: Delete that oMath. If the parent oMathPara then has no oMath left, delete the oMathPara as well.
docxDeleteMathOp.limits: 因此变空且无 sectPr 的正文段可删掉。表格单元格内的空段留下。删完后若 w:body 里没有 w:p，在 sectPr 之前补一个空段。某段带分节符且不能整段删掉时，报 NotImplemented。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 的 drawing 公式框见各自分册。
docxDeleteMathOp.limitsEn: A body paragraph that becomes empty and has no sectPr may be deleted. An empty paragraph inside a table cell stays. After the delete, if w:body has no w:p, insert an empty paragraph before sectPr. If a paragraph has a section break and the whole paragraph cannot be deleted, NotImplemented is returned. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an equation id returns InvalidId. For drawing formula boxes in xlsx / pptx, see the xlsx and pptx books.

insertEmbeddedFontOp.descriptionEn: Embed a font in the document.
insertEmbeddedFontOp.limits: 出现 subsetted 报 UnknownField。本期不写 w:subsetted，不在库里做 TTF 子集化。同一 name + style 已有嵌入面报 InvalidField。
insertEmbeddedFontOp.limitsEn: subsetted returns UnknownField. This phase does not write w:subsetted and does not subset a TTF in the library. An embed face that already exists for the same name + style returns InvalidField.

deleteEmbeddedFontOp.description: 删掉该 embed*、对应 font 部件及 fontTable 关系。
deleteEmbeddedFontOp.descriptionEn: Delete that embed*, the matching font part, and the fontTable relationship.
deleteEmbeddedFontOp.limits: 所属 w:font 条目留下（即使再也没有 embed*）。fontTable 本身不因删光嵌入面而拆掉。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 font:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteEmbeddedFontOp.limitsEn: The owning w:font entry stays, even if it no longer has any embed*. fontTable itself is not removed when every embed face is gone. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not font:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setFontEmbedOp.descriptionEn: Change how an embedded font is used.
setFontEmbedOp.limits: 三者至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。未点名的标志留下。本 op 不自动嵌字体、不子集化、不改 fontTable。 没有 settings 且要写成 true 时新建 /word/settings.xml 与主文档 settings 关系。id 不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setFontEmbedOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of the three, otherwise InvalidField. Unnamed flags stay. This op does not embed a font automatically, does not subset, and does not change fontTable. If settings is missing and a value must be written as true, create /word/settings.xml and the main document's settings relationship. An id that is not docx:document returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertFootnoteOp.description: 在该段末插入一个新 run，内含 w:footnoteReference 或 w:endnoteReference。
insertFootnoteOp.descriptionEn: Insert a new run at the end of that paragraph, containing w:footnoteReference or w:endnoteReference.
insertFootnoteOp.limits: 不提供字符偏移。分配该注部件里尚未占用的 w:id（十进制，跳过已有用户注和分隔符，常见从 2 起）。
insertFootnoteOp.limitsEn: No character offset is provided. Allocates an unused w:id in that notes part (decimal, skipping existing user notes and separators, commonly starting at 2).

insertEndnoteOp.description: 在该段末插入一个新 run，内含 w:footnoteReference 或 w:endnoteReference。
insertEndnoteOp.descriptionEn: Insert a new run at the end of that paragraph, containing w:footnoteReference or w:endnoteReference.
insertEndnoteOp.limits: 不提供字符偏移。分配该注部件里尚未占用的 w:id（十进制，跳过已有用户注和分隔符，常见从 2 起）。
insertEndnoteOp.limitsEn: No character offset is provided. Allocates an unused w:id in that notes part (decimal, skipping existing user notes and separators, commonly starting at 2).

deleteFootnoteOp.description: 去掉主文档、页眉、页脚和文本框里所有匹配的引用 run，再去掉注部件里该条 w:footnote / w:endnote。
deleteFootnoteOp.descriptionEn: Remove every matching reference run in the main document, headers, footers, and text boxes, then remove that w:footnote / w:endnote from the notes part.
deleteFootnoteOp.limits: 不得删分隔符。已经不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是用户注 id 报 InvalidId。注内图按图片规则：该媒体不再被任何关系引用则删除部件。删光用户注后仍保留注部件和两条分隔符，不拆掉整个 part。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteFootnoteOp.limitsEn: Separators must not be deleted. An id that no longer exists returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a user-note id returns InvalidId. A picture inside a note follows picture rules: the media part is deleted if no relationship still references it. After every user note is deleted, the notes part and the two separators remain; the whole part is not removed. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteEndnoteOp.description: 去掉主文档、页眉、页脚和文本框里所有匹配的引用 run，再去掉注部件里该条 w:footnote / w:endnote。
deleteEndnoteOp.descriptionEn: Remove every matching reference run in the main document, headers, footers, and text boxes, then remove that w:footnote / w:endnote from the notes part.
deleteEndnoteOp.limits: 不得删分隔符。已经不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是用户注 id 报 InvalidId。注内图按图片规则：该媒体不再被任何关系引用则删除部件。删光用户注后仍保留注部件和两条分隔符，不拆掉整个 part。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteEndnoteOp.limitsEn: Separators must not be deleted. An id that no longer exists returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a user-note id returns InvalidId. A picture inside a note follows picture rules: the media part is deleted if no relationship still references it. After every user note is deleted, the notes part and the two separators remain; the whole part is not removed. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setNoteNumberingOp.limits: numFmt、numStart、numRestart 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。只改被点名的属性，其余编号属性保留。不重算页面上已经画出来的序号（那是渲染，Word 打开时自己画）。 不认识的枚举报 InvalidField。id 不是 docx:document 或 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。节不存在报 IdNotFound。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setNoteNumberingOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of numFmt, numStart, and numRestart, otherwise InvalidField. Only the named attributes are changed; the other numbering attributes stay. Numbers already drawn on the page are not recomputed (that is rendering; Word draws them when it opens the file). An unrecognized enum returns InvalidField. An id that is not docx:document or section:{n} returns InvalidId. A missing section returns IdNotFound. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setHeaderFooterDistanceOp.description: 改页眉页脚到页边的距离。
setHeaderFooterDistanceOp.descriptionEn: Change the distance from the header and footer to the page edge.
setHeaderFooterDistanceOp.limits: 两个距离至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。节不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setHeaderFooterDistanceOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of the two distances, otherwise InvalidField. A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setHeaderFooterLinkOp.description: 改这一节的页眉页脚是否沿用上一节。
setHeaderFooterLinkOp.descriptionEn: Change whether this section's header and footer continue from the previous section.
setHeaderFooterLinkOp.limits: 第一节上 linked: true 报 InvalidField。该类型对本节不生效时报 InvalidField（不替用户打开首页不同或奇偶页）。节不存在报 IdNotFound。 id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。已经是目标状态则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied，不脏任何部件。
setHeaderFooterLinkOp.limitsEn: linked: true on the first section returns InvalidField. If that type does not apply to this section, InvalidField is returned (this does not turn on a different first page or odd and even pages for the user). A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. If it is already the target state, this is a no-op, still counted in opsApplied, and no part is dirtied.

insertHeaderFooterOp.description: 给这一节加上页眉或页脚。
insertHeaderFooterOp.descriptionEn: Add a header or footer to this section.
insertHeaderFooterOp.limits: 该类型对本节不生效时报 InvalidField（不替用户打开首页不同或奇偶页）。 本节该类型已经链接前节（inspect 的 headerLink / footerLink 为 true）时报 InvalidField； 要独立部件走 setHeaderFooterLink 且 linked: false。 节不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertHeaderFooterOp.limitsEn: If that type does not apply to this section, InvalidField is returned (this does not turn on a different first page or odd and even pages for the user). If this section's type is already linked to the previous section (inspect headerLink / footerLink is true), InvalidField is returned. For an independent part, use setHeaderFooterLink with linked: false. A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertSectionOp.description: 插在点名段之后：该段成为当前节的最后一段。
insertSectionOp.descriptionEn: Insert after the named paragraph: that paragraph becomes the last paragraph of the current section.
insertSectionOp.limits: 该段还没有 pPr/sectPr 时，把分节符写在该段上。该段已经带 sectPr 时，在它后面插入一个空的 w:p（新 w14:paraId），把新分节符放在这个空段上。不要拆 run，不要拆段落中间。
insertSectionOp.limitsEn: If the paragraph has no pPr/sectPr, write the section break on that paragraph. If it already has sectPr, insert an empty w:p after it (a new w14:paraId) and put the new section break on that empty paragraph. Do not split a run, and do not split the middle of a paragraph.

deleteSectionOp.description: 删掉结束第 n 节的那个 w:sectPr（一定在某段 pPr 上，不会是 w:body 末尾那一份）。
deleteSectionOp.descriptionEn: Delete the w:sectPr that ends section n. It is always on some paragraph's pPr, never the one at the end of w:body.
deleteSectionOp.limits: 第 n 节的正文并进第 n+1 节，沿用第 n+1 节的节属性。这与 Word 删除分节符的方向相同。
deleteSectionOp.limitsEn: Section n's body is merged into section n+1, which keeps section n+1's section properties. This is the same direction as deleting a section break in Word.

setTitlePageOp.description: 不新建 first 页眉页脚。
setTitlePageOp.descriptionEn: Does not create a first-page header or footer.
setTitlePageOp.limits: 关掉时不删除已有 first 部件。已经是目标状态则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied，不脏任何部件。节不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTitlePageOp.limitsEn: Turning it off does not delete an existing first part. If it is already the target state, this is a no-op, still counted in opsApplied, and no part is dirtied. A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setEvenAndOddHeadersOp.descriptionEn: One setting for the whole document, not per section.
setEvenAndOddHeadersOp.limits: 不新建 even 页眉页脚。关掉时不删除已有 even 部件。已经是目标状态则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied，不脏任何部件。没有 settings.xml 时报 OpcPartMissing。id 不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setEvenAndOddHeadersOp.limitsEn: Does not create an even-page header or footer. Turning it off does not delete an existing even part. If it is already the target state, this is a no-op, still counted in opsApplied, and no part is dirtied. A missing settings.xml returns OpcPartMissing. An id that is not docx:document returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setPageMarginOp.limits: 五个边距至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。不要出现 headerDistance / footerDistance。节不存在报 IdNotFound。 id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setPageMarginOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of the five margins, otherwise InvalidField. Do not include headerDistance / footerDistance. A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setPageSizeOp.limits: 三个字段至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。不认识的 orient 报 InvalidField。只改被点名的属性。没有 w:pgSz 时插入一个，只写本次给出的字段，不补宽高，也不猜纵向。 改 orient 时不自动对调 pageWidth / pageHeight。不读写 w:code。
setPageSizeOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of the three fields, otherwise InvalidField. An unrecognized orient returns InvalidField. Only the named attributes are changed. If w:pgSz is missing, one is inserted, writing only the fields given this time: width and height are not filled in, and portrait is not guessed. Changing orient does not automatically swap pageWidth / pageHeight. w:code is neither read nor written.

setColumnsOp.limits: enabled: false 与其它字段不能同时出现，否则报 InvalidField。其余字段至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。num 小于 1 报 InvalidField。只改被点名的属性。 没有 w:cols 且不是删除时插入一个。给了 cols 却同时 equalWidth 为 true 报 InvalidField。
setColumnsOp.limitsEn: enabled: false cannot appear together with other fields, otherwise InvalidField. Provide at least one of the remaining fields, otherwise InvalidField. num less than 1 returns InvalidField. Only the named attributes are changed. If w:cols is missing and this is not a delete, one is inserted. Providing cols while equalWidth is true returns InvalidField.

setVerticalAlignOp.limits: 不认识的字符串报 InvalidField。

setLineNumberingOp.limits: enabled: false 与其它字段不能同时出现。其余字段至少给一个。没有 w:lnNumType 且不是删除时插入一个，只写本次给出的属性。
setLineNumberingOp.limitsEn: enabled: false cannot appear together with other fields. Provide at least one of the remaining fields. If w:lnNumType is missing and this is not a delete, one is inserted, writing only the attributes given this time.

setDocGridOp.limits: enabled: false 与其它字段不能同时出现。其余字段至少给一个。没有 w:docGrid 且不是删除时插入一个。
setDocGridOp.limitsEn: enabled: false cannot appear together with other fields. Provide at least one of the remaining fields. If w:docGrid is missing and this is not a delete, one is inserted.

setMirrorMarginsOp.descriptionEn: Turn mirror margins on or off.
setMirrorMarginsOp.limits: id 不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。没有 settings.xml 报 OpcPartMissing。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setMirrorMarginsOp.limitsEn: An id that is not docx:document returns InvalidId. A missing settings.xml returns OpcPartMissing. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setGutterAtTopOp.description: id 与缺 settings 的报错与 setMirrorMargins 相同。
setGutterAtTopOp.descriptionEn: The id error and the missing-settings error match setMirrorMargins.
setGutterAtTopOp.limits: 关掉本标志不改各节 w:pgMar/@w:gutter。
setGutterAtTopOp.limitsEn: Turning this flag off does not change w:pgMar/@w:gutter on any section.

insertTocOp.description: 在点名段之后插入一个新的 w:p（新 w14:paraId），里面写一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText、fldChar separate、fldChar end。
insertTocOp.descriptionEn: After the named paragraph, insert a new w:p (a new w14:paraId) containing one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText, fldChar separate, and fldChar end.
insertTocOp.limits: 不写结果 run，不在库里根据标题算页码。不包 w:sdt。id 可以是正文、页眉页脚、文本框、脚注、尾注、批注段落，或 docx:document。表格单元格、section:{n}、toc:{n}、容器 id、表 id、run id 报 InvalidId。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。
insertTocOp.limitsEn: Does not write a result run, and this library does not compute page numbers from headings. Does not wrap a w:sdt. id may be a body, header, footer, text box, footnote, endnote, or comment paragraph, or docx:document. A table cell, section:{n}, toc:{n}, a container id, a table id, or a run id returns InvalidId. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound.

deleteTocOp.limits: 若该 TOC 域落在 w:sdt 里，且 sdtPr 的 docPartGallery 为 Table of Contents / Table of Figures / List of Figures / Table of Authorities， 并且该 sdt 是 w:body 的直接子节点，则删掉整个 sdt（含「目录」标题段）。否则删掉该域从 begin 到 end 的全部 run（含结果区里的嵌套域），再删掉因此变空、且没有 sectPr 的正文段落。不要留下空的目录段。
deleteTocOp.limitsEn: If that TOC field sits inside a w:sdt, sdtPr's docPartGallery is Table of Contents / Table of Figures / List of Figures / Table of Authorities, and that sdt is a direct child of w:body, delete the whole sdt (including the "目录" title paragraph). Otherwise delete every run of that field from begin through end (including nested fields in the result range), then delete body paragraphs that become empty and have no sectPr. Do not leave an empty TOC paragraph.

insertCaptionOp.description: 在点名段之后插入一个新的 w:p（新 w14:paraId）：bookmarkStart、标签 run（{label} 后带一个空格）、 一组复杂 SEQ 域（fldChar begin 带 w:dirty="true"、指令 SEQ {label} \* ARABIC 、separate、end， 不写结果 run）、bookmarkEnd、若给了 title 再写说明 run（若 title 不是以空白开头则前面补一个空格）。
insertCaptionOp.descriptionEn: After the named paragraph, insert a new w:p (a new w14:paraId): bookmarkStart, a label run ({label} followed by one space), one complex SEQ field (fldChar begin with w:dirty="true", instruction SEQ {label} \* ARABIC, separate, end; no result run is written), bookmarkEnd, and, if title is given, a description run (a leading space is added when title does not already start with whitespace).
insertCaptionOp.limits: 不写 Caption 段落样式。不在库里求序号。id 只能是正文段落、正文文本框段落，或 docx:document。页眉、页脚、脚注、尾注、批注，以及这些故事里的文本框，报 InvalidId。Word 更新 SEQ 的原话是「错误!仅主文档。」
insertCaptionOp.limitsEn: Does not write the Caption paragraph style. This library does not compute the sequence number. id must be a body paragraph, a body text-box paragraph, or docx:document. A header, footer, footnote, endnote, comment, or a text box in those stories returns InvalidId. Word's updated SEQ says the field is main-document only.

deleteCaptionOp.description: 若该 SEQ 落在 w:body 的直接子段落上，则删掉整段（题注就是这一段）。
deleteCaptionOp.descriptionEn: If that SEQ sits on a direct child paragraph of w:body, delete the whole paragraph (the caption is that paragraph).
deleteCaptionOp.limits: 某段带分节符且不能整段删掉时，报 NotImplemented。否则只拆掉该 SEQ 域（含缓存）以及包住它的 _Ref* 书签，不删格子或页眉段落。删完后若 w:body 里没有 w:p，在 sectPr 之前补一个空段。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 caption:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteCaptionOp.limitsEn: If a paragraph has a section break and the whole paragraph cannot be deleted, NotImplemented is returned. Otherwise only that SEQ field (including its cache) and the _Ref* bookmark around it are removed; a table cell or header paragraph is not deleted. After the delete, if w:body has no w:p, insert an empty paragraph before sectPr. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not caption:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertCrossRefOp.description: 在该段已有内容之后插入一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText、fldChar separate、fldChar end。
insertCrossRefOp.descriptionEn: After the paragraph's existing content, insert one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText, fldChar separate, and fldChar end.
insertCrossRefOp.limits: 不写结果 run，不计算注的编号。kind 为 note 时写 NOTEREF，并带 \h。bookmark 与 target 必须二选一，都给、都不给，或 target 配了不是 note 的 kind，报 InvalidField。bookmark 空串或含空白报 InvalidField。主文档里没有该书签名报 IdNotFound。target 为 footnote:{id} 或 endnote:{id}：已有紧邻的 _Ref 书签则复用，否则在引用标记 run 前后插入。正文文本框可以套。引用标记只在页眉或页脚里时报 InvalidField。找不到该注报 IdNotFound。target 不是注 id 报 InvalidId。同一批刚插入的注要先 inspect 再另一次 apply。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是段落 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertCrossRefOp.limitsEn: Does not write a result run and does not compute the note number. kind note writes NOTEREF with \h. bookmark and target are mutually exclusive: both, neither, or target with a kind other than note returns InvalidField. An empty bookmark or one that contains whitespace returns InvalidField. A bookmark name missing from the main document returns IdNotFound. target is footnote:{id} or endnote:{id}: reuse a tight _Ref bookmark, or insert one around the reference run. A mark in a main-document text box is allowed. A mark that exists only in a header or footer returns InvalidField. A missing note returns IdNotFound. A target that is not a note id returns InvalidId. A note inserted in the same batch must be inspected, then targeted in a later apply. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a paragraph id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteCrossRefOp.description: 拆掉该 REF / PAGEREF / NOTEREF 域（含指令与缓存），不删所在段落。
deleteCrossRefOp.descriptionEn: Remove that REF / PAGEREF / NOTEREF field (instruction and cache included) without deleting the paragraph that holds it.
deleteCrossRefOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 xref:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteCrossRefOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not xref:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertIndexOp.description: 在点名段之后插入一个新的 w:p（新 w14:paraId），里面写一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText、fldChar separate、fldChar end。
insertIndexOp.descriptionEn: After the named paragraph, insert a new w:p (a new w14:paraId) containing one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText, fldChar separate, and fldChar end.
insertIndexOp.limits: 不写结果 run，不在库里根据 XE 算页码。不包 w:sdt，不写 Index 样式，不改 sectPr 分栏。id 只能是正文段落或 docx:document。页眉、页脚、文本框、脚注、尾注、批注、表格单元格，以及 section:{n}、index:{n}、toc:{n}、容器 id、表 id、run id，报 InvalidId。Word 更新 INDEX 的原话是「错误!脚注、尾注、页眉、页脚或批注中不允许有索引。」已有文件里的 INDEX 仍可 inspect 和 deleteIndex。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。
insertIndexOp.limitsEn: Does not write a result run, and this library does not compute page numbers from XE entries. Does not wrap a w:sdt, does not write the Index style, and does not change sectPr columns. id must be a body paragraph or docx:document. A header, footer, text box, footnote, endnote, comment, table cell, section:{n}, index:{n}, toc:{n}, a container id, a table id, or a run id returns InvalidId. Word's updated INDEX says an index is not allowed in a footnote, endnote, header, footer, or comment. An INDEX already in a file can still be inspected and deleted. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound.

deleteIndexOp.description: 删掉该 INDEX 域从 begin 到 end 的全部 run（含结果区里的嵌套域），再删掉因此变空、且没有 sectPr 的正文段落。
deleteIndexOp.descriptionEn: Delete every run of that INDEX field from begin through end (including nested fields in the result range), then delete body paragraphs that become empty and have no sectPr.
deleteIndexOp.limits: 不要留下空的索引段。删完后若 w:body 里没有 w:p，在 sectPr 之前补一个空段。某段带分节符且不能整段删掉时，报 NotImplemented。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 index:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteIndexOp.limitsEn: Do not leave an empty index paragraph. After the delete, if w:body has no w:p, insert an empty paragraph before sectPr. If a paragraph has a section break and the whole paragraph cannot be deleted, NotImplemented is returned. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not index:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertIndexEntryOp.description: 在该段已有内容之后插入一组复杂域：fldChar begin、一条 instrText、fldChar end。
insertIndexEntryOp.descriptionEn: After the paragraph's existing content, insert one complex field: fldChar begin, one instrText, and fldChar end.
insertIndexEntryOp.limits: 不写 separate（与 Word 16.0 Indexes.MarkEntry 一致），不写 w:vanish，不写结果 run。不在库里求页码。框内、注内、批注内的段落，以及索引 id、容器 id、表 id、run id，一律报 InvalidId。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertIndexEntryOp.limitsEn: Does not write separate (matching Word 16.0 Indexes.MarkEntry), does not write w:vanish, and does not write a result run. This library does not compute page numbers. Paragraphs inside a text box, note, or comment, and an index id, container id, table id, or run id, all return InvalidId. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteIndexEntryOp.description: 拆掉该 XE 域（含指令），不删所在段落。
deleteIndexEntryOp.descriptionEn: Remove that XE field (including the instruction) without deleting the paragraph that holds it.
deleteIndexEntryOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 xe:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteIndexEntryOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not xe:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertSourceOp.description: 没有 bibliography customXml 时新建 /customXml/itemN.xml（空 b:Sources，SelectedStyle 为 \APASixthEditionOfficeOnline.xsl， StyleName 为 APA，Version 为 6）、itemPropsN.xml（schemaRef 为 bibliography 命名空间）、itemN.xml.rels，以及主文档 /customXml 关系。
insertSourceOp.descriptionEn: If there is no bibliography customXml, create /customXml/itemN.xml (empty b:Sources, SelectedStyle \APASixthEditionOfficeOnline.xsl, StyleName APA, Version 6), itemPropsN.xml (schemaRef is the bibliography namespace), itemN.xml.rels, and the main document's /customXml relationship.
insertSourceOp.limits: 只给 itemProps 写 Content Type Override。
insertSourceOp.limitsEn: Write a Content Type Override only for itemProps.

deleteSourceOp.description: 删掉该 b:Source，按剩余源重写 b:RefOrder（从 1 起）。
deleteSourceOp.descriptionEn: Delete that b:Source, and rewrite b:RefOrder from the remaining sources, starting at 1.
deleteSourceOp.limits: 不删 CITATION / BIBLIOGRAPHY 域。空了也留下 b:Sources 部件。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 source:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteSourceOp.limitsEn: CITATION / BIBLIOGRAPHY fields are not deleted. The b:Sources part stays even when it is empty. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not source:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertCitationOp.description: 在该段已有内容之后插入一行内 w:sdt：sdtPr 含 w:id 与空的 w:citation， sdtContent 里写一组复杂域（fldChar begin 带 w:dirty="true"、指令 CITATION {tag} 、separate、end）。
insertCitationOp.descriptionEn: After the paragraph's existing content, insert an inline w:sdt: sdtPr contains w:id and an empty w:citation, and sdtContent contains one complex field (fldChar begin with w:dirty="true", instruction CITATION {tag}, separate, end).
insertCitationOp.limits: 不写结果 run，不写 dataBinding。不在库里排版引文。主文档里没有该 tag 报 IdNotFound。空串、只含空白或含英文双引号的 tag 报 InvalidField。框内、注内、批注内本期不编。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertCitationOp.limitsEn: Does not write a result run and does not write dataBinding. This library does not format the citation. A tag that is not in the main document returns IdNotFound. An empty string, a whitespace-only tag, or a tag that contains an ASCII double quote returns InvalidField. Text boxes, notes, and comments are not supported in this phase. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteCitationOp.description: 若该 CITATION 包在带 w:citation 的 w:sdt 里，删掉整个 sdt；否则只拆掉该域。
deleteCitationOp.descriptionEn: If that CITATION is wrapped in a w:sdt that has w:citation, delete the whole sdt; otherwise only remove that field.
deleteCitationOp.limits: 不删所在段落，也不删书目源。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 cite:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteCitationOp.limitsEn: The paragraph that holds it is not deleted, and the bibliography source is not deleted. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not cite:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertBibliographyOp.description: 在点名段之后插入一个新的 w:p，里面写一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText、fldChar separate、fldChar end。
insertBibliographyOp.descriptionEn: After the named paragraph, insert a new w:p containing one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText, fldChar separate, and fldChar end.
insertBibliographyOp.limits: 不写结果 run，不包 w:sdt，不写 Bibliography 样式。不在库里按源排版。表格单元格内、页眉页脚、框内、注内、批注内的段落报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertBibliographyOp.limitsEn: Does not write a result run, does not wrap a w:sdt, and does not write the Bibliography style. This library does not lay out the bibliography from the sources. Paragraphs inside a table cell, header, footer, text box, note, or comment return InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteBibliographyOp.description: 删掉该 BIBLIOGRAPHY 域从 begin 到 end 的全部 run，再删掉因此变空、且没有 sectPr 的正文段落。
deleteBibliographyOp.descriptionEn: Delete every run of that BIBLIOGRAPHY field from begin through end, then delete body paragraphs that become empty and have no sectPr.
deleteBibliographyOp.limits: 删完后若 w:body 里没有 w:p，补一个空段。某段带分节符且不能整段删掉时，报 NotImplemented。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 biblio:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteBibliographyOp.limitsEn: After the delete, if w:body has no w:p, insert an empty paragraph. If a paragraph has a section break and the whole paragraph cannot be deleted, NotImplemented is returned. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not biblio:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setBibliographyStyleOp.description: 按 Word 16.0 另存写 b:Sources 的三个属性：
setBibliographyStyleOp.descriptionEn: Write the three attributes of b:Sources the way Word 16.0 Save As does:

insertDocPartOp.description: 没有 glossary 时新建 /word/glossary/document.xml（空 w:docParts）， 并写卫星 styles.xml / settings.xml / webSettings.xml / fontTable.xml、glossary .rels、 主文档 glossaryDocument 关系与 Content Type Override。
insertDocPartOp.descriptionEn: If there is no glossary, create /word/glossary/document.xml (empty w:docParts), and write the satellite styles.xml / settings.xml / webSettings.xml / fontTable.xml, the glossary .rels, the main document's glossaryDocument relationship, and the Content Type Override.
insertDocPartOp.limits: styles.xml / settings.xml 复制自主文档对应部件；没有则写最小 styles / settings。
insertDocPartOp.limitsEn: styles.xml / settings.xml are copied from the matching main-document parts. If those parts are missing, minimal styles / settings are written.

deleteDocPartOp.limits: 删光最后一条则去掉 glossary 部件、卫星、主文档关系与 Override，不要留空 w:docParts。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 docPart:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteDocPartOp.limitsEn: When the last entry is deleted, remove the glossary part, the satellites, the main-document relationship, and the Override. Do not leave an empty w:docParts. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not docPart:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertDocPartContentOp.description: 把该条目 docPartBody 的块级子节点复制进主文档。
insertDocPartContentOp.descriptionEn: Copy that entry's docPartBody block-level children into the main document.
insertDocPartContentOp.limits: 跳过 sectPr 与末尾空段。给新的 w:p 分配新 w14:paraId。behavior 为 pg 时先插一条只含 w:br/@w:type="page" 的段。content 与 p 都按块级兄弟插入（不把末段 run 并进点名段）。表格单元格内、页眉页脚、框内、注内、批注内的段落报 InvalidId。找不到基块报 IdNotFound。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertDocPartContentOp.limitsEn: Skip sectPr and a trailing empty paragraph. Assign a new w14:paraId to each new w:p. When behavior is pg, first insert a paragraph that contains only w:br/@w:type="page". Both content and p are inserted as block-level siblings (the last paragraph's runs are not merged into the named paragraph). Paragraphs inside a table cell, header, footer, text box, note, or comment return InvalidId. A missing base block returns IdNotFound. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

acceptRevisionOp.limits: run 级 ins：拆掉 w:ins 外壳，留下内部 w:r，并去掉这些 run 的属性容器上的 ins / del（Word 会另写在 rPr 里，不进树）。run 级 del：删掉整个 w:del（含 delText）。run 级 moveFrom：删掉该节点（含内容），并删掉包住它的同 w:id 的 moveFromRangeStart / moveFromRangeEnd。
acceptRevisionOp.limitsEn: Run-level ins: unwrap the w:ins shell, keep the inner w:r, and remove ins / del on those runs' property containers (Word also writes them on rPr, which is not in the tree). Run-level del: delete the whole w:del, including delText. Run-level moveFrom: delete that node, including its content, and delete the moveFromRangeStart / moveFromRangeEnd with the same w:id that wraps it.

rejectRevisionOp.description: run 级 ins：删掉整个 w:ins。
rejectRevisionOp.descriptionEn: Run-level ins: delete the whole w:ins.
rejectRevisionOp.limits: run 级 del：拆掉 w:del 外壳，把其中 w:delText 改回 w:t，并去掉内部属性容器上的 ins / del。run 级 moveFrom：拆掉 w:moveFrom 外壳，留下内部 w:r，并删掉包住它的 RangeStart/End。run 级 moveTo：删掉该节点（含内容），并删掉包住它的 RangeStart/End。rPrChange：用 Change 里的旧 w:rPr 替换当前 run 属性。pPrChange：用 Change 里的旧 w:pPr 替换当前段落属性。
rejectRevisionOp.limitsEn: Run-level del: unwrap the w:del shell, change its w:delText back to w:t, and remove ins / del on the inner property containers. Run-level moveFrom: unwrap the w:moveFrom shell, keep the inner w:r, and delete the RangeStart/End that wraps it. Run-level moveTo: delete that node, including its content, and delete the RangeStart/End that wraps it. rPrChange: replace the current run properties with the old w:rPr inside the Change. pPrChange: replace the current paragraph properties with the old w:pPr inside the Change.

insertContentControlOp.description: 在点名段末尾追加一个行内 w:sdt（sdtPr 含 w:id，值为本故事里尚未占用的十进制数字；有 tag / alias 则写入；类型元素按 kind）。
insertContentControlOp.descriptionEn: Append an inline w:sdt at the end of the named paragraph (sdtPr contains w:id, a decimal not yet used in this story; tag / alias are written when present; the type element follows kind).
insertContentControlOp.limits: checkbox 写 w14:checkbox（checked / checkedState / uncheckedState，缺省符号 U+2612 / U+2610、字体 MS Gothic）， sdtContent 里一条带 MS Gothic 的 w:r/w:t（勾选 ☒、未勾 ☐）。根元素补 xmlns:w14，并把 w14 列入 mc:Ignorable。
insertContentControlOp.limitsEn: checkbox writes w14:checkbox (checked / checkedState / uncheckedState; default symbols U+2612 / U+2610, font MS Gothic), and sdtContent gets one w:r/w:t in MS Gothic (checked ☒, unchecked ☐). The root element gains xmlns:w14, and w14 is added to mc:Ignorable.

setContentControlOp.description: checkbox：改 w14:checked 与内容符号字符，不把 sdtContent 换成任意文本。
setContentControlOp.descriptionEn: checkbox: change w14:checked and the content symbol character. Do not replace sdtContent with arbitrary text.
setContentControlOp.limits: picture：用新的行内 DrawingML 换掉控件里的图。其余 kind 用新文本替换当前值。块级有表格时只改第一个 w:p，留下表格。有 storeItemID 且 xpath 是简单元素路径时，同时改 customXml 节点。缺少 storeItemID 或 xpath 不是简单路径，报 NotImplemented。
setContentControlOp.limitsEn: picture replaces the picture inside the control. Other kinds replace the current value. A block control that contains a table only changes the first w:p and keeps the table. When storeItemID is present and xpath is a simple element path, the customXml node changes too. A missing storeItemID or a non-simple xpath returns NotImplemented.

deleteContentControlOp.description: keep 为 none 时：因此变空且无 sectPr 的正文段可删掉。
deleteContentControlOp.descriptionEn: When keep is none: a body paragraph that becomes empty and has no sectPr may be deleted.
deleteContentControlOp.limits: 表格单元格内的空段留下。删完后若 w:body 里没有 w:p，在 sectPr 之前补一个空段。某段带分节符且不能整段删掉时，报 NotImplemented。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是内容控件 id 报 InvalidId。不认识的 keep 报 InvalidField。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteContentControlOp.limitsEn: An empty paragraph inside a table cell stays. After the delete, if w:body has no w:p, insert an empty paragraph before sectPr. If a paragraph has a section break and the whole paragraph cannot be deleted, NotImplemented is returned. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a content-control id returns InvalidId. An unrecognized keep returns InvalidField. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertRepeatingItemOp.description: 在重复节里再克隆一项。
insertRepeatingItemOp.descriptionEn: Clone one more item inside a repeating section.
insertRepeatingItemOp.limits: id 可以是重复节或其中一项。克隆项插在该项后面；点的是节时克隆最后一项。新项换掉 w:id。不是重复节报 NotImplemented。
insertRepeatingItemOp.limitsEn: id may be the repeating section or one of its items. The clone is inserted after that item; when id is the section, the last item is cloned. The new item gets a new w:id. An id that is not a repeating section returns NotImplemented.

deleteRepeatingItemOp.descriptionEn: Delete one item inside a repeating section.
deleteRepeatingItemOp.limits: id 必须是 repeatingSectionItem。只剩一项时报 InvalidField。点到外壳报 NotImplemented。
deleteRepeatingItemOp.limitsEn: id must be a repeatingSectionItem. Deleting the last item returns InvalidField. The section shell returns NotImplemented.

insertNumberingOp.description: 写入一份抽象定义（9 级 hybridMultilevel）加一个 w:num 实例。
insertNumberingOp.descriptionEn: Write one abstract definition (9-level hybridMultilevel) plus one w:num instance.
insertNumberingOp.limits: 没有 /word/numbering.xml 则新建该部件、主文档关系与内容类型 Override。decimal 的 lvlText 为 %1.、%1.%2. 这类累计小数；bullet 用 Symbol 字体，各级 lvlText 轮换实心点、o 与节号。apply 不返回新 id；随后 inspect 按 w:num 文档顺序，新实例在名单末尾。kind 缺或不认识报 InvalidField。id 不是 docx:document 报 InvalidId。
insertNumberingOp.limitsEn: If /word/numbering.xml is missing, create that part, the main-document relationship, and the content-type Override. For decimal, lvlText is a cumulative decimal such as %1. or %1.%2. For bullet, the font is Symbol, and each level's lvlText rotates a filled bullet, o, and a section sign. apply does not return the new id. A later inspect lists w:num in document order, with the new instance at the end of the list. A missing or unrecognized kind returns InvalidField. An id that is not docx:document returns InvalidId.

setNumberingOp.descriptionEn: Change the format of one numbering level.
setNumberingOp.limits: numFmt、start、lvlText 至少给一个。只改被点名抽象定义上已有的 w:lvl，不自动建级，也不改该实例上的 w:lvlOverride。 不认识的 numFmt、ilvl 超出 0–8、或该抽象定义没有这一级，报 InvalidField。找不到抽象定义报 IdNotFound。id 不是抽象编号 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setNumberingOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of numFmt, start, and lvlText. Only an existing w:lvl on the named abstract definition is changed. Levels are not created automatically, and w:lvlOverride on that instance is not changed. An unrecognized numFmt, an ilvl outside 0–8, or an abstract definition that does not have that level returns InvalidField. A missing abstract definition returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an abstract-numbering id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setStyleOp.limits: font、eastAsiaFont、sz、bold、color、before、after 至少给一个。 段落、字符、表格样式都可改（w:type 为 paragraph / character / table，或缺省当段落）。编号样式报 InvalidField。 before / after 只允许段落与表格样式；字符样式带这两项报 InvalidField。rPr 字段三种都可写。 空 font / eastAsiaFont、不是六位十六进制的 color、sz 越界报 InvalidField。
setStyleOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of font, eastAsiaFont, sz, bold, color, before, and after. Paragraph, character, and table styles can all be changed (w:type is paragraph / character / table, or defaults to paragraph). A numbering style returns InvalidField. before / after are allowed only on paragraph and table styles; a character style that carries either returns InvalidField. rPr fields can be written on all three. An empty font / eastAsiaFont, a color that is not six hex digits, or sz out of range returns InvalidField.

insertStyleOp.description: 在 /word/styles.xml 末尾追加一条自定义样式。
insertStyleOp.descriptionEn: Append one custom style at the end of /word/styles.xml.
insertStyleOp.limits: 没有 styles 部件时新建最小部件，并补主文档关系与 [Content_Types].xml。
insertStyleOp.limitsEn: If the styles part is missing, create a minimal part, and add the main-document relationship and [Content_Types].xml.

deleteStyleOp.description: 只删 w:customStyle 为开（1 / true / on）且不是 w:default 的样式。
deleteStyleOp.descriptionEn: Delete only a style whose w:customStyle is on (1 / true / on) and that is not w:default.
deleteStyleOp.limits: 内置或没有 customStyle 的报 InvalidField。不扫描文档里的 pStyle / rStyle / tblStyle 引用。找不到样式报 IdNotFound。id 不是 style:{styleId} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteStyleOp.limitsEn: A built-in style, or a style without customStyle, returns InvalidField. pStyle / rStyle / tblStyle references in the document are not scanned. A missing style returns IdNotFound. An id that is not style:{styleId} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

mergeCellsOp.description: 把 Word 表格里的几格并成一格。
mergeCellsOp.descriptionEn: Merge several cells in a Word table into one cell.
mergeCellsOp.limits: 范围内已有合并、或格子对不上网格时报 NotImplemented。幸存格是左上角：水平方向写 gridSpan，垂直方向左上为 vMerge=restart、其余行为 continue。 被吃掉的格子里的段落（遇嵌套表停住）按先行后列挪进幸存格，然后删掉那些 w:tc。continue 格留下一个空的 w:p。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
mergeCellsOp.limitsEn: An existing merge in the range, or cells that do not line up with the grid, returns NotImplemented. The surviving cell is the top-left: horizontally it writes gridSpan; vertically the top-left is vMerge=restart and the other rows are continue. Paragraphs in the consumed cells (stopping at a nested table) are moved into the surviving cell in row-major order, and those w:tc elements are then deleted. A continue cell keeps one empty w:p. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

splitCellsOp.description: 把 Word 表格里并过的格子拆开。
splitCellsOp.descriptionEn: Split merged cells in a Word table.
splitCellsOp.limits: gridSpan 为 1 且没有 vMerge 时报 InvalidField。对 continue 格发此 op 报 InvalidField，必须点名 restart 那一格。 水平拆分后补出的新格各有一段空文本；垂直拆分去掉该列向下连续的 vMerge。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
splitCellsOp.limitsEn: gridSpan of 1 with no vMerge returns InvalidField. This op on a continue cell returns InvalidField; the restart cell must be named. After a horizontal split, each new cell has one empty paragraph. A vertical split removes the consecutive vMerge down that column. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTableStyleOp.description: 改 Word 表格的样式。
setTableStyleOp.limits: style 与 look 至少给一个。style 为样式 id 时目标必须是表格样式。段落 / 字符 / 编号样式报 InvalidField。找不到该样式报 IdNotFound。 look 对象字段：firstRow、lastRow、firstColumn、lastColumn、bandedRows、bandedColumns，均为可选布尔。未点名的开关与已有 tblLook 合并。 没有已有 tblLook 时缺省约 Word 的 04A0：首行开、末行关、首列开、末列关、行带开、列带关。 写出六个属性与 val（四位大写十六进制）。
setTableStyleOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of style and look. When style is a style id, the target must be a table style. A paragraph, character, or numbering style returns InvalidField. A missing style returns IdNotFound. look object fields: firstRow, lastRow, firstColumn, lastColumn, bandedRows, and bandedColumns, each an optional boolean. Unnamed switches are merged with the existing tblLook. When there is no existing tblLook, the default is about Word's 04A0: first row on, last row off, first column on, last column off, banded rows on, banded columns off. Writes the six attributes and val (four uppercase hex digits).

setTableFloatOp.description: 让 Word 表格浮在文字旁边。
setTableFloatOp.descriptionEn: Float a Word table beside the text.
setTableFloatOp.limits: 不要复用 pptx 的 setTablePos（单位是 EMU）。
setTableFloatOp.limitsEn: Do not reuse pptx setTablePos (its unit is EMU).

setTableWidthOp.description: 改 Word 表格的宽度。
setTableWidthOp.limits: 不要复用 pptx 的 setTableSize（单位是 EMU）。不要复用 xlsx 的 setColWidth。
setTableWidthOp.limitsEn: Do not reuse pptx setTableSize (its unit is EMU). Do not reuse xlsx setColWidth.

setTableAlignOp.description: 行内表的水平对齐与左缩进。
setTableAlignOp.descriptionEn: Horizontal alignment and left indent of an inline table.
setTableAlignOp.limitsEn: For a floating position, use setTableFloat.

setTableRowHeightOp.description: 改 Word 表格的行高。
setTableRowHeightOp.descriptionEn: Change a Word table's row height.
setTableRowHeightOp.limits: 不要复用 xlsx 的 setRowHeight（单位是磅）。
setTableRowHeightOp.limitsEn: Do not reuse xlsx setRowHeight (its unit is points).

setTableCellMarOp.description: 改 Word 表格单元格的内边距。
setTableCellMarOp.descriptionEn: Change a Word table cell's inner margins.
setTableCellMarOp.limits: 至少给一边。写入表级 tblCellMar，type="dxa"。四边都删光后去掉空的 tblCellMar。 找不到表报 IdNotFound。id 不是表 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTableCellMarOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one side. Writes table-level tblCellMar with type="dxa". After all four sides are deleted, the empty tblCellMar is removed. A missing table returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a table id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setTableBordersOp.description: 表级 w:tblBorders 的四边与内外框。
setTableBordersOp.descriptionEn: The four sides and the inside borders of table-level w:tblBorders.
setTableBordersOp.limits: 不要和格斜线、页面边框、段边框混。不算自动套表样式。
setTableBordersOp.limitsEn: Do not mix this with cell diagonals, page borders, or paragraph borders. This does not auto-apply a table style.

setCellBordersOp.description: 格级 w:tcBorders 的正交四边与格内 insideH / insideV。
setCellBordersOp.descriptionEn: The four orthogonal sides of cell-level w:tcBorders, plus insideH / insideV inside the cell.
setCellBordersOp.limits: 不要和 setCellFormat 的 tcMar、斜线、表级 setTableBorders 混。不算自动套表样式。
setCellBordersOp.limitsEn: Do not mix this with tcMar from setCellFormat, diagonals, or table-level setTableBorders. This does not auto-apply a table style.

setCellFormatOp.description: 改 Word 表格单元格的填充、边框和对齐。
setCellFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change a Word table cell's fill, borders, and alignment.
setCellFormatOp.limits: fill、四边、两条斜线、vAlign、noWrap、textDirection、fitText、hideMark、headers 至少给一个。 fill 写入 shd val="clear" color="auto"，并去掉 theme 填充属性。不是六位十六进制报 InvalidField。 vAlign 写入 tcPr/w:vAlign/@w:val。不认识报 InvalidField。不要和节上 setVerticalAlign 混。
setCellFormatOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of fill, the four sides, the two diagonals, vAlign, noWrap, textDirection, fitText, hideMark, and headers. fill writes shd with val="clear" and color="auto", and removes theme fill attributes. A value that is not six hex digits returns InvalidField. vAlign writes tcPr/w:vAlign/@w:val. An unrecognized value returns InvalidField. Do not confuse this with setVerticalAlign on a section.

setParaTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the text in one paragraph.
setParaTextOp.limits: 找不到该段落报 IdNotFound。不插入、不删除段落。多个 run 时只留第一个 run 已有的 w:rPr，其余 run 的字符格式去掉。对页眉或页脚容器 id（没有 /para:）报 InvalidId。该段里的 w:drawing 必须留下，包括只剩绘图、已经被清掉 w:t 的 run。
setParaTextOp.limitsEn: A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. Paragraphs are not inserted or deleted. When there are several runs, only the first run's existing w:rPr stays, and character formatting on the other runs is dropped. A header or footer container id (one without /para:) returns InvalidId. w:drawing in that paragraph must stay, including a run that has only the drawing and whose w:t has already been cleared.

setParaRunsOp.description: 按原文把已有段落拆成多个 run。短的用 match。中间很长时只写 after 和 before 两个切点。
setParaRunsOp.descriptionEn: Split an existing paragraph into runs from the original text. Use match for a short span. For a long span, give only the after and before cut points.
setParaRunsOp.limits: 不改没点名的字，不重建文件。不写 match 时，after 是左切点，before 是右切点，中间原文单独成一截，中间不用抄。重复时用 nth。text 连起来必须和现在的可见文字相同。
setParaRunsOp.limitsEn: Does not change unnamed words and does not rebuild the file. Without match, after is the left cut and before is the right cut; the text between them becomes the run and is not copied into the request. Use nth when the pair repeats. text pieces must join to the current visible text.

insertBookmarkOp.description: 在起始段 w:pPr 之后插入 w:bookmarkStart，在结束段末尾插入配对 w:bookmarkEnd。
insertBookmarkOp.descriptionEn: Insert w:bookmarkStart after the start paragraph's w:pPr, and insert the matching w:bookmarkEnd at the end of the end paragraph.
insertBookmarkOp.limits: w:id 取该部件已有书签 id 的最大整数加 1，至少为 0。name 不能为空、不能含空白、不能以 _ 开头，否则报 InvalidField。与已有书签名（含隐藏书签）冲突报 InvalidField。end 必须与 id 在同一故事，且文档顺序不得早于起始段，否则报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id / end 不是段落 id 报 InvalidId。
insertBookmarkOp.limitsEn: w:id is one greater than the largest existing bookmark id in that part, and at least 0. name must not be empty, must not contain whitespace, and must not start with _, otherwise InvalidField. A clash with an existing bookmark name, including hidden bookmarks, returns InvalidField. end must be in the same story as id, and must not precede the start paragraph in document order, otherwise InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id or end that is not a paragraph id returns InvalidId.

setBookmarkOp.limits: 同时把本部件里 w:hyperlink/@w:anchor 等于旧名的改成新名。新名规则与 insertBookmark 相同。与其他书签重名报 InvalidField。已经是该名则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是书签 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setBookmarkOp.limitsEn: Also change w:hyperlink/@w:anchor in this part from the old name to the new name. New-name rules match insertBookmark. A name already used by another bookmark returns InvalidField. If it is already that name, this is a no-op and is still counted in opsApplied. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a bookmark id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteBookmarkOp.description: 去掉配对的 w:bookmarkStart 与 w:bookmarkEnd。
deleteBookmarkOp.descriptionEn: Remove the matching pair of w:bookmarkStart and w:bookmarkEnd.
deleteBookmarkOp.limits: 不改指向该书签的 w:hyperlink/@w:anchor。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是书签 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteBookmarkOp.limitsEn: Does not change w:hyperlink/@w:anchor that points at that bookmark. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a bookmark id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

docxInsertFieldOp.description: 在该段已有内容之后插入一组复杂域：fldChar begin（w:dirty="true"）、一条 instrText（xml:space="preserve"）、fldChar separate、 若给了非空 result 则再写一个带 w:t 的 run、fldChar end。
docxInsertFieldOp.descriptionEn: After the paragraph's existing content, insert one complex field: fldChar begin (w:dirty="true"), one instrText (xml:space="preserve"), fldChar separate, then a run with w:t if a non-empty result was given, then fldChar end.
docxInsertFieldOp.limits: 给了窗体 code 时在 begin 里写 w:ffData，不写书签。不在库里求值。空 instr / 空 code / 同时给两者 / 两个都不给 / 不认识的 code / 缺 arg，报 InvalidField。
docxInsertFieldOp.limitsEn: When a form code is given, write w:ffData on begin and do not write a bookmark. This library does not evaluate the field. An empty instr, an empty code, giving both, giving neither, an unrecognized code, or a missing arg returns InvalidField.

docxSetFieldOp.description: 只改被点名那一域的指令，不改缓存结果，也不改 ffData。
docxSetFieldOp.descriptionEn: Change only the instruction of the named field. The cached result is not changed, and ffData is not changed.
docxSetFieldOp.limits: 简单域写 w:instr。复杂域删掉本层指令区里的旧 instrText 以及落在指令区里的嵌套域，在 begin 之后插入一条新的 instrText。结果区（separate 与 end 之间）不动。不在库里求值。instr 缺或只含空白报 InvalidField。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是域 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
docxSetFieldOp.limitsEn: A simple field writes w:instr. A complex field deletes the old instrText in this level's instruction range and any nested fields that fall in that instruction range, then inserts one new instrText after begin. The result range (between separate and end) is left unchanged. This library does not evaluate the field. A missing instr, or one that is only whitespace, returns InvalidField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

docxDeleteFieldOp.description: keep 为 result：拆掉该域外壳与指令，留下缓存结果。
docxDeleteFieldOp.descriptionEn: When keep is result: unwrap the field shell and the instruction, and keep the cached result.
docxDeleteFieldOp.limits: 指令区里的嵌套域一并删掉；结果区里的嵌套域留下。简单域拆掉 w:fldSimple，留下子节点。keep 为 instr：把本层指令变成普通可见文本（instrText 改成 w:t，简单域则写成一个带指令原文的 run），删掉 begin / separate / end 与结果区。指令区里的嵌套域留下。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是域 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
docxDeleteFieldOp.limitsEn: Nested fields in the instruction range are deleted along with it; nested fields in the result range stay. A simple field unwraps w:fldSimple and keeps its children. When keep is instr: turn this level's instruction into ordinary visible text (instrText becomes w:t; a simple field is written as a run that contains the instruction text), and delete begin / separate / end and the result range. Nested fields in the instruction range stay. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

setParaNumberingOp.description: num 为实例 id 时写入（或改写）w:numPr，插在 pStyle 之后。
setParaNumberingOp.descriptionEn: When num is an instance id, write or replace w:numPr, inserted after pStyle.
setParaNumberingOp.limits: 找不到该编号实例报 IdNotFound。num 为 null 时去掉 numPr，不要求 numbering 部件存在。缺 num 报 InvalidField。ilvl 超出 0–8 报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是正文或页眉页脚段落 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setParaNumberingOp.limitsEn: A missing numbering instance returns IdNotFound. When num is null, numPr is removed, and the numbering part need not exist. A missing num returns InvalidField. An ilvl outside 0–8 returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a body or header/footer paragraph id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setParaStyleOp.description: style 为样式 id 时写入（或改写）w:pStyle，放在 pPr 子元素最前。
setParaStyleOp.descriptionEn: When style is a style id, write or replace w:pStyle, placed first among the pPr children.
setParaStyleOp.limits: 目标必须已在 styles.xml 里，且是段落样式。字符 / 表格 / 编号样式报 InvalidField。找不到该样式报 IdNotFound。style 为 null 时去掉 pStyle，不要求 styles 部件存在。缺 style 报 InvalidField。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是正文或页眉页脚段落 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setParaStyleOp.limitsEn: The target must already be in styles.xml and must be a paragraph style. A character, table, or numbering style returns InvalidField. A missing style returns IdNotFound. When style is null, pStyle is removed, and the styles part need not exist. A missing style field returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a body or header/footer paragraph id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setRunStyleOp.description: style 为样式 id 时写入（或改写）w:rStyle，放在 rPr 子元素最前（EG_RPrBase）。
setRunStyleOp.descriptionEn: When style is a style id, write or replace w:rStyle, placed first among the rPr children (EG_RPrBase).
setRunStyleOp.limits: 目标必须已在 styles.xml 里，且是字符样式。段落 / 表格 / 编号样式报 InvalidField。找不到该样式报 IdNotFound。style 为 null 时去掉 rStyle，不要求 styles 部件存在。缺 style 报 InvalidField。找不到 run 报 IdNotFound。id 不是 run id 报 InvalidId。框内 / 注内 / 批注内 run 报 InvalidId。
setRunStyleOp.limitsEn: The target must already be in styles.xml and must be a character style. A paragraph, table, or numbering style returns InvalidField. A missing style returns IdNotFound. When style is null, rStyle is removed, and the styles part need not exist. A missing style field returns InvalidField. A missing run returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a run id returns InvalidId. A run inside a text box, note, or comment returns InvalidId.

setParaFormatOp.description: 改段落的对齐、缩进和间距。
setParaFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change a paragraph's alignment, indent, and spacing.
setParaFormatOp.limits: align、left、right、firstLine、hanging、before、after、line、lineRule、 kinsoku、overflowPunct、topLinePunct、autoSpaceDE、autoSpaceDN、borders、shd、tabs 至少给一个。 firstLine 与 hanging 不能同时写成非 null 的数字。不认识的 align / lineRule 报 InvalidField。只改该段自己的 w:pPr，不改 styles.xml。 属性删光后去掉空的 w:ind / w:spacing。
setParaFormatOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of align, left, right, firstLine, hanging, before, after, line, lineRule, kinsoku, overflowPunct, topLinePunct, autoSpaceDE, autoSpaceDN, borders, shd, and tabs. firstLine and hanging cannot both be written as non-null numbers. An unrecognized align or lineRule returns InvalidField. Only that paragraph's own w:pPr is changed; styles.xml is not changed. After the attributes are all removed, an empty w:ind or w:spacing is removed.

setRunFormatOp.description: 改一段文字的字体、颜色和字号。
setRunFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change the font, color, and size of a run of text.
setRunFormatOp.limits: bold、italic、underline、sz、color、font、eastAsiaFont、em、eastAsianLayout、highlight、strike、dstrike、vertAlign、spacing、kern、scale 至少给一个。只改被点名的那一个 w:r 的 w:rPr，不拆 run，不改 styles.xml。
setRunFormatOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of bold, italic, underline, sz, color, font, eastAsiaFont, em, eastAsianLayout, highlight, strike, dstrike, vertAlign, spacing, kern, and scale. Only w:rPr on the named w:r is changed. The run is not split, and styles.xml is not changed.

setPageBackgroundOp.limits: 缺 color、不是字符串也不是 null、或非空却不是六位十六进制，报 InvalidField。不写 themeColor。 可选 fill：省略则只改 @w:color，并删掉已有 v:background 与 w:drawing。 fill 必须是对象，字段只认 kind、color、file。kind 必填，只能是 gradient 或 picture。
setPageBackgroundOp.limitsEn: A missing color, a value that is neither a string nor null, or a non-empty value that is not six hex digits, returns InvalidField. themeColor is not written. fill is optional: if it is omitted, only @w:color is changed, and any existing v:background and w:drawing are deleted. fill must be an object, and the only fields accepted are kind, color, and file. kind is required and can only be gradient or picture.

setPageBordersOp.limits: enabled: false 与其它字段不能同时出现。其余字段至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。边对象必须有 val。 val 认 ECMA-376 ST_Border 全套（含 apples 等艺术型）。不认识的令牌报 InvalidField。JSON 不要 art 字段，出现则报 UnknownField。 sz 为非负整数（八分之一磅）。space 为非负整数（磅）。color 为 auto 或六位十六进制。 不认识的 offsetFrom / display / zOrder，或非法 color，报 InvalidField。
setPageBordersOp.limitsEn: enabled: false cannot appear together with other fields. Provide at least one of the remaining fields, otherwise InvalidField. A border object must have val. val accepts the full ECMA-376 ST_Border set, including art borders such as apples. An unrecognized token returns InvalidField. Do not put an art field in the JSON; if it is present, UnknownField is returned. sz is a non-negative integer in eighths of a point. space is a non-negative integer in points. color is auto or six hex digits. An unrecognized offsetFrom, display, or zOrder, or an illegal color, returns InvalidField.

setFormProtOp.descriptionEn: Change form protection on one section.
setFormProtOp.limits: 节不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。 setProtection 打开窗体仍给各节写 formProt；随后可用本 op 把某节改成 val=0。
setFormProtOp.limitsEn: A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not section:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField. When setProtection turns forms protection on, it still writes formProt on every section; this op can then set one section to val=0.

insertEditRangeOp.description: 划出一块允许编辑的区域。
insertEditRangeOp.descriptionEn: Mark a range that may be edited.
insertEditRangeOp.limits: edGrp 与 ed 不能同时给。两个都不给时写 w:edGrp="everyone"。不认识的 edGrp 或空 ed 报 InvalidField。 在该段 w:pPr 之后插入 w:permStart，在段末插入配对 w:permEnd。w:id 取该部件已有 perm 标记里最大整数加 1，至少为 0。 框内、注内、批注内的段落，以及非段落 id，报 InvalidId。找不到段落报 IdNotFound。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertEditRangeOp.limitsEn: edGrp and ed cannot both be given. When neither is given, write w:edGrp="everyone". An unrecognized edGrp or an empty ed returns InvalidField. Insert w:permStart after that paragraph's w:pPr, and insert the matching w:permEnd at the end of the paragraph. w:id is one greater than the largest integer among existing perm marks in that part, and at least 0. A paragraph inside a text box, note, or comment, and an id that is not a paragraph id, return InvalidId. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteEditRangeOp.description: 删掉该对 permStart / permEnd，不删文字。
deleteEditRangeOp.descriptionEn: Delete that permStart / permEnd pair without deleting the text.
deleteEditRangeOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 perm:{n} 报 InvalidId。xlsx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteEditRangeOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not perm:{n} returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setThemeFmtOp.description: 改主文档 theme 部件 a:fmtScheme 的常用槽。
setThemeFmtOp.descriptionEn: Change the common slots of a:fmtScheme on the main document's theme part.
setThemeFmtOp.limits: 不算主题排版引擎，不把 phClr 展开成 RGB。
setThemeFmtOp.limitsEn: This is not a theme layout engine, and phClr is not expanded to RGB.

setThemeOverrideOp.description: 读写主文档 themeOverride 部件的配色槽。
setThemeOverrideOp.descriptionEn: Read and write the color slots of the main document's themeOverride part.
setThemeOverrideOp.limits: 根元素是 a:themeOverride，配色写在根下 clrScheme。
setThemeOverrideOp.limitsEn: The root element is a:themeOverride, and the colors are written in clrScheme under the root.

docxSetThemeColorsOp.description: 改主文档 theme 部件的 a:clrScheme 槽位，以及配色方案名、theme 根名。
docxSetThemeColorsOp.descriptionEn: Change the a:clrScheme slots on the main document's theme part, and the color-scheme name and the theme root name.
docxSetThemeColorsOp.limits: 不改未点名的 fmtScheme 槽。不把段落 / run 上的 themeColor 展开成直接色。
docxSetThemeColorsOp.limitsEn: Unnamed fmtScheme slots are not changed. themeColor on a paragraph or run is not expanded to a direct color.

docxSetThemeFontsOp.description: 改主文档 theme 部件的 a:fontScheme。
docxSetThemeFontsOp.descriptionEn: Change a:fontScheme on the main document's theme part.
docxSetThemeFontsOp.limits: 未点名的 fmtScheme 槽留下。

setThemeExtraSchemesOp.description: 整份替换主文档 theme 部件的 a:extraClrSchemeLst。
setThemeExtraSchemesOp.descriptionEn: Replace a:extraClrSchemeLst on the main document's theme part as a whole.
setThemeExtraSchemesOp.limitsEn: This is not a theme layout engine.

setThemeObjectDefaultsOp.description: 改主文档 theme 部件的 a:objectDefaults。
setThemeObjectDefaultsOp.descriptionEn: Change a:objectDefaults on the main document's theme part.
setThemeObjectDefaultsOp.limits: 不算主题排版引擎，不把 phClr 展开成 RGB。
setThemeObjectDefaultsOp.limitsEn: This is not a theme layout engine, and phClr is not expanded to RGB.

insertAnimOp.description: 给该页对象追加一条预设效果。
insertAnimOp.descriptionEn: Append one preset effect to that slide object.
insertAnimOp.limits: 只写与 PowerPoint 16.0 另存同构的最小 <p:timing> 树，不接受调用方提交的时间轴 JSON。
insertAnimOp.limitsEn: Writes only a minimal <p:timing> tree matching a PowerPoint 16.0 Save As, and does not accept a timeline JSON submitted by the caller.

deleteAnimOp.description: 摘掉该宿主名单上的一条效果。
deleteAnimOp.descriptionEn: Remove one effect from that host's list.

setAnimOp.description: 改该宿主名单上已有一条的 type / trigger / delay / dur / repeat / sound / para / clickOn。
setAnimOp.descriptionEn: Change type / trigger / delay / dur / repeat / sound / para / clickOn on one existing entry in that host's list.
setAnimOp.limits: 不换绑定对象。不接受整棵时间轴 JSON。
setAnimOp.limitsEn: Does not rebind the target object. Does not accept a whole timeline JSON.

moveAnimOp.description: 把该宿主名单上的一条效果挪到新的文档顺序。
moveAnimOp.descriptionEn: Move one effect on that host's list to a new document order.
moveAnimOp.limits: 不改 type，不换绑定对象，不改 delay / dur。不接受整棵时间轴 JSON。
moveAnimOp.limitsEn: Does not change type, does not rebind the target object, and does not change delay / dur. Does not accept a whole timeline JSON.

pptxPresentation.description: 新建演示文稿时的正文，只在 create 里使用。
pptxPresentation.descriptionEn: Body of a new presentation. Use it only with create.
pptxPresentation.limits: 不要把它当成 apply 的补丁。slides 为空则生成一页，该页一个空文本框。某一页 shapes 为空则生成一个空文本框。create 不写画布尺寸，建好后用 setSlideSize。
pptxPresentation.limitsEn: Do not send it as an apply patch. An empty slides array creates one slide with one empty text box. An empty shapes array on a slide creates one empty text box. create does not set the slide size; use setSlideSize after the file exists.

setPicturePosOp.description: 改图片在页面上的位置。
setPicturePosOp.descriptionEn: Change a picture's position on the page.
setPicturePosOp.limits: x 与 y 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。只改被点名的那一侧。写入 p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off。找不到该对象报 IdNotFound。 id 不是合法图 id、视频 id 或音频 id 报 InvalidId。批注内图没有画布坐标。setMedia 仍不改几何。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setPicturePosOp.limitsEn: Provide at least one of x and y, otherwise InvalidField. Only the named side is changed. Writes p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off. A missing object returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a valid picture id, video id, or audio id returns InvalidId. A picture inside a comment has no canvas coordinates. setMedia still does not change geometry. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setChartPosOp.description: 字段与 setPicturePos 相同，id 为 pptx 图表 id。
setChartPosOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPicturePos. id is a pptx chart id.
setChartPosOp.limits: 写入 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:off。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setChartPosOp.limitsEn: Writes p:xfrm/a:off on the graphicFrame. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSmartArtPosOp.description: 字段与 setPicturePos 相同，id 为 pptx 图示 id。
setSmartArtPosOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPicturePos. id is a pptx SmartArt id.
setSmartArtPosOp.limits: 写入 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:off。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSmartArtPosOp.limitsEn: Writes p:xfrm/a:off on the graphicFrame. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

pptxInsertModel3dOp.description: 把本地 GLB 作为 3D 模型写入目标幻灯片或备注页。
pptxInsertModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Write a local GLB as a 3D model on the target slide or notes page.
pptxInsertModel3dOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不栅格化模型。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。不写 <p:timing>。
pptxInsertModel3dOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. The model is not rasterized. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder. Does not write <p:timing>.

pptxReplaceModel3dOp.description: 换 GLB 字节，保留 graphicFrame 与关系 id。
