pptxReplaceModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Replace the GLB bytes. Keep the graphicFrame and the relationship id.
pptxReplaceModel3dOp.limits: 海报仍写成 1×1 PNG。不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / docx 见各自分册。
pptxReplaceModel3dOp.limitsEn: The poster stays a 1×1 PNG. Position and size are unchanged. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. See the xlsx and docx books.

pptxDeleteModel3dOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。摘整棵 AlternateContent。 清掉无人引用的关系与 GLB / 海报。xlsx / docx 见各自分册。
pptxDeleteModel3dOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. Remove the whole AlternateContent. Drop unreferenced relationships and the GLB / poster. See the xlsx and docx books.

setModel3dPosOp.description: 字段与 setPicturePos 相同，id 必须是 pptx 3D 模型 id。
setModel3dPosOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPicturePos. id must be a pptx 3D model id.
setModel3dPosOp.limits: 写入 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:off。Fallback 海报 p:pic 同步改位置。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setModel3dPosOp.limitsEn: Writes p:xfrm/a:off on the graphicFrame. The Fallback poster p:pic moves with it. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

pptxInsertInkOp.description: 把本地 InkML 作为一笔墨迹写入目标幻灯片、备注页、母版或版式。
pptxInsertInkOp.descriptionEn: Write a local InkML file as one ink stroke on the target slide, notes page, master, or layout.
pptxInsertInkOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不把笔画放进树。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。不写 <p:timing>。位置是画布 EMU。
pptxInsertInkOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. Strokes are not placed in the tree. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder. Does not write <p:timing>. Position is in canvas EMU.

pptxReplaceInkOp.description: 换 InkML 字节，保留 contentPart 与关系 id。
pptxReplaceInkOp.descriptionEn: Replace the InkML bytes. Keep the contentPart and the relationship id.
pptxReplaceInkOp.limits: 不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。
pptxReplaceInkOp.limitsEn: Position and size are unchanged. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId.

pptxDeleteInkOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。摘整棵 AlternateContent。 清掉无人引用的关系、InkML 与海报。按 deleteShape 同一套规则清该 cNvPr/@id 的 timing tgtEl。
pptxDeleteInkOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId. Remove the whole AlternateContent. Drop unreferenced relationships, InkML, and the poster. Clear the timing tgtEl for that cNvPr/@id by the same rules as deleteShape.

pptxSetInkSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 pptx 一侧相同。
pptxSetInkSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the pptx side of setPictureSize.
pptxSetInkSizeOp.limits: id 必须是墨迹 id。写入 p14:xfrm/a:ext。Fallback 海报 p:pic 同步改尺寸。对图 id 发此 op、对墨迹 id 发 setPictureSize 仍报 InvalidId。xlsx 用 setInkSize 改单元格锚点，见 xlsx 分册。
pptxSetInkSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an ink id. Writes p14:xfrm/a:ext. The Fallback poster p:pic is resized with it. This op on a picture id, or setPictureSize on an ink id, still returns InvalidId. On xlsx, use setInkSize to change the cell anchor; see the xlsx book.

pptxInsertOleOp.description: 把本地文件作为嵌入对象写入目标宿主。
pptxInsertOleOp.descriptionEn: Embed a local file as an OLE object on the target host.
pptxInsertOleOp.limits: 不在库里启动 OLE 服务器，不生成真实预览图（写入一张最小 PNG 占位）。不写 <p:timing>。不进批注、备注母版、讲义。
pptxInsertOleOp.limitsEn: This library does not start an OLE server and does not draw a real preview (it writes a minimal PNG placeholder). Does not write <p:timing>. Not allowed in comments, the notes master, or handouts.

pptxDeleteOleOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 OLE id 报 InvalidId。摘整棵 graphicFrame（含 AlternateContent）。两支都扫 r:id（预览只在 Fallback）。 清掉无人引用的关系与 embeddings / 预览媒体。按 deleteShape 同一套规则清该 graphicFrame cNvPr/@id 的 timing tgtEl。 xlsx 见 [xlsx 分册](json-contract-xlsx.md#deleteole)。
pptxDeleteOleOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an OLE id returns InvalidId. Remove the whole graphicFrame (including AlternateContent). Both branches are scanned for r:id (the preview is only in Fallback). Drop unreferenced relationships and embeddings / preview media. Clear the timing tgtEl for that graphicFrame cNvPr/@id by the same rules as deleteShape. For xlsx, see json-contract-xlsx.md#deleteole.

pptxSetOleSizeOp.description: 写入 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:ext、Choice 与 Fallback 两支 p:oleObj 的 imgW / imgH，以及 Fallback 预览 p:pic 的 a:ext。
pptxSetOleSizeOp.descriptionEn: Writes p:xfrm/a:ext on the graphicFrame, imgW / imgH on both the Choice and Fallback p:oleObj, and a:ext on the Fallback preview p:pic.
pptxSetOleSizeOp.limits: 不改 a:off，不改 embeddings，不启动 OLE 服务器。出现 to 报 InvalidField。对页 id 或图 id 发此 op 报 InvalidId。找不到报 IdNotFound。docx 见 [docx 分册](json-contract-docx.md#setolesize)。
pptxSetOleSizeOp.limitsEn: Does not change a:off, does not change embeddings, and does not start an OLE server. to returns InvalidField. A slide id or a picture id returns InvalidId. A missing id returns IdNotFound. For docx, see json-contract-docx.md#setolesize.

setInkPosOp.limits: id 必须是墨迹 id。写入 p14:xfrm/a:off。Fallback 海报 p:pic 同步改位置。x 与 y 一个都不给报 InvalidField。显式 0 可以。xlsx 不认此 op。
setInkPosOp.limitsEn: id must be an ink id. Writes p14:xfrm/a:off. The Fallback poster p:pic moves with it. Giving neither x nor y returns InvalidField. An explicit 0 is allowed. xlsx does not accept this op.

pptxInsertMathOp.description: 把一条线性公式写入目标幻灯片或备注页。
pptxInsertMathOp.descriptionEn: Write one linear formula on the target slide or notes page.
pptxInsertMathOp.limits: 不进 shapes。不实现排版引擎。不写 <p:timing>。
pptxInsertMathOp.limitsEn: It is not a shape. This library does not implement a layout engine. Does not write <p:timing>.

pptxSetMathOp.limits: 出现 expr / kind 报 InvalidField。空 text 报 InvalidField。出现 x / y / cx / cy 报未知字段。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx / docx 见各自分册。
pptxSetMathOp.limitsEn: expr or kind returns InvalidField. Empty text returns InvalidField. x / y / cx / cy returns UnknownField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a formula-box id returns InvalidId. See the xlsx and docx books.

pptxDeleteMathOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。摘整棵 AlternateContent。 海报无人引用则删。xlsx / docx 见各自分册。
pptxDeleteMathOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a formula-box id returns InvalidId. Remove the whole AlternateContent. Delete the poster if nothing references it. See the xlsx and docx books.

pptxSetMathSizeOp.limits: id 必须是公式框 id。写入 Choice 里该 p:sp 的 p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext。没有 xfrm 则补。不改 Fallback。cx 与 cy 一个都不给报 InvalidField。对形状 id 发此 op、对公式框 id 发 setShapeSize 仍报 InvalidId。docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。xlsx 见 [xlsx 分册](json-contract-xlsx.md#setmathsize)。
pptxSetMathSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be a formula-box id. Write p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext on that p:sp inside Choice. If xfrm is missing, add one. Do not change Fallback. Giving neither cx nor cy returns InvalidField. This op on a shape id, or setShapeSize on a formula-box id, still returns InvalidId. This op on docx returns InvalidField. For xlsx, see json-contract-xlsx.md#setmathsize.

setMathPosOp.limits: id 必须是公式框 id。写入 Choice 里该 p:sp 的 p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off。没有 xfrm 则补。不改 Fallback。x 与 y 一个都不给报 InvalidField。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。对公式框 id 发 setShapePos 仍报 InvalidId。
setMathPosOp.limitsEn: id must be a formula-box id. Write p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off on that p:sp inside Choice. If xfrm is missing, add one. Do not change Fallback. Giving neither x nor y returns InvalidField. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField. setShapePos on a formula-box id still returns InvalidId.

insertShapeOp.description: 往幻灯片、备注页、母版或版式插入一个带 p:txBody 的形状。
insertShapeOp.descriptionEn: Insert a shape that has p:txBody on a slide, notes page, master, or layout.
insertShapeOp.limits: 缺省 prst 为矩形文本框。不抄版式占位符，不写 <p:timing>。往母版 / 版式插时写出没有 p:ph 的装饰形，不把该 p:sp 抄进各页。插占位符请用 insertPlaceholder。
insertShapeOp.limitsEn: The default prst is a rectangle text box. Layout placeholders are not copied, and <p:timing> is not written. Inserting on a master or layout writes a decorative shape with no p:ph, and that p:sp is not copied onto slides. To insert a placeholder, use insertPlaceholder.

insertConnectorOp.description: 往幻灯片、备注页、母版或版式插入一条连接线（p:cxnSp）。
insertConnectorOp.descriptionEn: Insert a connector (p:cxnSp) on a slide, notes page, master, or layout.
insertConnectorOp.limits: 不算自动绕障碍。省略 start / end 时不写 a:stCxn / a:endCxn。
insertConnectorOp.limitsEn: Does not route around obstacles automatically. When start / end are omitted, a:stCxn / a:endCxn are not written.

deleteConnectorOp.limits: 找不到该连接线报 IdNotFound。id 不是连接线 id 报 InvalidId。删掉对应 p:cxnSp。 若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。删组合内连接线后若组合空了，把空 p:grpSp 一并摘掉。不改其它对象的 cNvPr/@id。 按被删连接线的 cNvPr/@id 清掉本页 <p:timing> 里对应的 p:tgtEl。docx 见 [docx 分册](json-contract-docx.md#deleteconnector)。
deleteConnectorOp.limitsEn: A missing connector returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a connector id returns InvalidId. Delete the matching p:cxnSp. If it sits in the Choice of an mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. After deleting a connector inside a group, if the group is empty, remove the empty p:grpSp too. cNvPr/@id of other objects is unchanged. Clear the matching p:tgtEl in this slide's <p:timing> for the deleted connector's cNvPr/@id. For docx, see json-contract-docx.md#deleteconnector.

groupShapesOp.description: 把同一页 spTree 上至少两个直接子对象包进一个新 p:grpSp。
groupShapesOp.descriptionEn: Wrap at least two direct children of the same slide's spTree into a new p:grpSp.
groupShapesOp.limits: 组合本身不进 inspect 树。
groupShapesOp.limitsEn: The group itself is not placed in the inspect tree.

ungroupOp.description: 解开某个成员所在的 p:grpSp，子节点抬回父节点。
ungroupOp.descriptionEn: Ungroup the p:grpSp that contains a member, and lift the children back onto the parent.
ungroupOp.limits: 组合本身没有 inspect id。
ungroupOp.limitsEn: The group itself has no inspect id.

deleteShapeOp.limits: 找不到该形状报 IdNotFound。id 不是形状 id 报 InvalidId。对母版、版式、备注母版或讲义占位符 id 发本 op 报 InvalidId。 插删占位符请用 insertPlaceholder / deletePlaceholder。对备注页、备注母版或讲义上占位符 p:ph/@type 为 sldImg 的形状发本 op 报 InvalidField，不写文件。 删掉对应 p:sp。若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。
deleteShapeOp.limitsEn: A missing shape returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a shape id returns InvalidId. A master, layout, notes-master, or handout placeholder id returns InvalidId for this op. To insert or delete a placeholder, use insertPlaceholder / deletePlaceholder. This op on a shape whose placeholder p:ph/@type is sldImg, on a notes page, notes master, or handout, returns InvalidField, and the file is not written. Delete the matching p:sp. If it sits in the Choice of an mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent.

setShapePosOp.description: 写入该 p:sp 或 p:cxnSp 的 p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off。
setShapePosOp.descriptionEn: Writes p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:off on that p:sp or p:cxnSp.
setShapePosOp.limits: 没有 xfrm 则补。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是形状 id 也不是连接线 id 报 InvalidId。x 与 y 一个都不给报 InvalidField。对 sldImg 占位符报 InvalidField。母版 / 版式占位符与装饰形只改对应 slideMaster / slideLayout 部件，不改各页 XML。备注母版只改 notesMaster 部件。讲义只改 handoutMaster 部件。
setShapePosOp.limitsEn: If xfrm is missing, add one. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a shape id nor a connector id returns InvalidId. Giving neither x nor y returns InvalidField. An sldImg placeholder returns InvalidField. Master and layout placeholders and decorative shapes are changed only in the matching slideMaster or slideLayout part, not in each slide's XML. The notes master changes only the notesMaster part. Handouts change only the handoutMaster part.

setShapeSizeOp.description: 写入该 p:sp 或 p:cxnSp 的 p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext。
setShapeSizeOp.descriptionEn: Writes p:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext on that p:sp or p:cxnSp.
setShapeSizeOp.limits: 没有 xfrm 则补。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是形状 id 也不是连接线 id 报 InvalidId。cx 与 cy 一个都不给报 InvalidField。对 sldImg 占位符报 InvalidField。母版 / 版式占位符与装饰形只改对应 slideMaster / slideLayout 部件。备注母版只改 notesMaster 部件。讲义只改 handoutMaster 部件。对已组合的子对象只改该子 xfrm，不重算父组合框。
setShapeSizeOp.limitsEn: If xfrm is missing, add one. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a shape id nor a connector id returns InvalidId. Giving neither cx nor cy returns InvalidField. An sldImg placeholder returns InvalidField. Master and layout placeholders and decorative shapes are changed only in the matching slideMaster or slideLayout part. The notes master changes only the notesMaster part. Handouts change only the handoutMaster part. For a child that is already grouped, change only that child's xfrm. Do not recompute the parent group box.

setShapeFillOp.description: 写入形状填充：纯色、无填充、渐变或图片。
setShapeFillOp.descriptionEn: Writes a shape fill: solid, none, gradient, or picture.
setShapeFillOp.limits: color 与 fill 恰好一个。alpha 为 0 到 100000。blip 不能带 alpha。找不到报 IdNotFound。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setShapeFillOp.limitsEn: color and fill are mutually exclusive and one is required. alpha is 0 to 100000. blip cannot take alpha. A missing id returns IdNotFound. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setShapeFormatOp.description: 改 DrawingML 文本框的字号、字色、字填充、字轮廓、加粗、斜体、下划线、中英文字体、水平对齐、框内垂直锚点、段落间距与字符间距。
setShapeFormatOp.descriptionEn: Change a DrawingML text box's font size, font color, text fill, text outline, bold, italic, underline, Latin and East Asian fonts, horizontal alignment, vertical anchor inside the box, paragraph spacing, and character spacing.
setShapeFormatOp.limits: 不改可见字。不要用 Word 的半磅字号。
setShapeFormatOp.limitsEn: Visible text is not changed. Do not use Word's half-point font size.

setShapeLineOp.limits: color 为 null 时写成 a:ln/a:noFill；此时出现 width 报 InvalidField。缺 color 或非法十六进制报 InvalidField。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是形状 id 也不是连接线 id 报 InvalidId。对母版或版式占位符 id 发本 op 报 InvalidId。对 sldImg 占位符报 InvalidField。母版 / 版式装饰形只改对应 slideMaster / slideLayout 部件，不改各页 XML。
setShapeLineOp.limitsEn: A null color is written as a:ln/a:noFill. width then returns InvalidField. A missing color, or an illegal hexadecimal value, returns InvalidField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a shape id nor a connector id returns InvalidId. A master or layout placeholder id returns InvalidId for this op. An sldImg placeholder returns InvalidField. Decorative shapes on a master or layout are changed only in the matching slideMaster or slideLayout part, not in each slide's XML.

setShapeGeomOp.description: 把带 p:txBody 的 p:sp 的 a:prstGeom 或已有 a:custGeom 整份换成自定义路径。
setShapeGeomOp.descriptionEn: Replace the whole a:prstGeom, or an existing a:custGeom, of a p:sp that has p:txBody with a custom path.
setShapeGeomOp.limitsEn: The group box is not recomputed.

setConnectorOp.description: 改一条已有连接线的起点 / 终点绑定。
setConnectorOp.descriptionEn: Change the start and end bindings of an existing connector.
setConnectorOp.limits: 不算自动绕障碍。不改画布坐标。
setConnectorOp.limitsEn: Does not route around obstacles automatically. Canvas coordinates are unchanged.

insertVideoOp.description: 往幻灯片、备注页或幻灯片母版 / 版式插入一段内嵌视频。
insertVideoOp.descriptionEn: Insert an embedded video on a slide, a notes page, or a slide master or layout.
insertVideoOp.limitsEn: Does not decode the media or extract frames. Does not write <p:timing>.

insertAudioOp.description: 往幻灯片、备注页或幻灯片母版 / 版式插入一段内嵌音频。
insertAudioOp.descriptionEn: Insert an embedded audio clip on a slide, a notes page, or a slide master or layout.
insertAudioOp.limits: 字段与 insertVideo 相同，op 为 "insertAudio"，file 按文件头认 WAV（RIFF…WAVE），写出 /ppt/media/mediaN.wav，内容类型 audio/x-wav。p:nvPr 写 a:audioFile/@r:link 与 p14:media/@r:embed。ISO 关系 Type 以 /audio 结尾。缺尺寸则用 609600 × 609600。其余规则与 insertVideo 相同。文件不是 WAV 报 InvalidField。
insertAudioOp.limitsEn: Same fields as insertVideo. op is "insertAudio". file is recognized as WAV from the header (RIFF…WAVE) and written to /ppt/media/mediaN.wav with content type audio/x-wav. p:nvPr gets a:audioFile/@r:link and p14:media/@r:embed. The ISO relationship Type ends with /audio. If size is omitted, use 609600 × 609600. The other rules match insertVideo. A file that is not WAV returns InvalidField.

setMediaOp.description: 改已有内嵌视频 / 音频的裁剪、书签与字幕轨。
setMediaOp.descriptionEn: Change the crop, bookmarks, and caption tracks of an existing embedded video or audio clip.
setMediaOp.limits: 不换媒体文件。不写 <p:timing>。不写 <p14:fade>。
setMediaOp.limitsEn: The media file is not replaced. Does not write <p:timing>. Does not write <p14:fade>.

deleteMediaOp.descriptionEn: Delete a video or an audio clip.
deleteMediaOp.limits: 找不到该对象报 IdNotFound。id 不是视频 id 也不是音频 id 报 InvalidId。摘掉对应 p:pic。 该 p:pic 上的 media / video / audio / 海报 image 关系若本页 XML 里无人引用则删除；对应 /ppt/media/… 若重新解析后无人引用则删掉。 清掉 <p:timing> 里对应该 cNvPr/@id 的 p:tgtEl，规则与 deleteShape 相同；未点名对象的 timing 留下，不要整节无故删掉 <p:timing>。不改未点名的 p:pic。
deleteMediaOp.limitsEn: A missing object returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a video id nor an audio id returns InvalidId. Remove the matching p:pic. media / video / audio / poster image relationships on that p:pic are deleted when nothing else in this slide's XML references them. The matching /ppt/media/… part is deleted if nothing references it after relationships are resolved again. Clear the p:tgtEl in <p:timing> for that cNvPr/@id, by the same rules as deleteShape. Timing for objects you did not name stays. Do not delete the whole <p:timing> without cause. p:pic elements you did not name are unchanged.

insertCustomShowOp.description: 在 p:custShowLst 里追加或插入一条自定义放映。
insertCustomShowOp.descriptionEn: Append or insert one custom show in p:custShowLst.
insertCustomShowOp.limits: 不改各页 XML。不实现放映引擎。不改 presProps 的 showPr（放映设置用 setShowPr）。
insertCustomShowOp.limitsEn: Slide XML is unchanged. This library does not implement a slideshow engine. showPr on presProps is unchanged (slideshow settings use setShowPr).

setCustomShowOp.limits: name 与 slides 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。找不到该条报 IdNotFound。id 不是自定义放映 id 报 InvalidId。未点名的 @id 与 extLst 留下。 xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setCustomShowOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of name and slides, or the op returns InvalidField. A missing entry returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a custom-show id returns InvalidId. Unnamed @id and extLst stay. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

deleteCustomShowOp.limits: 找不到该条报 IdNotFound。id 不是自定义放映 id 报 InvalidId。摘掉该 p:custShow。删光后去掉空的 custShowLst。不改各页 XML，不改 sldIdLst。 xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteCustomShowOp.limitsEn: A missing entry returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a custom-show id returns InvalidId. Remove that p:custShow. When the last one is gone, remove the empty custShowLst. Slide XML is unchanged, and sldIdLst is unchanged. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

insertZoomOp.description: 把幻灯片缩放、节缩放或摘要缩放写入目标宿主。
insertZoomOp.descriptionEn: Write a slide zoom, a section zoom, or a summary zoom on the target host.
insertZoomOp.limits: 不实现放映跳转，不写 <p:timing>，不生成真实预览图（写入一张最小 PNG 占位）。不进批注、备注母版、讲义。
insertZoomOp.limitsEn: Does not implement slideshow jumps, does not write <p:timing>, and does not draw a real preview (it writes a minimal PNG placeholder). Not allowed in comments, the notes master, or handouts.

deleteZoomOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 Zoom id 报 InvalidId。摘整段 AlternateContent（或无 AC 时的 graphicFrame）。两支都扫关系 id。 清掉无人引用的预览媒体与指向目标页的 slide 关系。按 deleteShape 同一套规则清该 graphicFrame cNvPr/@id 的 timing tgtEl。xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteZoomOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a Zoom id returns InvalidId. Remove the whole AlternateContent (or the graphicFrame when there is no AC). Both branches are scanned for relationship ids. Drop unreferenced preview media and slide relationships that point at the target slide. Clear the timing tgtEl for that graphicFrame cNvPr/@id by the same rules as deleteShape. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

setZoomOp.limits: target、targets、file、几何至少给一类，否则报 InvalidField。只给几何也合法。target 与 targets 同时出现报 InvalidField。 cx 与 cy 只出现一侧报 InvalidField。 targets 为空或含重复节报 InvalidField。空 file 报 InvalidField。读不到 file 报 Io。不是该格式认的图片报 InvalidField。 SVG 只写入 PNG 海报，不写 svgBlip。
setZoomOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of target, targets, file, and geometry, or the op returns InvalidField. Geometry alone is valid. target together with targets returns InvalidField. Giving only one of cx and cy returns InvalidField. An empty targets list, or one that contains a duplicate section, returns InvalidField. An empty file returns InvalidField. A file that cannot be read returns Io. A picture this format does not accept returns InvalidField. SVG is written only as a PNG poster. svgBlip is not written.

setShowPrOp.limits: 不实现放映引擎，不改自定义放映名单，不改 prnPr。
setShowPrOp.limitsEn: Does not implement a slideshow engine, does not change the custom-show list, and does not change prnPr.

pptxInsertFieldOp.description: 往幻灯片文本形状最后一段、a:endParaRPr 之前插入一个 a:fld（ECMA-376 §21.1.2.2.4）。
pptxInsertFieldOp.descriptionEn: Insert an a:fld (ECMA-376 §21.1.2.2.4) before a:endParaRPr in the last paragraph of a slide text shape.
pptxInsertFieldOp.limits: 不写 a:pPr。不在库里求值，不刷新缓存。
pptxInsertFieldOp.limitsEn: a:pPr is not written. This library does not evaluate the field and does not refresh the cache.

pptxSetFieldOp.limits: type 与 text 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。改 type 不改 GUID。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 pptx 域 id 报 InvalidId。 xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。docx 仍改 instr。
pptxSetFieldOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of type and text, or the op returns InvalidField. Changing type does not change the GUID. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a pptx field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. docx still changes instr.

pptxDeleteFieldOp.description: keep 为 result：把 a:fld 换成 a:r，抄 rPr 与缓存 a:t。
pptxDeleteFieldOp.descriptionEn: When keep is result, replace a:fld with a:r, copying rPr and the cached a:t.
pptxDeleteFieldOp.limits: keep 为 instr：把 a:t 写成 type 字符串。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 pptx 域 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
pptxDeleteFieldOp.limitsEn: When keep is instr, write a:t as the type string. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a pptx field id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

setNotesTextOp.description: 只改备注页上占位符 p:ph/@type 为 body 的那个文本框。
setNotesTextOp.descriptionEn: Change only the text box on the notes page whose placeholder p:ph/@type is body.
setNotesTextOp.limits: 文档顺序中第一个 body 占位符命中。找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是上述两种报 InvalidId。
setNotesTextOp.limitsEn: The first body placeholder in document order is the one that matches. A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not one of those two kinds returns InvalidId.

insertSlideOp.limits: pptx：id 不是 pptx:presentation 报 InvalidId。after 找不到报 IdNotFound；不是页 id 报 InvalidId。 新建空白幻灯片部件（p:spTree 只有组合框，不抄版式占位符，不写 <p:timing>），关系指向一份已有 slideLayout：优先抄 after 那一页的版式关系，省略 after 则抄最后一页；该页没有版式关系则用第一份幻灯片母版的第一份版式。 找不到任何版式报 InvalidField。p:sldId/@id 取已有最大 ST_SlideId 加 1，至少为 256。
insertSlideOp.limitsEn: pptx: an id that is not pptx:presentation returns InvalidId. A missing after returns IdNotFound. An after that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. Create a blank slide part (p:spTree contains only the group shape, layout placeholders are not copied, and <p:timing> is not written). The relationship points at an existing slideLayout: prefer the layout relationship of the after slide; if after is omitted, copy the last slide's; if that slide has no layout relationship, use the first layout of the first slide master. If no layout can be found, the op returns InvalidField. p:sldId/@id is the largest existing ST_SlideId plus 1, and at least 256.

deleteSlideOp.limits: 找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。删掉演示文稿里最后一页报 InvalidField，不写文件。 去掉 sldIdLst 表项、presentation 关系、内容类型，以及该页部件及其 .rels。该页备注 notesSlide、现代批注部件、图表 / embedding / diagram / 媒体若再无人引用则删。 不删幻灯片版式、母版、主题、notesMaster。
deleteSlideOp.limitsEn: A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. Deleting the last slide in the presentation returns InvalidField, and the file is not written. Remove the sldIdLst entry, the presentation relationship, the content type, and that slide part and its .rels. That slide's notesSlide, modern comment part, and chart / embedding / diagram / media are deleted if nothing else references them. Slide layouts, masters, the theme, and notesMaster are not deleted.

moveSlideOp.description: 调整一张幻灯片的顺序。
moveSlideOp.limits: 找不到该页或 after 报 IdNotFound。id / after 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。after 与 id 是同一页报 InvalidField。已经在目标位置则空操作。 只改 presentation.xml 里 sldIdLst 子元素顺序，以及若有 p14:sectionLst 则按同一套顺序把该 ST_SlideId 挪到 after 那一页所在节（移到最前则进第一节）。 不改部件路径、p:sldId/@id 或关系 id。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
moveSlideOp.limitsEn: A missing slide or a missing after returns IdNotFound. An id or after that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. after equal to id returns InvalidField. If it is already at the target position, the op is a no-op. Only the order of sldIdLst children in presentation.xml changes. If p14:sectionLst is present, move that ST_SlideId, by the same order, into the section that contains the after slide (moving it to the front puts it in the first section). Part paths, p:sldId/@id, and relationship ids are unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideHiddenOp.description: 隐藏或显示一张幻灯片。
setSlideHiddenOp.limits: 找不到该页报 IdNotFound。id 不是页 id 报 InvalidId。缺 hidden 报 InvalidField。true 在该页 p:sld 上写 show="0"。 false 去掉 show。已经是目标可见性则空操作。允许把全部页藏起来。不改 sldIdLst。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlideHiddenOp.limitsEn: A missing slide returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a slide id returns InvalidId. A missing hidden returns InvalidField. true writes show="0" on that slide's p:sld. false removes show. If visibility is already the target, the op is a no-op. Hiding every slide is allowed. sldIdLst is unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideLayoutOp.description: 只改该页 .rels 里指向 slideLayout 的关系。
setSlideLayoutOp.descriptionEn: Change only the relationship in that slide's .rels that points at a slideLayout.
setSlideLayoutOp.limits: 不改幻灯片 XML，不删用户形状，不把版式占位符抄进页，不写 <p:timing>。
setSlideLayoutOp.limitsEn: Slide XML is unchanged. User shapes are not deleted. Layout placeholders are not copied onto the slide. <p:timing> is not written.

insertLayoutOp.description: 在已有母版上追加一份空白版式。
insertLayoutOp.descriptionEn: Append a blank layout to an existing master.
insertLayoutOp.limits: 不抄占位符，不算母版排版引擎。
insertLayoutOp.limitsEn: Placeholders are not copied. This is not a master layout engine.

deleteLayoutOp.limits: 找不到该版式报 IdNotFound。id 不是版式 id 报 InvalidId。任何页的 layoutId 指向它则报 InvalidField，未写文件。该母版只剩这一份版式报 InvalidField。 摘掉母版 p:sldLayoutIdLst 对应项、母版 .rels 对应关系、该 slideLayout 部件及其 .rels、内容类型 Override。不改各页 XML，不改未点名版式。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteLayoutOp.limitsEn: A missing layout returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a layout id returns InvalidId. If any slide's layoutId points at it, the op returns InvalidField and the file is not written. If that master has only this layout left, the op returns InvalidField. Remove the matching entry in the master's p:sldLayoutIdLst, the matching relationship in the master's .rels, that slideLayout part and its .rels, and the content-type Override. Slide XML is unchanged, and layouts you did not name are unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

insertPlaceholderOp.description: 往母版或版式插入一个带 p:ph 与 p:txBody 的占位符。
insertPlaceholderOp.descriptionEn: Insert a placeholder that has p:ph and p:txBody on a master or layout.
insertPlaceholderOp.limits: 装饰形请用 insertShape。不写 theme p:style，不写 a16:creationId。可写 title、body、ctrTitle、subTitle、dt、ftr、sldNum、hdr、obj、chart、tbl、pic、media，以及备注母版上的 sldImg。
insertPlaceholderOp.limitsEn: For a decorative shape, use insertShape. Do not write a theme p:style or a16:creationId. Writable types are title, body, ctrTitle, subTitle, dt, ftr, sldNum, hdr, obj, chart, tbl, pic, media, and sldImg on the notes master.

deletePlaceholderOp.limits: 找不到该占位符报 IdNotFound。id 不是占位符 id 报 InvalidId。对幻灯片形状 id 发本 op 报 InvalidId。只删该 p:sp。 若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。组合里的占位符同样摘掉；组合空了则把空 p:grpSp 一并摘掉。 不改各页 XML，不改未点名占位符的 cNvPr/@id。不把备注母版 / 讲义的删除抄进 notesSlide 或各页。 docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deletePlaceholderOp.limitsEn: A missing placeholder returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a placeholder id returns InvalidId. A slide shape id returns InvalidId for this op. Only that p:sp is deleted. If it sits in the Choice of an mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. A placeholder inside a group is removed the same way. If the group is then empty, the empty p:grpSp is removed too. Slide XML is unchanged, and cNvPr/@id of placeholders you did not name is unchanged. A delete on the notes master or handout is not copied into notesSlide or onto slides. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

insertMasterOp.description: 抄现有一份母版及其全部版式与 theme 部件，新开 master / layout / theme。
insertMasterOp.descriptionEn: Copy an existing master together with all of its layout and theme parts, and open new master / layout / theme parts.
insertMasterOp.limits: 不生成新的占位符几何，不算母版排版引擎。
insertMasterOp.limitsEn: New placeholder geometry is not generated. This is not a master layout engine.

deleteMasterOp.limits: 找不到该母版报 IdNotFound。id 不是母版 id 报 InvalidId（对 master:{n}/layout:{k} 或占位符 id 也是这条）。最后一份母版报 InvalidField。 任何页仍使用该母版下的版式报 InvalidField，未写文件。摘掉 presentation 的 p:sldMasterId 与对应关系， 以及该母版、其全部版式、仅被它引用的 theme 部件及其 .rels 与内容类型 Override。 不改各页 XML。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteMasterOp.limitsEn: A missing master returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a master id returns InvalidId (a master:{n}/layout:{k} id or a placeholder id returns this same error). The last remaining master returns InvalidField. If any slide still uses a layout under that master, the op returns InvalidField and the file is not written. Remove the presentation's p:sldMasterId and its relationship, plus that master, all of its layouts, theme parts referenced only by it, their .rels, and the content-type Overrides. Slide XML is unchanged. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setSlideSizeOp.limits: 不按新画布重排已有形状，不算排版引擎。不改 p:notesSz。
setSlideSizeOp.limitsEn: Existing shapes are not rearranged onto the new canvas. This is not a layout engine. p:notesSz is unchanged.

setNotesSizeOp.limits: 不按新画布重排已有备注形状，不算排版引擎。不改 p:sldSz。
setNotesSizeOp.limitsEn: Existing notes shapes are not rearranged onto the new canvas. This is not a layout engine. p:sldSz is unchanged.

setHandoutTextOp.description: 改讲义上的页眉页脚文字。
setHandoutTextOp.descriptionEn: Change header and footer text on the handout.
setHandoutTextOp.limits: 四个槽位至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。未点名的槽位留下。id 不是 handout 报 InvalidId。 不要和 setNotesText 混用：本 op 只改 /ppt/handoutMasters/…，不改 notesSlide。 对 handout 容器发 setShapeText / setShapeFormat / insertShape / deleteShape / setShapeFill / setShapeLine / setShapeGeom 报 InvalidId。
setHandoutTextOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of the four slots, or the op returns InvalidField. Slots you did not name stay. An id that is not handout returns InvalidId. Do not mix this with setNotesText: this op changes only /ppt/handoutMasters/…, not notesSlide. setShapeText / setShapeFormat / insertShape / deleteShape / setShapeFill / setShapeLine / setShapeGeom on the handout container returns InvalidId.

insertSlideSectionOp.description: 在 p:sldIdLst 之上写入 p14:sectionLst 分组。
insertSlideSectionOp.descriptionEn: Write a p14:sectionLst grouping over p:sldIdLst.
insertSlideSectionOp.limits: 不改页部件。不写节的 UI 颜色。
insertSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: Slide parts are unchanged. Section UI color is not written.

setSlideSectionNameOp.descriptionEn: Change the name of a slide section.
setSlideSectionNameOp.limits: 找不到该节报 IdNotFound。id 不是节 id 报 InvalidId。只改 p14:section/@name。不改 GUID、不改所含页。xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlideSectionNameOp.limitsEn: A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a section id returns InvalidId. Only p14:section/@name changes. The GUID is unchanged, and the slides in the section are unchanged. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

deleteSlideSectionOp.limits: 找不到该节报 IdNotFound。id 不是节 id 报 InvalidId。页留在 sldIdLst，不删幻灯片部件。该节里的 ST_SlideId 并进前一节（删的是第一节则并进后一节）。 只剩这一节时去掉整份 p14:sectionLst；若该 p:ext 里没有别的子元素则连 p:ext 一起去掉。空的 p:extLst 也去掉。xlsx / docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: A missing section returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a section id returns InvalidId. Slides stay in sldIdLst. Slide parts are not deleted. ST_SlideId values in that section merge into the previous section (if the first section is deleted, they merge into the next one). When only this section remains, remove the whole p14:sectionLst. If that p:ext has no other children, remove p:ext with it. An empty p:extLst is removed too. This op on xlsx / docx returns InvalidField.

setSlideSectionOp.descriptionEn: Move one slide into a section.
setSlideSectionOp.limits: 节必须覆盖 sldIdLst 的一个连续分段。
setSlideSectionOp.limitsEn: A section must cover one contiguous span of sldIdLst.

setTableCellTextOp.description: 改幻灯片 DrawingML 表某一格的可见文字。
setTableCellTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the visible text of one cell in a slide DrawingML table.
setTableCellTextOp.limits: 手术刀规则与 setShapeText 相同，目标是该 a:tc 的 a:txBody，不整格重建。
setTableCellTextOp.limitsEn: The surgical-edit rule matches setShapeText. The target is that a:tc's a:txBody. The cell is not rebuilt as a whole.

setTablePosOp.description: 写入该 p:graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:off。
setTablePosOp.limits: 没有 xfrm 则补。只改画布坐标，不重分配 gridCol/@w 与 tr/@h。找不到报表 IdNotFound。id 不是表 id 报 InvalidId。x 与 y 一个都不给报 InvalidField。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTablePosOp.limitsEn: If xfrm is missing, add one. Only canvas coordinates change. gridCol/@w and tr/@h are not redistributed. A missing table returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a table id returns InvalidId. Giving neither x nor y returns InvalidField. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setTableSizeOp.description: 写入该 p:graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:ext。
setTableSizeOp.limits: 没有 xfrm 则补。只改框尺寸，不算自动列宽，不重分配 a:gridCol/@w 与 a:tr/@h。找不到报表 IdNotFound。id 不是表 id 报 InvalidId。cx 与 cy 一个都不给报 InvalidField。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTableSizeOp.limitsEn: If xfrm is missing, add one. Only the frame size changes. Column width is not calculated automatically, and a:gridCol/@w and a:tr/@h are not redistributed. A missing table returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a table id returns InvalidId. Giving neither cx nor cy returns InvalidField. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField.

setTableColWidthsOp.limits: 没有网格则补 a:tblGrid。不改 p:xfrm。不改各格 tcW。找不到报表 IdNotFound。id 不是表 id 报 InvalidId。缺 cols、不是数组、长度对不上 colCount、或某项不是正整数报 InvalidField。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。不要复用 Word 的 setTableWidth（单位是 twip）。不要复用 xlsx 的 setColWidth。
setTableColWidthsOp.limitsEn: If there is no grid, add a:tblGrid. p:xfrm is unchanged. Each cell's tcW is unchanged. A missing table returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a table id returns InvalidId. A missing cols, a value that is not an array, a length that does not match colCount, or an item that is not a positive integer returns InvalidField. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField. Do not reuse Word setTableWidth (the unit is twip). Do not reuse xlsx setColWidth.

setTableTrHeightOp.limits: 不改框 p:xfrm。找不到该行报 IdNotFound。id 不是行 id 报 InvalidId。缺 h、或不是正整数报 InvalidField。a:tr/@h 必填，h: null 报 InvalidField。inspect 缺 @h 仍报 null。docx / xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。不要复用 Word 的 setTableRowHeight（单位是 twip）。不要复用 xlsx 的 setRowHeight。
setTableTrHeightOp.limitsEn: The frame's p:xfrm is unchanged. A missing row returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a row id returns InvalidId. A missing h, or a value that is not a positive integer, returns InvalidField. a:tr/@h is required. h: null returns InvalidField. When inspect finds no @h, it still reports null. This op on docx / xlsx returns InvalidField. Do not reuse Word setTableRowHeight (the unit is twip). Do not reuse xlsx setRowHeight.

setTableCellFillOp.description: 改某一格 a:tcPr 的填充（EG_FillProperties）。
setTableCellFillOp.descriptionEn: Change the fill on one cell's a:tcPr (EG_FillProperties).
setTableCellFillOp.limits: 不要用 setShapeFill。不要用 docx 的 setCellFormat。theme 色仍不展开成 RGB。备注表、母版表同样认。
setTableCellFillOp.limitsEn: Do not use setShapeFill. Do not use docx setCellFormat. Theme colors are still not expanded to RGB. Notes tables and master tables are accepted the same way.

setTableCellBordersOp.description: 改某一格 a:tcPr 的六边。
setTableCellBordersOp.descriptionEn: Change the six edges of one cell's a:tcPr.
setTableCellBordersOp.limits: 未点名的边留下。不要用 setShapeLine。
setTableCellBordersOp.limitsEn: Edges you did not name stay. Do not use setShapeLine.

setTableCellInsetOp.description: 改某一格 a:tcPr 的 marT / marL / marB / marR。
setTableCellInsetOp.descriptionEn: Change marT / marL / marB / marR on one cell's a:tcPr.
setTableCellInsetOp.limits: 不要用 docx 的 setTableCellMar 或 setCellFormat。
setTableCellInsetOp.limitsEn: Do not use docx setTableCellMar or setCellFormat.

setTableCellPrOp.description: 改某一格 a:tcPr 上 44 / 45 / 50 未覆盖的属性与子元：vert、anchorCtr、horzOverflow、cell3D、headers。
setTableCellPrOp.descriptionEn: Change attributes and child elements of one cell's a:tcPr that 44 / 45 / 50 do not cover: vert, anchorCtr, horzOverflow, cell3D, and headers.
setTableCellPrOp.limits: 不要改 C9 的 textAnchor。不要写 tcPr/@anchor。不要用 setShapeFormat。备注表、母版表同样认。
setTableCellPrOp.limitsEn: Do not change C9 textAnchor. Do not write tcPr/@anchor. Do not use setShapeFormat. Notes tables and master tables are accepted the same way.

setTableStyleRefOp.description: 改某一张 DrawingML 表上的样式 GUID 与 a:tblPr 行列开关。
setTableStyleRefOp.descriptionEn: Change the style GUID and the a:tblPr row and column switches on one DrawingML table.
setTableStyleRefOp.limits: 不要用 docx 的 setTableStyle。不要读写 /ppt/tableStyles.xml。备注表、母版表同样认。
setTableStyleRefOp.limitsEn: Do not use docx setTableStyle. Do not read or write /ppt/tableStyles.xml. Notes tables and master tables are accepted the same way.

pptxSetThemeColorsOp.description: 改该母版 theme 部件的 a:clrScheme 槽位，以及配色方案名、theme 根名。
pptxSetThemeColorsOp.descriptionEn: Change a:clrScheme slots on that master's theme part, and the color-scheme name and the theme root name.
pptxSetThemeColorsOp.limits: 不改未点名的 fmtScheme 槽。不把未点名形状上的 schemeClr 展开成直接色。
pptxSetThemeColorsOp.limitsEn: fmtScheme slots you did not name stay unchanged. schemeClr on shapes you did not name is not expanded to a direct color.

pptxSetThemeFontsOp.description: 改该母版 theme 部件的 a:fontScheme。
pptxSetThemeFontsOp.descriptionEn: Change a:fontScheme on that master's theme part.
pptxSetThemeFontsOp.limits: 未点名的 fmtScheme 槽留下。

setClrMapOp.description: 改 slideMaster、notesMaster 或 handoutMaster 上的 p:clrMap。
setClrMapOp.descriptionEn: Change p:clrMap on a slideMaster, notesMaster, or handoutMaster.
setClrMapOp.limits: 不把映射算成 RGB。不改 theme 部件。
setClrMapOp.limitsEn: The map is not resolved to RGB. The theme part is unchanged.

setClrMapOvrOp.description: 改幻灯片、版式或备注页上的 p:clrMapOvr。
setClrMapOvrOp.descriptionEn: Change p:clrMapOvr on a slide, a layout, or a notes page.

insertChartOp.limits: docx：在该段末插入 w:drawing，默认浮动。新建 /word/charts/chartN.xml（N 从 1 起尚未占用）、chart 的 .rels、一份最小 embedding xlsx（工作表名 Sheet1， 分类从 A2 起，系列名在第 1 行，数值从 B2 起向右），以及宿主部件关系（主文档、页眉页脚、comments.xml、footnotes.xml 或 endnotes.xml）、[Content_Types].xml Override。 chart 部件仍写在 /word/charts/。
insertChartOp.limitsEn: docx: insert a w:drawing at the end of that paragraph, floating by default. Create /word/charts/chartN.xml (N starts at 1 and is not yet used), the chart .rels, and a minimal embedding xlsx (sheet name Sheet1, categories starting at A2, series names on row 1, values from B2 to the right), plus a relationship on the host part (main document, header or footer, comments.xml, footnotes.xml, or endnotes.xml) and a [Content_Types].xml Override. The chart part is still written under /word/charts/.

dataFrom.description: dataFrom 是单个单元格地址，例如 A1。不要写范围（A1:E19），不要写表名（Sheet!A1）。它不是「图表去引用哪一块已有单元格」。series 里的分类和数值会按这个格子当左上角，写进工作表，挡住的格子会被盖掉。分类写在这一列的下一行起；每个系列的名字写在这一行、向右逐列；数值写在名字下面。气泡图每个系列占两列。已经手写了表格时，把 dataFrom 指到空区域，不要指到那张表的表头。

deleteChartOp.limits: docx：删掉对应 w:drawing。若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。 所在 w:r 若删完后只剩 w:rPr 或空，把该 run 也删掉。重新解析关系之后，若该 chart 部件、专属 colors / style、embedding 再无人引用，删掉这些部件、关系条目和对应内容类型。
deleteChartOp.limitsEn: docx: delete the matching w:drawing. If it sits in the Choice of an mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. If the host w:r has only w:rPr left, or is empty, after the delete, that run is deleted too. After relationships are resolved again, if that chart part, its dedicated colors / style, and the embedding are unreferenced, delete those parts, the relationship entries, and the matching content types.

setChartTitleOp.limits: 找不到该图报表 IdNotFound。id 不是图表 id 报 InvalidId。
setChartTitleOp.limitsEn: A missing chart returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a chart id returns InvalidId.

setChartSeriesOp.description: 改图表里一个系列的数据。
setChartSeriesOp.descriptionEn: Change one series' data in a chart.
setChartSeriesOp.limits: name、categories、values、sizes 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。只给的字段改，其余保留。categories 与 values 都给时长度可以不同。 对非气泡系列给 sizes 报 InvalidField。找不到该系列报 IdNotFound。id 不是系列 id 报 InvalidId。
setChartSeriesOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of name, categories, values, and sizes, or the op returns InvalidField. Only the fields you give are changed; the rest stay. When both categories and values are given, their lengths may differ. sizes on a non-bubble series returns InvalidField. A missing series returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a series id returns InvalidId.

addChartSeriesOp.description: 在 chart 部件末尾追加一条 c:ser，c:idx / c:order 取尚未占用的最小值。
addChartSeriesOp.descriptionEn: Append one c:ser at the end of the chart part. c:idx / c:order take the smallest unused value.
addChartSeriesOp.limits: 样式能从最后一条系列抄则抄，抄不了就用最小默认。docx 有 embedding 则在工作表右侧追加一列。xlsx 能从已有系列的 c:f 推出右侧相邻空列则写入；推不出报 NotImplemented。不能用本 op 把单类型图加成组合图。id 不是图表 id 报 InvalidId。
addChartSeriesOp.limitsEn: Copy the style from the last series when it can be copied; otherwise use a minimal default. If docx has an embedding, append a column on the right of the worksheet. On xlsx, if an empty column immediately to the right can be inferred from an existing series c:f, write it; if it cannot, return NotImplemented. This op cannot turn a single-type chart into a combo chart. An id that is not a chart id returns InvalidId.

deleteChartSeriesOp.limits: docx 若能从公式定位则同步 embedding 里对应列。xlsx 不删单元格。删完后一条都不剩时报 InvalidField（要整张去掉请用 deleteChart）。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是系列 id 报 InvalidId。
deleteChartSeriesOp.limitsEn: On docx, if the column can be located from the formula, update the matching column in the embedding too. xlsx does not delete cells. If none remain after the delete, the op returns InvalidField (to remove the whole chart, use deleteChart). A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a series id returns InvalidId.

setChartTypeOp.limits: 不认识的枚举、或值为 combo、chartex，报 InvalidField。当前 type 为 other 或 chartex 时报 NotImplemented，不写文件。 转成 stock 必须恰好三条（hlc）或四条（ohlc）系列，否则 NotImplemented。从组合图转成股价报 NotImplemented。 转成 surface 必须恰好三条系列，否则 NotImplemented。 转成 ofPie / pie / doughnut 必须恰好一条系列，否则 NotImplemented。
setChartTypeOp.limitsEn: An unknown enum, or the value combo or chartex, returns InvalidField. If the current type is other or chartex, the op returns NotImplemented and the file is not written. Converting to stock requires exactly three series (hlc) or four series (ohlc); otherwise NotImplemented. Converting a combo chart to stock returns NotImplemented. Converting to surface requires exactly three series; otherwise NotImplemented. Converting to ofPie / pie / doughnut requires exactly one series; otherwise NotImplemented.

setChartAxisTitleOp.limits: axis 不认识报 InvalidField。找不到对应主轴报 InvalidField。id 不是图表 id 报 InvalidId。找不到图报表 IdNotFound。
setChartAxisTitleOp.limitsEn: An unknown axis returns InvalidField. If the matching primary axis cannot be found, the op returns InvalidField. An id that is not a chart id returns InvalidId. A missing chart returns IdNotFound.

setChartLegendOp.description: show 为 false 时忽略 pos。
setChartLegendOp.descriptionEn: When show is false, pos is ignored.
setChartLegendOp.limits: 不认识的 pos 报 InvalidField。id 不是图表 id 报 InvalidId。
setChartLegendOp.limitsEn: An unknown pos returns InvalidField. An id that is not a chart id returns InvalidId.

setChartDataLabelsOp.description: true：在 plotArea 写 c:dLbls，c:showVal 为 1，不调标签坐标。
setChartDataLabelsOp.descriptionEn: true: write c:dLbls on plotArea, with c:showVal set to 1. Label coordinates are not adjusted.
setChartDataLabelsOp.limits: false：去掉 plotArea 与各系列上的 c:dLbls。id 不是图表 id 报 InvalidId。
setChartDataLabelsOp.limitsEn: false: remove c:dLbls from plotArea and from each series. An id that is not a chart id returns InvalidId.

insertTrendlineOp.description: 在该 c:ser 末尾追加一条 c:trendline（插在 c:cat / c:val / c:errBars / c:extLst 之前）。
insertTrendlineOp.descriptionEn: Append one c:trendline at the end of that c:ser (inserted before c:cat / c:val / c:errBars / c:extLst).
insertTrendlineOp.limits: poly 以外给 order、或 movingAvg 以外给 period，报 InvalidField。饼、圆环、复合饼、曲面、other、chartex 上报 InvalidField。id 不是系列 id 报 InvalidId。找不到系列报 IdNotFound。
insertTrendlineOp.limitsEn: order for a type other than poly, or period for a type other than movingAvg, returns InvalidField. Pie, doughnut, of-pie, surface, other, and chartex return InvalidField. An id that is not a series id returns InvalidId. A missing series returns IdNotFound.

setTrendlineOp.limits: 至少给一个可写字段，否则报 InvalidField。只改被点名的字段。把 type 改成非 poly 时去掉 c:order；改成非 movingAvg 时去掉 c:period。 id 不是趋势线 id 报 InvalidId。找不到报 IdNotFound。
setTrendlineOp.limitsEn: Give at least one writable field, or the op returns InvalidField. Only the fields you name are changed. Changing type to a non-poly value removes c:order. Changing it to a non-movingAvg value removes c:period. An id that is not a trendline id returns InvalidId. A missing id returns IdNotFound.

deleteTrendlineOp.limits: id 不是趋势线 id 报 InvalidId。找不到报 IdNotFound。
deleteTrendlineOp.limitsEn: An id that is not a trendline id returns InvalidId. A missing id returns IdNotFound.

insertErrorBarsOp.limits: valType 为 cust 时必须给 plus 与 minus，写成 c:plus / c:minus 的 c:numLit，不必与系列点数相同。非 cust 时出现 plus / minus 报 InvalidField。lCaps 不是合法 valType，报 InvalidField。dir 为 y 或缺省时不写 c:errDir；dir 为 x 时写 c:errDir val="x"。该系列已有同 dir 的误差线时报 InvalidField。
insertErrorBarsOp.limitsEn: When valType is cust, plus and minus are required and are written as c:numLit under c:plus / c:minus. They need not have the same point count as the series. plus or minus on a non-cust value returns InvalidField. lCaps is not a legal valType and returns InvalidField. When dir is y or omitted, c:errDir is not written. When dir is x, write c:errDir val="x". If that series already has an error bar with the same dir, the op returns InvalidField.

setErrorBarsOp.limits: 至少给一个可写字段。改成 stdErr 时去掉 c:val。改成 cust 时必须有 plus 与 minus（本 op 给的，或原节点已有）。 改成非 cust 时去掉 c:plus / c:minus。lCaps 报 InvalidField。id 不是误差线 id 报 InvalidId。
setErrorBarsOp.limitsEn: Give at least one writable field. Changing to stdErr removes c:val. Changing to cust requires plus and minus (supplied on this op, or already present on the node). Changing to a non-cust value removes c:plus / c:minus. lCaps returns InvalidField. An id that is not an error-bar id returns InvalidId.

setChartSeriesAxisOp.description: 把该系列所在包裹的数值轴 c:axId 指到主轴或次轴。
setChartSeriesAxisOp.descriptionEn: Point the value-axis c:axId of the wrapper that holds this series at the primary or secondary axis.
setChartSeriesAxisOp.limits: 没有次轴时按主数值轴复制一条，写 c:overlay val="1"、c:crosses val="max"、新的 c:axId。同一包裹里还有别的系列且目标轴不同时，把被点名系列拆到同类型的新包裹。已经是目标状态则空操作。饼、圆环、复合饼、曲面、股价、other、chartex 上报 InvalidField。axis 不认识报 InvalidField。id 不是系列 id 报 InvalidId。
setChartSeriesAxisOp.limitsEn: If there is no secondary axis, copy one from the primary value axis and write c:overlay val="1", c:crosses val="max", and a new c:axId. If the same wrapper still has other series and the target axis differs, split the named series into a new wrapper of the same type. If it is already in the target state, the op is a no-op. Pie, doughnut, of-pie, surface, stock, other, and chartex return InvalidField. An unknown axis returns InvalidField. An id that is not a series id returns InvalidId.

setChartSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 相同，id 为图表 id。
setChartSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureSize. id is a chart id.
setChartSizeOp.limits: docx 改宿主 wp:extent（以及 a:ext 若有），规则与图相同。xlsx 规则与图相同：oneCell / absolute 改 xdr:ext，twoCell 改右下角 to。pptx 写入 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:ext。
setChartSizeOp.limitsEn: docx changes the host wp:extent (and a:ext when present), by the same rules as pictures. xlsx follows pictures: oneCell / absolute change xdr:ext, and twoCell changes the bottom-right to. pptx writes p:xfrm/a:ext on the graphicFrame.

insertCommentOp.limits: start 与 end 必须在同一部件，且 start 在文档顺序上不得晚于 end，否则报 InvalidField。不提供字符偏移。 在 start 段 w:pPr 之后插入 w:commentRangeStart； 在 end 段已有内容之后插入 w:commentRangeEnd，再跟一个含 w:commentReference 的 run（rStyle 为 CommentReference）。跨段时中间段落整段落在范围内，不另写标记。
insertCommentOp.limitsEn: start and end must be in the same part, and start must not come after end in document order, or the op returns InvalidField. Character offsets are not accepted. Insert w:commentRangeStart after w:pPr in the start paragraph. After the existing content of the end paragraph, insert w:commentRangeEnd, followed by a run that contains w:commentReference (rStyle is CommentReference). When the range crosses paragraphs, each paragraph in between lies wholly inside the range, and no extra marks are written.

deleteCommentOp.description: 去掉该批注在主文档、页眉、页脚、文本框和注里所有匹配的范围标记与 commentReference，再去掉 comments.xml 里该条。
deleteCommentOp.descriptionEn: Remove every matching range mark and commentReference for that comment in the main document, headers, footers, text boxes, and notes, then remove that entry from comments.xml.
deleteCommentOp.limits: 子回复级联删除（paraIdParent 链指向它的都删），清单里验回复不残留。已经不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是批注容器 id 报 InvalidId。批注内图按图片规则收。删光批注后仍保留 comments.xml 空壳和已有的 extended / people 部件，不拆掉整个 part。xlsx 的 id 可以是顶层批注或回复。
deleteCommentOp.limitsEn: Child replies are cascade-deleted (every paraIdParent chain that points at it is deleted). The listing must show no leftover replies. An id that no longer exists returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a comment-container id returns InvalidId. Pictures inside the comment are cleaned up by the picture rules. After the last comment is deleted, the empty comments.xml shell and the existing extended / people parts remain. The whole part is not removed. An xlsx id may be a top-level comment or a reply.

replyCommentOp.description: 新增一条 w:comment 和新的 commentEx，paraIdParent 为父批注当前最后一段的 paraId。
replyCommentOp.descriptionEn: Add one w:comment and a new commentEx. paraIdParent is the paraId of the parent comment's current last paragraph.
replyCommentOp.limits: 在父批注已有的范围上再套一套相同范围的标记（commentRangeStart 插在父 start 之后， commentRangeEnd 与 commentReference 插在父 commentReference 所在 run 之后），与 Word 16 Replies.Add 一致；rStyle 抄父引用 run。找不到父批注的范围标记时仍写 comment 与 commentEx，不报错。
replyCommentOp.limitsEn: Place another mark of the same range around the parent comment's existing range (commentRangeStart goes after the parent's start, and commentRangeEnd and commentReference go after the run that holds the parent's commentReference), matching Word 16 Replies.Add. rStyle is copied from the parent reference run. If the parent comment's range marks cannot be found, comment and commentEx are still written, and no error is returned.

setCommentTextOp.description: 只改该 w:comment 的可见文本，不改范围标记。
setCommentTextOp.descriptionEn: Change only the visible text of that w:comment. Range marks stay unchanged.
setCommentTextOp.limits: 留下第一段（含 annotationRef），按 setParaText 的规则改这段的可见 w:t，删掉后面多出来的 w:p。随后把 commentEx/@paraId 和指向旧最后一段的 paraIdParent 改成留下的那一段。id 不是批注容器 id 报 InvalidId。对批注内段落 id 请用 setParaText。对 kind 为 ink 的批注报 NotImplemented，没有可见 w:t 时同样拒绝，不写文件。xlsx 的 id 可以是批注容器 id 或回复 id。
setCommentTextOp.limitsEn: Keep the first paragraph (including annotationRef). Change that paragraph's visible w:t by the setParaText rules, and delete the extra w:p elements after it. Then set commentEx/@paraId, and any paraIdParent that pointed at the old last paragraph, to the paragraph that remains. An id that is not a comment-container id returns InvalidId. For a paragraph id inside a comment, use setParaText. A comment whose kind is ink returns NotImplemented. The same refusal applies when there is no visible w:t, and the file is not written. An xlsx id may be a comment-container id or a reply id.

setCommentBoxOp.description: 改批注框的显隐或宽高。
setCommentBoxOp.descriptionEn: Change a comment box's visibility or size.
setCommentBoxOp.limits: 只用于 xlsx 顶层批注。按格子的行、列找到 Note，不看 shapeId。visible、width、height 至少给一个。width 和 height 是正数，单位磅。回复 id 报 InvalidId。没有 Note 报 IdNotFound。不改批注文字。
setCommentBoxOp.limitsEn: xlsx top-level comments only. The Note is found by the cell row and column, not by shapeId. Give at least one of visible, width, and height. width and height are positive numbers in points. A reply id returns InvalidId. A missing Note returns IdNotFound. Comment text stays unchanged.

setCommentMetaOp.description: 改批注的作者、缩写或时间。
setCommentMetaOp.descriptionEn: Change a comment's author, initials, or date.
setCommentMetaOp.limits: author、initials、date 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。只改被点名的属性，其余不动。改 author 时若 people.xml 里还没有这个作者则补一条，不删旧作者。 id 不是批注容器 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 的 id 可以是批注容器 id 或回复 id。 改 author 时按新的 displayName 指向（必要时新建）一条 person，只改该条 personId，不改共享的那条 person，以免误伤同作者其它批注。initials 接受但不写入。 改 date 时写 @dT。
setCommentMetaOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of author, initials, and date, or the op returns InvalidField. Only the attributes you name change. The rest stay. When author changes, if people.xml does not yet contain that author, add one entry. The old author is not deleted. An id that is not a comment-container id returns InvalidId. An xlsx id may be a comment-container id or a reply id. When author changes, point at one person by the new displayName (create it if needed), change only that personId, and do not change the shared person, so other comments by the same author are not affected. initials is accepted but not written. When date changes, write @dT.

setCommentDoneOp.description: 只改被点名这一条的 done，不自动改回复。
setCommentDoneOp.descriptionEn: Change done only on the one entry you name. Replies are not updated automatically.
setCommentDoneOp.limits: 没有 commentsExtended 则按 Word 16 最小集新建，并为文件里每条批注补 commentEx（默认 done="0"），再改被点名的那条。父批注最后一段没有 w14:paraId 时报 InvalidField。xlsx 的 id 可以是批注容器 id 或回复 id。done: true 写 @done="1"；false 去掉 @done。pptx 的 id 可以是批注容器 id 或回复 id。
setCommentDoneOp.limitsEn: If commentsExtended is missing, create the Word 16 minimal set, add a commentEx for every comment in the file (default done="0"), then change the one you named. If the parent comment's last paragraph has no w14:paraId, the op returns InvalidField. An xlsx id may be a comment-container id or a reply id. done: true writes @done="1"; false removes @done. A pptx id may be a comment-container id or a reply id.

drawingAlign.description: 段落水平对齐。l、ctr、r、just，或 null 去掉属性。
drawingAlign.descriptionEn: Paragraph horizontal alignment: l, ctr, r, or just. null removes the attribute.

drawingTextAnchor.description: 文本框垂直对齐。t、ctr、b、just、dist，或 null 去掉属性。
drawingTextAnchor.descriptionEn: Text body vertical anchor: t, ctr, b, just, or dist. null removes the attribute.

drawingUnderline.description: 下划线。sng、none、dbl，或 null 去掉属性。
drawingUnderline.descriptionEn: Underline: sng, none, or dbl. null removes the attribute.

shapePrst.description: 可写的预设几何名。不含连接线。
shapePrst.descriptionEn: Writable preset geometry name. Connector names are not included.

inspectRequest.description: 按 scope 看文件的一部分。
inspectRequest.descriptionEn: View part of the file according to scope.
inspectRequest.limits: 不要一次要整份文件。不带 scope 只返回名单，不返回单元格。xlsx 公式格的 value 是包里的缓存，没有缓存则为 null，库不算。改内容用 apply，不要把这次看到的树整份送回去当修改。
inspectRequest.limitsEn: Do not request the whole file at once. Without scope the result is only the list, not cells. An xlsx formula cell's value is the cached value in the package; it is null when there is no cache, and the library does not calculate it. To change content, use apply. Do not send the whole tree you just saw back as the edit.

inspectScope.limits: 三种格式的键不能混用。xlsx 看格子要同时给 sheet 和 range。没列出的键不要写。
inspectScope.limitsEn: Do not mix keys from the three formats. To view xlsx cells, give both sheet and range. Do not write keys that are not listed.

createRequest.description: 整包生成一份新文件。目标路径已存在则覆盖。
createRequest.descriptionEn: Generate a whole new file. An existing path is overwritten.
createRequest.limits: 改已有内容用 apply，不要靠 create 覆盖。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不要同时写。
createRequest.limitsEn: To change existing content, use apply instead of overwriting with create. xlsx uses workbook, docx uses document, and pptx uses presentation. Do not write all three together.
createRequest.comment: path 必填。xlsx 用 workbook，docx 用 document，pptx 用 presentation，三者不能同时出现。

exportMediaRequest.description: 按 id 把图或嵌入对象的原始字节写到本地。
exportMediaRequest.descriptionEn: Write the original bytes of a picture or an embedded object to a local file, by id.
exportMediaRequest.limits: 不改源文件，字节也不进 inspect 树。
exportMediaRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file, and the bytes are not placed in the inspect tree.
exportMediaRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

applyRequest.description: 用 id 和 op 改文件里点名的内容。
applyRequest.descriptionEn: Use id and op to change the named content in the file.
applyRequest.limits: 不要把整棵 inspect 树塞进请求。
applyRequest.limitsEn: Do not send the whole inspect tree back as the edit.

exportChartDataRequest.description: 把图表背后的工作簿数据导出。
exportChartDataRequest.descriptionEn: Export the workbook data behind a chart.
exportChartDataRequest.limitsEn: Does not modify the source file and does not evaluate formulas.
exportChartDataRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。

exportChartImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 簇状柱形图画成 PNG。
exportChartImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx clustered column chart to a PNG.
exportChartImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。只画簇状柱形图，系列用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。其余图报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。
exportChartImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Only clustered column charts are drawn, using caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Other charts return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented.
exportChartImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSparklineImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 一组里的一条折线迷你图画成 PNG。
exportSparklineImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one line sparkline in an xlsx group to a PNG.
exportSparklineImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{name}/spark:{n}。一组只能有一条，落点只能是一个格子。只画折线。柱形、盈亏、标记、高低点、首末点、负值、横坐标、日期轴和从右到左报 NotImplemented。数值用包里已有的缓存。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。
exportSparklineImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}/spark:{n}. The group must hold one sparkline, and the location must be one cell. Only the line is drawn. Column, win/loss, markers, high and low points, first and last points, negatives, the axis, a date axis, and right-to-left return NotImplemented. Values come from caches already in the package. docx and pptx return InvalidField. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented.
exportSparklineImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSheetImageRequest.description: 把 xlsx 工作表的已用区域画成 PNG。
exportSheetImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw an xlsx worksheet's used range to a PNG.
exportSheetImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 sheet:{名称}。图画 dimension，没有则用单元格外框。像素按 Excel 复制为图片的 100% 格子，不乘工作表缩放。显式列宽用 floor(((256*宽度+floor(128/7))/256)*7)，缺省列 64 像素。行高把磅截成像素。自动行高只认微软雅黑一类字体乘 1.65，以及 Calibri 11 磅为 15 磅。宽高是各格之和再加 1。网格色 E0E0E0。纯色填充盖住格子右缘和下缘。上边和左边的外框保持网格色。公式没有缓存时用库里的求值。合并单元格用锚点。数据条按最小最大、长度 10% 到 90%。两档或三档色阶按 RGB 混合。筛选按钮 17×17，箭头居中。实线边框认 thin、medium、thick，各 1、2、3 像素，颜色用 rgb，没写颜色时用黑色。边框只画在写下它的那一格上，不沿合并区扩开，合并区内部的边不画。线以边界为中线，偶数宽度多出的一像素落在格外。线只伸到实际有边的那一端。更粗的线盖住交界。斜线、虚线、主题色和索引色，以及关掉网格、隐藏行列、渐变填充、压到区域上的图形和其它条件格式报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。docx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportSheetImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is sheet:{name}. The picture is the dimension, or the cell bounding box when that is absent. Pixels follow Excel CopyPicture at 100 percent and do not multiply the sheet zoom. An explicit column width uses floor(((256*width+floor(128/7))/256)*7). An omitted column is 64 pixels. Row height truncates points to pixels. Automatic row height only treats CJK faces as 1.65 times the point size, and Calibri 11 pt as 15 pt. Width and height are the sums plus 1. The grid is E0E0E0. Solid fills cover the cell's right and bottom edges. The top and left outer frame stay the grid color. Formulas without a cache use the library evaluator. A merge uses its anchor. Data bars use min and max, from 10 percent to 90 percent. Two or three color-scale stops mix in RGB. Filter buttons are 17 by 17, with the arrow centered. Solid borders accept thin, medium, and thick, at 1, 2, and 3 pixels. The color is rgb, and a missing color is black. A border stays on the cell that has it, is not stretched around a merge, and an edge inside the merge is not drawn. The line is centered on the cell edge. An even width puts the extra pixel outside the cell. A line stops at an end that has no border. A thicker line covers a thinner one on the same edge. Diagonals, dashed lines, theme colors, indexed colors, grid off, hidden rows or columns, gradient fills, drawings that hit the range, and other conditional formats return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. docx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportSheetImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportPageImageRequest.description: 把 docx 里没有字的一页画成 PNG。
exportPageImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw one docx page that has no text to a PNG.
exportPageImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。id 是 page:N，从 1 起。只画单节、空段、Calibri 11 磅、没有页眉页脚的白页。宽高按 w:pgSz，96 dpi，twip×96/1440 四舍五入，要落在 1 到 4096 像素。有字、表格、图、页眉页脚或别的行距报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 pptx 报 InvalidField。
exportPageImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. id is page:N, starting at 1. Only a white page with one section, empty paragraphs, Calibri 11 pt, and no header or footer is drawn. Width and height come from w:pgSz at 96 dpi, rounding twip times 96/1440, and must be 1 to 4096 pixels. Text, tables, pictures, headers, footers, or another line spacing return NotImplemented. xlsx and pptx return InvalidField.
exportPageImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

exportSlideImageRequest.description: 把 pptx 一页的纯色页底、PNG 和没有描边的实心矩形画成 PNG。
exportSlideImageRequest.descriptionEn: Draw a pptx slide's solid background, PNG pictures, and solid rectangles without a stroke to a PNG.
exportSlideImageRequest.limits: 只读。不改源包，像素不进 inspect。只画幻灯片自己的不透明纯色页底、没有旋转翻转裁剪的 PNG，以及没有翻转、没有描边的不透明实心矩形，含绕中心转 90 度倍数。后画的盖住先画的，超出页面的部分裁掉。半透明、文字、其它形状和图表不画。组合里的图、视频和音频报 NotImplemented。宽或高超出 1 到 4096 像素也报 NotImplemented。xlsx 与 docx 报 InvalidField。
exportSlideImageRequest.limitsEn: Read only. Does not modify the source package, and pixels do not enter inspect. Only the slide's own opaque solid background, unrotated unflipped uncropped PNG pictures, and opaque solid rectangles without a flip or a stroke are drawn, including quarter turns around the center. Later objects cover earlier ones, and the part outside the page is clipped. Translucent fills, text, other shapes, and charts are not drawn. Pictures inside groups, video, and audio return NotImplemented. Width or height outside 1 to 4096 pixels also returns NotImplemented. xlsx and docx return InvalidField.
exportSlideImageRequest.comment: output 必填。不得默认写成源 path。contentType 固定为 image/png。

layoutCheckRequest.description: 只读检查页上形状的几何，不改文件。
layoutCheckRequest.descriptionEn: Check shape geometry on slides without changing the file.
layoutCheckRequest.limits: 不生成图片，不调用 Office，不重排。本期只做 pptx，其余格式报 InvalidField。
layoutCheckRequest.limitsEn: No images, no Office calls, no reflow. Only pptx is supported in this phase; other formats return InvalidField.

helpRequest.descriptionEn: Look up how to fill in an operation.
helpRequest.limits: 先搜再打开。不要猜字段，也不要把别的格式的字段套过来。本工具不支持预览。xlsx 的簇状柱形图可以按 exportChartImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的折线迷你图可以按 exportSparklineImage 写成 PNG。xlsx 的已用区域可以按 exportSheetImage 写成 PNG。pptx 可以按 exportSlideImage 把页底、PNG、矩形、圆角矩形、椭圆、两色渐变、形状文字、簇状柱形图和纯色单元格的表写成图。画不了的对象让整页失败。docx 没有字的页可以按 exportPageImage 写成 PNG，有字的页还不画。像素不进 inspect。机器上有 Microsoft Office 或 WPS 时，可以自己导出后再查看：Word、Excel，以及 WPS 的 kwps、ket，用 ExportAsFixedFormat 写成 PDF；PowerPoint 和 WPS 的 kwpp 用幻灯片的 Export 写成 PNG。本工具不调用它们。
helpRequest.limitsEn: Search first, then open one operation. Do not guess fields, and do not reuse fields from another format. This tool does not preview a whole page. An xlsx clustered column chart can be written to PNG with exportChartImage. An xlsx line sparkline can be written to PNG with exportSparklineImage. An xlsx used range can be written to PNG with exportSheetImage. A pptx slide's background, PNG pictures, rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, two-stop gradients, shape text, clustered column charts, and solid table cells can be written with exportSlideImage. An object that cannot be drawn fails the slide. Those pixels do not enter inspect. A docx page with no text can be written to PNG with exportPageImage. Pages with text are not drawn yet. If Microsoft Office or WPS is installed, export and then look: Word, Excel, and WPS kwps and ket use ExportAsFixedFormat to write a PDF; PowerPoint and WPS kwpp use the slide Export method to write a PNG. This tool does not call them.

insertHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链在该段已有内容之后插入一个 w:hyperlink，内含一个带 text 的 run。 外部链在该部件 .rels 上新建 Type 以 /hyperlink 结尾的关系，TargetMode 为 External，Target 为 url 原文。内部链写 w:anchor，不写关系。 url 与 anchor 同时出现或一个都不给报 InvalidField。url 为空串报 InvalidField。anchor 为空串或以 _ 开头报 InvalidField。 找不到段落报 IdNotFound。
insertHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx: for a paragraph link, insert a w:hyperlink after that paragraph's existing content, containing one run that carries text. An external link creates, on that part's .rels, a relationship whose Type ends with /hyperlink, with TargetMode External and Target the url verbatim. An internal link writes w:anchor and writes no relationship. url and anchor both present, or neither given, returns InvalidField. An empty url returns InvalidField. An empty anchor, or an anchor that starts with _, returns InvalidField. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound.

setHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链：url、anchor、text、tooltip 至少给一个。url 与 anchor 不能同时出现。 给了 url：有已有 r:id 则改该关系 Target；没有则新建关系并写 r:id，去掉 w:anchor。给了 anchor：写 w:anchor，去掉 r:id，该关系无人引用则删除。 text 只改该 w:hyperlink 内可见 w:t（规则与 setParaText 第 2–4 条相同，范围限于该元素）。tooltip 为字符串则写属性；为 null 则去掉属性。 找不到报 IdNotFound。
setHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx paragraph link: give at least one of url, anchor, text, and tooltip. url and anchor cannot both appear. If url is given and an r:id already exists, update that relationship's Target; if there is no r:id, create a relationship, write r:id, and remove w:anchor. If anchor is given, write w:anchor, remove r:id, and delete that relationship if nothing references it. text changes only the visible w:t inside that w:hyperlink (same rules as setParaText rules 2–4, limited to that element). A string tooltip writes the attribute; null removes it. A missing id returns IdNotFound.

deleteHyperlinkOp.limits: docx：段落链拆掉 w:hyperlink 外壳，留下内部 w:r。该 r:id 在本部件 XML 里无人引用则删除关系。 DrawingML 链去掉 a:hlinkClick 和无人引用的 hyperlink 关系，不删对象。 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是超链接 id 且不是带链的本期 DrawingML 对象 id 报 InvalidId。 对 OLE id 报 InvalidId。
deleteHyperlinkOp.limitsEn: docx: a paragraph link unwraps the w:hyperlink and leaves the inner w:r. If that r:id is unreferenced in this part's XML, the relationship is deleted. A DrawingML link removes a:hlinkClick and any unreferenced hyperlink relationship, and does not delete the object. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is neither a hyperlink id nor a linked DrawingML object id supported in this phase returns InvalidId. An OLE id returns InvalidId.

setModel3dSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
setModel3dSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
setModel3dSizeOp.limits: id 必须是 3D 模型 id。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。不按列宽行高去换算 EMU。留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData。对图 id 发此 op、对 3D id 发 setPictureSize 仍报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
setModel3dSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be a 3D model id. oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. EMU is not converted from column width or row height. AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay. This op on a picture id, or setPictureSize on a 3D id, still returns InvalidId. See the docx and pptx books.

setModel3dCameraOp.limits: id 必须是 xlsx 3D 模型 id。改 Choice 里 am3d:camera、am3d:rot 与 am3d:spPr 里的 a:scene3d/a:lightRig。不换 GLB。不改锚点。docx / pptx 上同一套字段。示例见 docs/examples/xlsx-apply-model3d-camera.json。
setModel3dCameraOp.limitsEn: id must be an xlsx 3D model id. Updates am3d:camera, am3d:rot, and a:scene3d/a:lightRig inside am3d:spPr in the Choice. Does not replace the GLB. Does not change the anchor. docx / pptx use the same fields. See docs/examples/xlsx-apply-model3d-camera.json.

replaceLegacyPictureOp.description: 换一张旧式页眉图的媒体字节。
replaceLegacyPictureOp.descriptionEn: Replace the media bytes of one legacy header or footer picture.
replaceLegacyPictureOp.limits: id 必须是旧式页眉图 id。找不到报 IdNotFound。表上已有 drawingHF 时这份 VML 不在名单里，同样报 IdNotFound。SVG 报 InvalidField。不改形状 id，不新建 drawingHF，不改页眉原文。
replaceLegacyPictureOp.limitsEn: id must be a legacy header picture id. A missing picture returns IdNotFound. When the sheet already has drawingHF, this VML picture is not listed and also returns IdNotFound. SVG returns InvalidField. The shape id stays, drawingHF is not created, and the header text stays.

deleteLegacyPictureOp.descriptionEn: Delete one legacy header or footer picture.
deleteLegacyPictureOp.limits: id 必须是旧式页眉图 id。找不到报 IdNotFound。不改页眉原文。最后一张删掉后去掉 legacyDrawingHF。
deleteLegacyPictureOp.limitsEn: id must be a legacy header picture id. A missing picture returns IdNotFound. Header text stays. After the last one is deleted, legacyDrawingHF is removed.

replacePictureOp.limits: 找不到该图报 IdNotFound。读不到 file 报 Io。文件不是该格式认的图片报 InvalidField。
replacePictureOp.limitsEn: A missing picture returns IdNotFound. An unreadable file returns Io. A file that is not a picture recognized for this format returns InvalidField.

insertPictureOp.limits: docx：找不到该段落报 IdNotFound。id 不是段落 id 报 InvalidId。 cx / cy 都省略时，位图按像素尺寸、96 dpi 换算成 EMU（px × 914400 / 96）；读不出尺寸则用 1 英寸见方（914400）。 SVG 按根元素 width / height（无单位或 px 当 CSS 像素，同样 96 dpi）；没有则用 viewBox；再没有则 1 英寸见方。 EMF 优先用 rclFrame（单位 0.01 mm）换 EMU；读不到再用 rclBounds 当像素、96 dpi。
insertPictureOp.limitsEn: docx: a missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a paragraph id returns InvalidId. When both cx and cy are omitted, a bitmap is converted from pixels at 96 dpi to EMU (px × 914400 / 96); if the size cannot be read, a 1-inch square (914400) is used. SVG uses the root width / height (unitless or px treated as CSS pixels, also at 96 dpi); if those are missing, viewBox is used; if that is missing too, a 1-inch square is used. EMF prefers rclFrame (unit 0.01 mm) converted to EMU; if that cannot be read, rclBounds is treated as pixels at 96 dpi.

deletePictureOp.limits: 找不到该图报 IdNotFound。docx：按图 id 删掉对应的 w:drawing。 若该图在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉（避免 Fallback 的 VML 把图留住）。 所在 w:r 若删完后只剩 w:rPr 或空，把该 run 也删掉。xlsx：按图 id 删掉包含该 xdr:pic 的整个锚点。工作表 drawing 删空后去掉该部件、工作表上的 <drawing> 和对应关系。
deletePictureOp.limitsEn: A missing picture returns IdNotFound. docx: delete the w:drawing for that picture id. If the picture is in the Choice of mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent (so Fallback VML does not keep the picture). If the host w:r then contains only w:rPr or is empty, delete that run too. xlsx: delete the whole anchor that contains that xdr:pic. When a worksheet drawing is empty, remove that part, the worksheet <drawing>, and the matching relationship.

setPictureSizeOp.limits: cx 与 cy 至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField（xlsx twoCell 见下）。cx / cy 与 to 不能同时出现。只改被点名的那一侧，另一侧保持原值。 docx：写入 wp:extent；若 pic:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext 存在，一并改。 xlsx：oneCell 或 absolute 时写入 xdr:ext；若 xdr:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext 存在，一并改。
setPictureSizeOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of cx and cy, or InvalidField is returned (for xlsx twoCell, see below). cx / cy and to cannot both appear. Only the named side changes; the other side keeps its value. docx: write wp:extent; if pic:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext exists, update it too. xlsx: for oneCell or absolute, write xdr:ext; if xdr:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext exists, update it too.

setProtectionOp.description: docx 改 /word/settings.xml 的限制编辑；xlsx 改工作表 sheetProtection 或工作簿 workbookProtection； pptx 改 presentation.xml 的 p:modifyVerifier。
setProtectionOp.descriptionEn: docx updates restricted editing in /word/settings.xml; xlsx updates a worksheet's sheetProtection or the workbook's workbookProtection; pptx updates p:modifyVerifier in presentation.xml.
setProtectionOp.limits: pptx 的放映设置用 setShowPr，不要塞进本 op。
setProtectionOp.limitsEn: For pptx slide-show settings, use setShowPr. Do not put them in this op.

setPropsOp.description: 改标题、作者这类文档属性。
setPropsOp.descriptionEn: Change document properties such as title and author.
setPropsOp.limits: 这八个字段至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。未点名的字段留下，含 Application、页数/字数、HeadingPairs、TitlesOfParts、Slides，以及未点名的公司名。 不要写 DigSig。不要改 lastModifiedBy、created、modified。出现这些只读键报 UnknownField。id 不是格式根报 InvalidId。 缺 core.xml 或 app.xml 时，只要这条 op 点到了对应部件里的字段，就按需新建部件、根关系和 Content Type Override。
setPropsOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of these eight fields, or InvalidField is returned. Fields that were not named stay, including Application, page and word counts, HeadingPairs, TitlesOfParts, Slides, and a company name that was not named. Do not write DigSig. Do not change lastModifiedBy, created, or modified. Those read-only keys return UnknownField. An id that is not the format root returns InvalidId. If core.xml or app.xml is missing, and this op names a field in the corresponding part, create the part, the root relationship, and the Content Type Override as needed.

setCustomPropOp.description: 按名 upsert：已有同名 property 时命中文档顺序第一处，保留原来的 pid / fmtid，只换值子元素。
setCustomPropOp.descriptionEn: Upsert by name: when a property with the same name already exists, hit the first one in document order, keep its pid / fmtid, and replace only the value child.
setCustomPropOp.limits: 没有则追加，fmtid 固定 {D5CDD505-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE}，pid 取已有最大整数加 1，至少为 2。name 为空、type 不认识，或 type 与 value 对不上（例如 i4 却给了字符串或带小数的数字），报 InvalidField。id 不是格式根报 InvalidId。缺 custom.xml 则新建部件、根关系和 Override。
setCustomPropOp.limitsEn: If there is no match, append one. fmtid is fixed to {D5CDD505-2E9C-101B-9397-08002B2CF9AE}. pid is the largest existing integer plus 1, and at least 2. An empty name, an unrecognized type, or a type that does not match value (for example i4 given a string or a number with a fractional part) returns InvalidField. An id that is not the format root returns InvalidId. If custom.xml is missing, create the part, the root relationship, and the Override.

deleteCustomPropOp.description: 删掉一个自定义文档属性。
deleteCustomPropOp.limits: 找不到该名报 IdNotFound。id 不是 prop:{name} 报 InvalidId。删光后去掉 custom 部件、根关系和 Override。
deleteCustomPropOp.limitsEn: A missing name returns IdNotFound. An id that is not prop:{name} returns InvalidId. When none remain, remove the custom part, the root relationship, and the Override.

setShapeTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the text inside a shape.
setShapeTextOp.limits: 找不到该形状报 IdNotFound。第一个含 a:t 的 run 留下 a:rPr，其余可见 run 清掉。对 slide:{n} 或 slide:{n}/notes（没有 /shape:）发本 op 报 InvalidId。 对备注页、备注母版或讲义上占位符 p:ph/@type 为 sldImg 的形状发本 op 报 InvalidField，不写文件。 xlsx 改工作表文本框或无 txBox 形状的 xdr:txBody，规则与 pptx 相同（把下文的 p:sp / p:txBody 换成 xdr:sp / xdr:txBody）。
setShapeTextOp.limitsEn: A missing shape returns IdNotFound. The first run that contains a:t keeps its a:rPr, and the other visible runs are cleared. This op on slide:{n} or slide:{n}/notes (no /shape:) returns InvalidId. This op on a shape on a notes page, notes master, or handout whose placeholder p:ph/@type is sldImg returns InvalidField and writes nothing. xlsx changes xdr:txBody of a worksheet text box or a shape without txBox, with the same rules as pptx (read p:sp / p:txBody below as xdr:sp / xdr:txBody).

setShapeRunsOp.description: 按原文把形状或文本框里的文字拆成多个 run。短的用 match。中间很长时只写 after 和 before 两个切点。
setShapeRunsOp.descriptionEn: Split the text in a shape or text box into runs. Use match for a short span. For a long span, give only the after and before cut points.
setShapeRunsOp.limits: 不改没点名的字，不重建形状。id 与 setShapeText 相同。不写 match 时，after 是左切点，before 是右切点，中间原文单独成一截，中间不用抄。text 连起来必须和现在的可见文字相同。单元格、备注整段、讲义槽位、图表标题和 SmartArt 不走这条。
setShapeRunsOp.limitsEn: Does not change unnamed words and does not rebuild the shape. id matches setShapeText. Without match, after is the left cut and before is the right cut; the text between them becomes the run and is not copied into the request. text pieces must join to the current visible text. Cells, whole notes, handout slots, chart titles, and SmartArt do not use this op.

insertSmartArtOp.limits: docx：在该段末插入 w:drawing，默认浮动。新建 /word/diagrams/ 下尚未占用的 data / layout / colors / quickStyle 四件套（序号从 1 起）， 并把四条关系写在宿主 .rels 上（主文档、页眉页脚、comments.xml、footnotes.xml 或 endnotes.xml）。 diagram 部件仍写在 /word/diagrams/。wp:docPr/@id 取该部件已有 docPr 的最大整数加 1，至少为 1。
insertSmartArtOp.limitsEn: docx: insert a w:drawing at the end of that paragraph, floating by default. Create an unused data / layout / colors / quickStyle set of four under /word/diagrams/ (numbers starting at 1), and write the four relationships on the host .rels (main document, header or footer, comments.xml, footnotes.xml, or endnotes.xml). Diagram parts are still written under /word/diagrams/. wp:docPr/@id is the largest existing docPr integer in that part plus 1, and at least 1.

deleteSmartArtOp.limits: docx 删 w:drawing；若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉（Fallback 位图一起走）。所在 w:r 若删完后只剩 w:rPr 或空，把该 run 也删掉。xlsx 删对应 xdr:graphicFrame；若在组合里只摘该子节点，空组合再摘组合；锚点只剩 from/to/clientData 再摘整锚点。pptx 删 p:graphicFrame；若在 Choice 里同样整段 AlternateContent 删掉。
deleteSmartArtOp.limitsEn: docx deletes the w:drawing; if it is inside the Choice of mc:AlternateContent, the whole AlternateContent is deleted (the Fallback bitmap goes with it). If the host w:r then contains only w:rPr or is empty, that run is deleted too. xlsx deletes the matching xdr:graphicFrame; inside a group, only that child is removed, and an empty group is removed next; if the anchor has only from/to/clientData left, the whole anchor is removed. pptx deletes the p:graphicFrame; if it is inside a Choice, the whole AlternateContent is deleted the same way.

setSmartArtTextOp.description: 只改该点 dgm:t 的可见文字。
setSmartArtTextOp.descriptionEn: Change only the visible text of that point's dgm:t.
setSmartArtTextOp.limits: 留下第一个含 a:t 的 run 收下全部新文本，规则对齐 setShapeText 的可见替换（不整段重建 dgm:t 的 a:bodyPr）。没有 dgm:t 则补一份最小文本体。找不到该点报 IdNotFound。id 不是点 id 报 InvalidId。对 doc / pres / parTrans / sibTrans 点发此 op 报 InvalidId（它们不在树上）。
