setSmartArtTextOp.limitsEn: Keep the first run that contains a:t and put all of the new text there, matching setShapeText's visible replacement (do not rebuild a:bodyPr of dgm:t). If there is no dgm:t, add a minimal text body. A missing point returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a point id returns InvalidId. This op on a doc / pres / parTrans / sibTrans point returns InvalidId (those points are not on the tree).

addSmartArtPointOp.description: 在 data 部件追加一个可见 dgm:pt，并追加一条 type 为 parOf（或省略 type）的 cxn：srcId 为父点 modelId（图示 id 时父为 type="doc" 的点），destId 为新点。
addSmartArtPointOp.descriptionEn: Append one visible dgm:pt in the data part, and append one cxn whose type is parOf (or whose type is omitted): srcId is the parent point's modelId (when the id is the diagram, the parent is the point with type="doc"), and destId is the new point.
addSmartArtPointOp.limits: 不手写 pres / parTrans / sibTrans。现有 modelId 都能解析成非负整数时，新点与新连接用尚未占用的最小正整数； 否则新点写新的大写 GUID（带花括号），连接 modelId 同样不与已有 pt / cxn 冲突。
addSmartArtPointOp.limitsEn: Do not hand-author pres / parTrans / sibTrans. When every existing modelId parses as a non-negative integer, the new point and the new connection use the smallest unused positive integer; otherwise the new point is a new uppercase GUID (with braces), and the connection modelId likewise does not collide with an existing pt or cxn.

deleteSmartArtPointOp.description: 删掉该点，并沿 parOf 边删掉所有子孙可见点。
deleteSmartArtPointOp.descriptionEn: Delete that point and, along parOf edges, every visible descendant.
deleteSmartArtPointOp.limits: 同时删掉 srcId / destId 指向这些 modelId 的连接，以及 cxnId 指向已删连接的 parTrans / sibTrans 点。不删 type="doc" 的点。删完后可见点一条都不剩时报 InvalidField（要整张去掉请用 deleteSmartArt）。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是点 id 报 InvalidId。
deleteSmartArtPointOp.limitsEn: Also delete connections whose srcId or destId points at those modelIds, and parTrans / sibTrans points whose cxnId points at a deleted connection. Do not delete the point whose type is "doc". If no visible point remains, InvalidField is returned (to remove the whole diagram, use deleteSmartArt). A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a point id returns InvalidId.

setSmartArtSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 相同，id 为图示 id。
setSmartArtSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureSize. id is a diagram id.
setSmartArtSizeOp.limits: docx 改宿主 wp:extent（以及 a:ext 若有），规则与图相同。xlsx 规则与图相同：oneCell / absolute 改 xdr:ext，twoCell 改右下角 to。pptx 改 graphicFrame 的 p:xfrm/a:ext。
setSmartArtSizeOp.limitsEn: docx updates the host wp:extent (and a:ext if present), with the same rules as pictures. xlsx follows pictures: oneCell / absolute updates xdr:ext, and twoCell updates the bottom-right to. pptx updates p:xfrm/a:ext on the graphicFrame.

setSmartArtColorsOp.description: 换成库内对应色板模板。
setSmartArtColorsOp.descriptionEn: Switch to the matching color-palette template in the library.
setSmartArtColorsOp.limits: 包里已有相同 uniqueId 的 colors 部件则只改 r:cs 指向它；否则写入新部件并改 r:cs。不认识的取值报 InvalidField。找不到图示报 IdNotFound。id 不是图示 id 报 InvalidId。
setSmartArtColorsOp.limitsEn: If the package already has a colors part with the same uniqueId, only retarget r:cs to it; otherwise write a new part and update r:cs. An unrecognized value returns InvalidField. A missing diagram returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a diagram id returns InvalidId.

setSmartArtStyleOp.description: 换成库内对应 quickStyle 模板。
setSmartArtStyleOp.descriptionEn: Switch to the matching quickStyle template in the library.
setSmartArtStyleOp.limits: 包里已有相同 uniqueId 的 style 部件则只改 r:qs；否则写入新部件并改 r:qs。不认识的取值报 InvalidField。找不到图示报 IdNotFound。id 不是图示 id 报 InvalidId。
setSmartArtStyleOp.limitsEn: If the package already has a style part with the same uniqueId, only update r:qs; otherwise write a new part and update r:qs. An unrecognized value returns InvalidField. A missing diagram returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a diagram id returns InvalidId.

setSmartArtLayoutOp.limits: 不认识的短名报 InvalidField。当前 uniqueId 已经是目标那一条：空操作，仍计入 opsApplied。 当前 uniqueId 属于库内 list / org / cycle 三族之一：把 layout 部件换成库内对应模板，并改 r:lo；可见点与 parOf 连接不动。 目标是 list 或 cycle 时，助手点改成普通节点，以免文字在新版式里消失。删掉 diagram drawing 缓存，让 Office 打开时重排。 当前 uniqueId 不在这三族里报 NotImplemented，不写文件。
setSmartArtLayoutOp.limitsEn: An unrecognized short name returns InvalidField. If the current uniqueId is already the target entry, this is a no-op and still counts toward opsApplied. If the current uniqueId is one of the library's list / org / cycle families: replace the layout part with the matching library template and update r:lo; visible points and parOf connections stay. When the target is list or cycle, assistant points become ordinary nodes so text does not disappear in the new layout. Delete the diagram drawing cache so Office lays the diagram out again on open. If the current uniqueId is outside those three families, NotImplemented is returned and nothing is written.

insertTableOp.description: 写出带单线边框的 w:tbl，每列宽 1440 twip，每格至少一段并带新的 w14:paraId。
insertTableOp.descriptionEn: Write a w:tbl with a single-line border, each column 1440 twips wide, and at least one paragraph per cell with a new w14:paraId.
insertTableOp.limits: docx 插在单元格时，嵌套表放在该格 tcPr 之后、已有段落之前。格末仍保留一个 w:p。Word 16.0 在文本框单元格里插表另存也是这个顺序；把等宽嵌套表接到格尾会报无法读取。rows / cols 越界或不是正整数报 InvalidField。id 形态不对报 InvalidId。找不到锚点报 IdNotFound。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
insertTableOp.limitsEn: When docx inserts into a cell, the nested table is placed after that cell's tcPr and before existing paragraphs. One w:p remains at the end of the cell. Word 16.0 saves a table inserted into a text-box cell in this same order; appending an equal-width nested table at the end of the cell makes the file unreadable. rows / cols out of range, or not a positive integer, returns InvalidField. A malformed id returns InvalidId. A missing anchor returns IdNotFound. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField.

deleteTableOp.limits: 若删的是正文里仅剩的块级内容，在 sectPr 前补一个空的 w:p。若删的是单元格里的嵌套表，该格至少留下一个 w:p。表不存在报 IdNotFound。id 不是表 id 报 InvalidId。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx：删掉对应 p:graphicFrame。若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。组合里删子框后若组合空了，把空 p:grpSp 一并摘掉。不改其它对象的 cNvPr/@id。
deleteTableOp.limitsEn: If this was the last block-level content in the body, insert an empty w:p before sectPr. If a nested table inside a cell is deleted, that cell keeps at least one w:p. A missing table returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a table id returns InvalidId. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. pptx: delete the matching p:graphicFrame. If it is in the Choice of mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. After a child frame is removed from a group, remove an empty p:grpSp as well. Do not change other objects' cNvPr/@id.

insertRowOp.description: 新行按参照行（表 id 时用最后一行，行 id 时用该行）的 gridSpan 布局复制格子，不复制 vMerge，每格一段空文本。
insertRowOp.descriptionEn: The new row copies cells from the reference row's gridSpan layout (the last row when the id is a table, that row when the id is a row), does not copy vMerge, and puts one empty paragraph in each cell.
insertRowOp.limits: xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx：往 a:tbl 插入一行 a:tr。参照行的 gridSpan / hMerge 布局复制，不复制 vMerge / rowSpan，每格空 a:txBody。行高抄参照行的 a:tr/@h，缺则均分当前框高。id 不是表 id 也不是行 id 报 InvalidId。某行占的列数对不上 colCount 报 NotImplemented，不写文件。
insertRowOp.limitsEn: This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. pptx: insert one a:tr into a:tbl. Copy the reference row's gridSpan / hMerge layout, and do not copy vMerge / rowSpan. Each cell gets an empty a:txBody. Row height copies a:tr/@h from the reference row; if it is missing, split the current frame height evenly. An id that is neither a table id nor a row id returns InvalidId. A row whose column count does not match colCount returns NotImplemented and writes nothing.

deleteRowOp.limits: 只剩一行时报 InvalidField。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx：删掉该 a:tr。只剩一行时报 InvalidField。id 不是行 id 报 InvalidId。 找不到报 IdNotFound。该行含 rowSpan 起点或 vMerge 继续格时报 NotImplemented，不写文件。
deleteRowOp.limitsEn: If only one row remains, InvalidField is returned. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. pptx: delete that a:tr. If only one row remains, InvalidField is returned. An id that is not a row id returns InvalidId. A missing id returns IdNotFound. A row that contains a rowSpan start or a vMerge continuation cell returns NotImplemented and writes nothing.

insertColOp.description: 新列宽抄相邻列；没有 tblGrid 时先按当前布局补上，缺宽则 1440 twip。
insertColOp.descriptionEn: The new column width copies the adjacent column. If there is no tblGrid, build one from the current layout first; a missing width is 1440 twips.
insertColOp.limits: 插入点落在某格 gridSpan 内部时，该格 gridSpan 加 1，不新开 w:tc。否则每行在该处插入一个新格。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx：在 a:tblGrid 插入 a:gridCol，宽度抄相邻列。插入点落在某格 gridSpan 内部时，该格 gridSpan 加 1，并补一个 hMerge 继续格。否则每行插入一个空 a:tc。after 越界报 InvalidField。
insertColOp.limitsEn: If the insertion point falls inside a cell's gridSpan, that cell's gridSpan increases by 1 and no new w:tc is opened. Otherwise each row inserts a new cell there. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. pptx: insert an a:gridCol into a:tblGrid, with the width copied from the adjacent column. If the insertion point falls inside a cell's gridSpan, that cell's gridSpan increases by 1 and an hMerge continuation cell is added. Otherwise each row inserts an empty a:tc. after out of range returns InvalidField.

deleteColOp.limits: 只剩一列时报 InvalidField。该列落在某格 gridSpan 内部时，gridSpan 减 1；减到 0 则删掉该 w:tc。xlsx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。 pptx：删掉对应 a:gridCol。该列落在某格 gridSpan 内部时，gridSpan 减 1；纯 hMerge 继续格则删掉该 a:tc。只剩一列时报 InvalidField。 col 越界报 InvalidField。某行占的列数对不上 colCount 报 NotImplemented。
deleteColOp.limitsEn: If only one column remains, InvalidField is returned. If the column falls inside a cell's gridSpan, gridSpan decreases by 1; at 0 that w:tc is deleted. This op on xlsx returns InvalidField. pptx: delete the matching a:gridCol. If the column falls inside a cell's gridSpan, gridSpan decreases by 1; a pure hMerge continuation cell deletes that a:tc. If only one column remains, InvalidField is returned. col out of range returns InvalidField. A row whose column count does not match colCount returns NotImplemented.

insertTextBoxOp.limits: id 必须是段落 id，对图 id、框 id、容器 id、框内段落 id 或 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。找不到该段报 IdNotFound。 cx / cy 都省略时用 2 英寸宽、1 英寸高（1828800 / 914400）。只给一个时报 InvalidField。 插入浮动 anchor + wrapSquare，挂在该段末尾一个新的 w:r 里，写成 mc:AlternateContent（Choice 为 wps:wsp / wps:txbx，Fallback 为空白 w:pict，不编 VML 几何）。
insertTextBoxOp.limitsEn: id must be a paragraph id. A picture id, text box id, container id, in-box paragraph id, or section:{n} returns InvalidId. A missing paragraph returns IdNotFound. When both cx and cy are omitted, the box is 2 inches wide and 1 inch high (1828800 / 914400). Giving only one of them returns InvalidField. Insert a floating anchor with wrapSquare, in a new w:r at the end of that paragraph, written as mc:AlternateContent (Choice is wps:wsp / wps:txbx, Fallback is an empty w:pict, and no VML geometry is authored).

deleteTextBoxOp.limits: 找不到该框报 IdNotFound。对段落 id、图 id、容器 id 或 section:{n} 报 InvalidId。 按框 id 删掉对应的 w:drawing；若在 mc:AlternateContent 的 Choice 里，整段 AlternateContent 删掉。 所在 w:r 若删完后只剩 w:rPr 或空，把该 run 也删掉。链接链从中间删时，把前一框的 next 接到后一框、后一框的 prev 接到前一框， 并改写 wps:txbx / linkedTxbx 的 id 与 seq。
deleteTextBoxOp.limitsEn: A missing text box returns IdNotFound. A paragraph id, picture id, container id, or section:{n} returns InvalidId. Delete the w:drawing for that text box id; if it is inside the Choice of mc:AlternateContent, delete the whole AlternateContent. If the host w:r then contains only w:rPr or is empty, delete that run too. When deleting from the middle of a link chain, point the previous box's next at the following box and the following box's prev at the previous box, and rewrite id and seq on wps:txbx / linkedTxbx.

setTextBoxSizeOp.limits: docx 的 id 必须是框 id。xlsx 的 id 可以是文本框 id、形状 id 或连接线 id。docx 写入该框 wp:extent；若 wps:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext 存在，一并改。xlsx 规则与图相同：oneCell / absolute 改 xdr:ext，twoCell 改右下角 to。pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxSizeOp.limitsEn: For docx, id must be a text box id. For xlsx, id may be a text box id, a shape id, or a connector id. docx writes that box's wp:extent; if wps:spPr/a:xfrm/a:ext exists, update it too. xlsx follows pictures: oneCell / absolute updates xdr:ext, and twoCell updates the bottom-right to. This op on pptx returns InvalidField.

setPictureAnchorOp.description: 改图片在工作表上的锚点。
setPictureAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Change a picture's anchor on the worksheet.
setPictureAnchorOp.limits: anchor、位置字段、editAs、cx / cy 至少给一类，否则报 InvalidField。找不到该图报 IdNotFound。id 不是 xlsx 图 id 报 InvalidId。 docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。pptx 改画布坐标请用 setPicturePos。
setPictureAnchorOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of anchor, position fields, editAs, and cx / cy, or InvalidField is returned. A missing picture returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an xlsx picture id returns InvalidId. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField. To change pptx canvas coordinates, use setPicturePos.

setTextBoxAnchorOp.limits: id 可以是 xlsx 文本框 id、形状 id 或连接线 id。改包含该 xdr:sp 或 xdr:cxnSp 的外层锚点，规则与 setPictureAnchor 相同（留下该对象或其所在 xdr:grpSp，以及 xdr:clientData）。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setTextBoxAnchorOp.limitsEn: id may be an xlsx text box id, shape id, or connector id. Update the outer anchor that contains that xdr:sp or xdr:cxnSp, with the same rules as setPictureAnchor (that object, or the xdr:grpSp it sits in, and xdr:clientData, stay). This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setInkAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setPictureAnchor 相同，id 必须是 xlsx 墨迹 id。
setInkAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureAnchor. id must be an xlsx ink id.
setInkAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 xdr14 AlternateContent 的外层锚点。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setInkAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the outer anchor that contains that xdr14 AlternateContent. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setModel3dAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setPictureAnchor 相同，id 必须是 xlsx 3D 模型 id。
setModel3dAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureAnchor. id must be an xlsx 3D model id.
setModel3dAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 am3d AlternateContent 的外层锚点，规则与 setPictureAnchor 相同（留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData）。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setModel3dAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the outer anchor that contains that am3d AlternateContent, with the same rules as setPictureAnchor (AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay). This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setMathAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setPictureAnchor 相同，id 必须是公式框 id。
setMathAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureAnchor. id must be an equation box id.
setMathAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 a14:m AlternateContent 的外层锚点，规则与 setPictureAnchor 相同（留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData）。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。对公式框 id 发 setTextBoxAnchor 仍报 InvalidId。
setMathAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the outer anchor that contains that a14:m AlternateContent, with the same rules as setPictureAnchor (AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay). This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField. setTextBoxAnchor on an equation box id still returns InvalidId.

setSlicerAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setPictureAnchor 相同，id 必须是切片器 id（含时间线）。
setSlicerAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureAnchor. id must be a slicer id (including a timeline).
setSlicerAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 graphicFrame 的外层锚点，规则与 setPictureAnchor 相同（留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData）。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlicerAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the outer anchor that contains that graphicFrame, with the same rules as setPictureAnchor (AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay). This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setChartAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setPictureAnchor 相同，id 必须是 xlsx 图表 id。
setChartAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setPictureAnchor. id must be an xlsx chart id.
setChartAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 xdr:graphicFrame 的锚点，规则与 setPictureAnchor 相同（留下 xdr:graphicFrame 与 xdr:clientData）。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setChartAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the anchor that contains that xdr:graphicFrame, with the same rules as setPictureAnchor (xdr:graphicFrame and xdr:clientData stay). This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setSmartArtAnchorOp.description: 字段与 setChartAnchor 相同，id 必须是 xlsx 图示 id。
setSmartArtAnchorOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as setChartAnchor. id must be an xlsx diagram id.
setSmartArtAnchorOp.limits: 改包含该 xdr:graphicFrame 的外层锚点，规则与 setChartAnchor 相同。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSmartArtAnchorOp.limitsEn: Update the outer anchor that contains that xdr:graphicFrame, with the same rules as setChartAnchor. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setCellOp.description: 改一个单元格的值或公式。
setCellOp.descriptionEn: Change a cell's value or formula.
setCellOp.limits: value 和 formula 二选一，不能同时出现。arrayRef、sharedRef、dataTableRef 只能出现一个，shared 与 array 也不能同时为真。新建数据表要同时给 TABLE 公式和 dataTableRef。不改超链接，不改迷你图。不要把从属格当成主格来写。
setCellOp.limitsEn: Give exactly one of value and formula; they cannot both appear. At most one of arrayRef, sharedRef, and dataTableRef may appear, and shared and array cannot both be true. A new data table needs both a TABLE formula and dataTableRef. Do not change hyperlinks or sparklines. Do not write a dependent cell as if it were the master cell.

dataTableRef.description: 新建数据表的结果区域。主格必须是左上角。与已有区域不同则不写。
dataTableRef.descriptionEn: Result range of a new data table. The master cell must be the top-left. A different range on an existing table is rejected.

rgb.description: 6 位或 8 位十六进制。写入时改为大写；6 位前面补 FF。
rgb.descriptionEn: 6 or 8 hex digits. Written in uppercase; 6 digits get an FF prefix.

setCellStyleOp.description: 写单元格的数字格式、字体、填充、边框与对齐。
setCellStyleOp.descriptionEn: Write a cell's number format, font, fill, border, and alignment.
setCellStyleOp.limitsEn: Does not change the value or the formula.

setColWidthOp.limits: JSON 的 width 是 Excel 列宽字符数（与 COM ColumnWidth 同一套），不是像素。写入 col/@width 时按 ECMA-376 §18.3.1.13 的公式转换；MDW 固定用该节示例的 Calibri 11 点 7 像素，不读实际字体、不算最适列宽。
setColWidthOp.limitsEn: JSON width is the Excel column-width character count (the same scale as COM ColumnWidth), not pixels. When writing col/@width, convert with the formula in ECMA-376 §18.3.1.13. MDW is fixed at that section's example, Calibri 11 pt and 7 pixels. The actual font is not read, and best-fit width is not calculated.

setRowHeightOp.limits: 单位磅，对应 row/@ht。不算自动换行后的高度。
setRowHeightOp.limitsEn: The unit is points, stored in row/@ht. Wrapped-text height is not calculated.

mergeRangeOp.limits: 不要跟 Word 表的 mergeCells 混用。
mergeRangeOp.limitsEn: Do not confuse this with Word table mergeCells.

unmergeRangeOp.limits: 不恢复合并时清掉的值。
unmergeRangeOp.limitsEn: Does not restore values cleared by the merge.

insertCellStyleOp.description: 往 styles.xml 追加一条命名单元格样式。
insertCellStyleOp.descriptionEn: Append one named cell style to styles.xml.
insertCellStyleOp.limitsEn: Does not apply the style to any cell.

deleteCellStyleOp.description: 删掉一条命名单元格样式。
deleteCellStyleOp.limits: 不删 cellStyleXfs，不改格子上已有 s。
deleteCellStyleOp.limitsEn: Does not delete cellStyleXfs and does not change s already on cells.

setCellNamedStyleOp.description: 把单元格的 s 指到一条引用该命名样式 xfId 的 cellXfs。
setCellNamedStyleOp.descriptionEn: Point the cell's s at a cellXfs entry that references that named style's xfId.

xlsxWorkbook.description: 新建工作簿时的正文，只在 create 里使用。
xlsxWorkbook.descriptionEn: Body of a new workbook. Use it only with create.
xlsxWorkbook.limits: 不要把它当成 apply 的补丁。
xlsxWorkbook.limitsEn: Do not send it as an apply patch.

dataFrom.description: dataFrom 是单个单元格地址，例如 A1。不要写范围（A1:E19），不要写表名（Sheet!A1）。它不是「图表去引用哪一块已有单元格」。series 里的分类和数值会按这个格子当左上角，写进工作表，挡住的格子会被盖掉。分类写在这一列的下一行起；每个系列的名字写在这一行、向右逐列；数值写在名字下面。气泡图每个系列占两列。已经手写了表格时，把 dataFrom 指到空区域，不要指到那张表的表头。

background.description: 工作表背景图的本地路径。只许 worksheet。图表工作表带这个字段会在解析时被拒绝。
background.descriptionEn: Local path of the worksheet background. Worksheets only. A chart sheet that includes this field is rejected while parsing.

dataFrom.description: dataFrom 是单个单元格地址，例如 A1。不要写范围（A1:E19），不要写表名（Sheet!A1）。它不是「图表去引用哪一块已有单元格」。series 里的分类和数值会按这个格子当左上角，写进工作表，挡住的格子会被盖掉。分类写在这一列的下一行起；每个系列的名字写在这一行、向右逐列；数值写在名字下面。气泡图每个系列占两列。已经手写了表格时，把 dataFrom 指到空区域，不要指到那张表的表头。

xlsxInsertModel3dOp.description: 把本地 GLB 作为 3D 模型写入目标工作表。
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Write a local GLB as a 3D model on the target worksheet.
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不栅格化模型。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。
xlsxInsertModel3dOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. The model is not rasterized. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder.

xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.description: 换 GLB 字节，保留 graphicFrame 与关系 id。
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.descriptionEn: Replace the GLB bytes. Keep the graphicFrame and the relationship id.
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.limits: 海报仍写成 1×1 PNG。不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。不是 GLB 报 InvalidField。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxReplaceModel3dOp.limitsEn: The poster stays a 1×1 PNG. Position and size are unchanged. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. A non-GLB file returns InvalidField. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxDeleteModel3dOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 3D 模型 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 GLB 与海报无人引用则删。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxDeleteModel3dOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a 3D model id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the GLB and the poster are unreferenced, delete them. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxInsertInkOp.description: 把本地 InkML 作为一笔墨迹写入目标工作表。
xlsxInsertInkOp.descriptionEn: Write a local InkML file as one ink stroke on the target worksheet.
xlsxInsertInkOp.limits: 不进 pictures。不把手写识别成字。海报用 1×1 PNG 占位。
xlsxInsertInkOp.limitsEn: It is not a picture. Handwriting is not recognized as text. The poster is a 1×1 PNG placeholder.

xlsxReplaceInkOp.description: 换 InkML 字节，保留 contentPart 与关系 id。
xlsxReplaceInkOp.descriptionEn: Replace the InkML bytes. Keep the contentPart and the relationship id.
xlsxReplaceInkOp.limits: 不改海报，不改位置尺寸。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。不是 InkML 报 InvalidField。
xlsxReplaceInkOp.limitsEn: Do not change the poster, and do not change position or size. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId. A non-InkML file returns InvalidField.

xlsxDeleteInkOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是墨迹 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 InkML 与海报无人引用则删。
xlsxDeleteInkOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an ink id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the InkML and the poster are unreferenced, delete them.

xlsxSetInkSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.limits: id 必须是墨迹 id。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。对图 id 发此 op、对墨迹 id 发 setPictureSize 仍报 InvalidId。
xlsxSetInkSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an ink id. oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. This op on a picture id, or setPictureSize on an ink id, still returns InvalidId.

xlsxInsertMathOp.description: 把一条线性公式写入目标工作表 drawing。
xlsxInsertMathOp.descriptionEn: Write one linear formula into the target worksheet drawing.
xlsxInsertMathOp.limits: 不进单元格 f。不进 textBoxes。不实现排版引擎。
xlsxInsertMathOp.limitsEn: It does not go into a cell f. It does not go into textBoxes. No layout engine is implemented.

xlsxSetMathOp.descriptionEn: Do not change the anchor or the size.
xlsxSetMathOp.limits: 出现 expr / kind 报 InvalidField。空 text 报 InvalidField。出现 x / y / cx / cy / from / to 报未知字段。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxSetMathOp.limitsEn: expr / kind returns InvalidField. An empty text returns InvalidField. x / y / cx / cy / from / to returns UnknownField. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an equation box id returns InvalidId. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxDeleteMathOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是公式框 id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent；若锚点只剩 from / to / ext / pos / clientData 则删整个锚点。 海报无人引用则删。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxDeleteMathOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an equation box id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent; if the anchor has only from / to / ext / pos / clientData left, delete the whole anchor. If the poster is unreferenced, delete it. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxSetMathSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.limits: id 必须是公式框 id。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。不按列宽行高去换算 EMU。留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData。对文本框 id 发此 op、对公式框 id 发 setTextBoxSize 仍报 InvalidId。docx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
xlsxSetMathSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be an equation box id. oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. EMU is not converted from column width or row height. AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay. This op on a text box id, or setTextBoxSize on an equation box id, still returns InvalidId. This op on docx returns InvalidField.

setFormControlOp.description: 改一个已有窗体控件的标题、链接、列表、勾选或选中项。
setFormControlOp.descriptionEn: Change the caption, link, list, check state, or selected item of an existing form control.
setFormControlOp.limits: 只改已有的按钮、复选框、下拉。caption 同时写 Choice 的 a:t 和 VML 文本框，空字符串不合法。fmlaLink、fmlaRange 为 null 时两处一起去掉。checked 为 true 时写 checked=Checked 和 x:Checked 为 1，为 false 时两处一起去掉。有链接格时同时把该格写成布尔值。sel 同时写 formControlPr 和 x:Sel，不改 val。按钮不能设链接、列表、勾选、选中项。复选框不能设列表和选中项。下拉不能设链接和勾选。没有 a:t 或没有 VML 文本框时不能设 caption。一个字段都不给则报错。不改对象名和锚点。不插入、不删除。只能改 worksheet。
setFormControlOp.limitsEn: Only an existing button, check box, or drop-down can be changed. caption is written to both the Choice a:t and the VML text box; an empty string is invalid. A null fmlaLink or fmlaRange removes both copies. checked true writes checked=Checked and x:Checked 1; false removes both. When a link cell exists, that cell is also written as a boolean. sel is written to both formControlPr and x:Sel, and val is left unchanged. A button cannot take a link, list, check state, or selected item. A check box cannot take a list or selected item. A drop-down cannot take a link or check state. caption is rejected when a:t or the VML text box is missing. Giving no field is an error. The object name and anchor are not changed. There is no insert or delete. Only a worksheet can be changed.

insertFormControlOp.description: 在工作表上新建按钮、复选框或下拉。
insertFormControlOp.descriptionEn: Add a button, check box, or drop-down to a worksheet.
insertFormControlOp.limits: 只插入按钮、复选框、下拉。四处一起写：工作表 control、drawing 里 Choice 的形状、VML 形状、ctrlProp。按钮和复选框必须给 caption，下拉不能给。fmlaLink 只用于复选框，fmlaRange 和 sel 只用于下拉。checked 只用于复选框。有本表链接格时同时把该格写成布尔值。sel 省略时写成 0。val 写成 0。from 和 to 是单元格。偏移是 EMU，省略为 0。VML 的 x:Anchor 只记单元格，偏移写 0。对象名按已有名字末尾数字加一。不改已有控件的锚点。不插入其他类型，不认 ActiveX。只能用于 worksheet。
insertFormControlOp.limitsEn: Only a button, check box, or drop-down can be inserted. The worksheet control, the Choice shape, the VML shape, and ctrlProp are written together. caption is required for a button or check box and rejected for a drop-down. fmlaLink is only for a check box. fmlaRange and sel are only for a drop-down. checked is only for a check box. A link on this sheet is also written as a boolean cell. Omitted sel is written as 0. val is written as 0. from and to are cells. Offsets are EMUs and default to 0. The VML x:Anchor records cells only, with zero inner offsets. The object name uses the next trailing number. Existing anchors are left unchanged. Other control types and ActiveX are not inserted. Only a worksheet is accepted.

deleteFormControlOp.description: 删掉一个已在树上的窗体控件。
deleteFormControlOp.descriptionEn: Delete one form control that is already on the tree.
deleteFormControlOp.limits: 按窗体控件 id 摘掉工作表 control、drawing 里对应的 Choice 锚点、VML 形状，以及 ctrlProp 部件、关系和内容类型。不删 drawing 与 vmlDrawing 部件。控件删光后去掉 controls。对不上的 id 报 IdNotFound，部件原样。只能用于 worksheet。
deleteFormControlOp.limitsEn: The worksheet control, the matching Choice anchor, the VML shape, and the ctrlProp part, relationship, and content type are removed together. The drawing and vmlDrawing parts stay. An empty controls element is removed. An id that does not match returns IdNotFound and leaves the parts unchanged. Only a worksheet is accepted.

insertDataValidationOp.description: 往工作表追加一条数据验证（ECMA-376 §18.3.1.32）。
insertDataValidationOp.descriptionEn: Append one data validation to the worksheet (ECMA-376 §18.3.1.32).
insertDataValidationOp.limits: 公式当字符串，不求值，不展开下拉列表。
insertDataValidationOp.limitsEn: The formula is stored as a string. It is not evaluated, and the drop-down list is not expanded.

setDataValidationOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

insertConditionalFormatOp.descriptionEn: Append one conditional formatting rule to the worksheet (ECMA-376 §18.3.1.18 / §18.3.1.10).
insertConditionalFormatOp.limits: 公式当字符串，不求值。不渲染色阶、数据条或图标。始终新建一块 <conditionalFormatting>（一块一条规则），追加到已有条件格式之后、dataValidations 之前。
insertConditionalFormatOp.limitsEn: The formula is stored as a string and is not evaluated. Color scales, data bars, and icon sets are not rendered. Always create a new <conditionalFormatting> block (one rule per block), appended after existing conditional formatting and before dataValidations.

setConditionalFormatOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

insertDefinedNameOp.description: 往工作簿追加一条定义名（ECMA-376 §18.2.5）。
insertDefinedNameOp.descriptionEn: Append one defined name to the workbook (ECMA-376 §18.2.5).
insertDefinedNameOp.limits: 公式当字符串写入元素文本，不解析、不求值。
insertDefinedNameOp.limitsEn: Write the formula into the element text as a string. Do not parse it and do not evaluate it.

setDefinedNameOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

insertCustomViewOp.description: 把当前窗口设置存成一条自定义视图。
insertCustomViewOp.descriptionEn: Save the current window settings as one custom view.
insertCustomViewOp.limitsEn: Do not restore hidden rows or columns.

deleteCustomViewOp.description: 去掉该 <customWorkbookView>，以及各表上同一 guid 的 <customSheetView>。
deleteCustomViewOp.descriptionEn: Remove that <customWorkbookView>, and the <customSheetView> with the same guid on each sheet.
deleteCustomViewOp.limits: 删光则去掉 <customWorkbookViews> / 空的 <customSheetViews>。找不到该序号报 IdNotFound。id 不是自定义视图 id 报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。不标重算。
deleteCustomViewOp.limitsEn: When none remain, remove <customWorkbookViews> and empty <customSheetViews>. A missing index returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a custom view id returns InvalidId. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField. Do not mark the file for recalculation.

showCustomViewOp.description: 按快照把窗格写回当前默认视图。
showCustomViewOp.descriptionEn: Write the panes from the snapshot back onto the current default view.

insertConnectionOp.description: 把网页查询或文本连接写入工作簿 Connections 部件。
insertConnectionOp.descriptionEn: Write a web query or a text connection into the workbook Connections part.
insertConnectionOp.limits: 不向数据源发请求，不把查询结果写进单元格，不写 queryTable。
insertConnectionOp.limitsEn: Do not send a request to the data source, do not write query results into cells, and do not write a queryTable.

deleteConnectionOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是连接 id 报 InvalidId。摘该条 connection。删光则去掉 Connections 部件、workbook 关系与 Override。 不改 queryTable / sheetData。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteConnectionOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a connection id returns InvalidId. Remove that connection. When none remain, remove the Connections part, the workbook relationship, and the Override. Do not change queryTable / sheetData. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertExternalLinkOp.description: 把对其他工作簿的外部引用写入 /xl/externalLinks/…。
insertExternalLinkOp.descriptionEn: Write an external reference to another workbook under /xl/externalLinks/….
insertExternalLinkOp.limits: 不打开目标文件，不把缓存值写进 sheetDataSet，也不改单元格公式。
insertExternalLinkOp.limitsEn: Do not open the target file, do not write cached values into sheetDataSet, and do not change cell formulas.

deleteExternalLinkOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是外部引用 id 报 InvalidId。引用这条链接的单元格和图表公式换成已有缓存值，没有缓存则写 0。定义名里的对应引用换成 #REF!。更大的 [n] 依次减一。字符串不改。引号不配对报 InvalidField，不写文件。
deleteExternalLinkOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an external-reference id returns InvalidId. Cell and chart formulas that use this link become their cached value, or 0 when there is no cache. The matching reference in a defined name becomes #REF!. Larger [n] indexes decrease by one. Text inside strings stays. An unmatched quote returns InvalidField and nothing is written.

setExternalLinkOp.description: 改已有外部引用的路径。
setExternalLinkOp.descriptionEn: Change the path of an existing external reference.
setExternalLinkOp.limits: 不打开目标文件，不刷新 sheetDataSet，也不改单元格公式里的 [n]。
setExternalLinkOp.limitsEn: Do not open the target file, do not refresh sheetDataSet, and do not change [n] in cell formulas.

xlsxInsertOleOp.description: 把本地文件作为嵌入对象写入目标工作表。
xlsxInsertOleOp.descriptionEn: Embed a local file as an OLE object on the target worksheet.
xlsxInsertOleOp.limits: 不在库里启动 OLE 服务器，不生成真实预览图（写入一张最小 PNG 占位）。不进页眉、chartsheet、组合。
xlsxInsertOleOp.limitsEn: This library does not start an OLE server and does not draw a real preview (it writes a minimal PNG placeholder). It does not go into headers, a chartsheet, or a group.

xlsxDeleteOleOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是 OLE id 报 InvalidId。 摘该条 mc:AlternateContent（或裸的 oleObject）、对应 dummy xdr:sp 所在锚点、以及 VML 里 _x0000_s{shapeId} 的 v:shape。 oleObjects 删光则去掉该元素。清掉无人引用的关系与 embeddings / 预览媒体。docx / pptx 见各自分册。
xlsxDeleteOleOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not an OLE id returns InvalidId. Remove that mc:AlternateContent (or a bare oleObject), the anchor of the matching dummy xdr:sp, and the v:shape _x0000_s{shapeId} in the VML. When no oleObjects remain, remove that element. Clear unreferenced relationships and embeddings / preview media. See the docx and pptx books.

xlsxSetOleSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同，id 必须是 OLE id。
xlsxSetOleSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize. id must be an OLE id.
xlsxSetOleSizeOp.limits: objectPr/anchor 为 twoCell 时必须给 to，可选 toOffX / toOffY。cx / cy 在这种锚点上出现报 InvalidField。同时改 dummy xdr:twoCellAnchor 的 to，以及 VML x:Anchor 的右下角单元格。不按列宽行高换算 EMU。没有 objectPr、锚点是 oneCell 或 absolute 时，改 xdr:ext。不启动 OLE 服务器，不改 embeddings。
xlsxSetOleSizeOp.limitsEn: When objectPr/anchor is twoCell, to is required and toOffX / toOffY are optional. cx / cy on that anchor returns InvalidField. Also update to on the dummy xdr:twoCellAnchor and the bottom-right cell of the VML x:Anchor. Do not convert EMU from column width or row height. When there is no objectPr and the anchor is oneCell or absolute, update xdr:ext. Do not start an OLE server, and do not change embeddings.

insertProtectedRangeOp.description: 往工作表追加一条允许编辑区域（ECMA-376 §18.3.1.71）。
insertProtectedRangeOp.descriptionEn: Append one allowed-edit range to the worksheet (ECMA-376 §18.3.1.71).
insertProtectedRangeOp.limits: 区域在工作表保护打开且单元格锁定时生效。不标重算。
insertProtectedRangeOp.limitsEn: The range takes effect when worksheet protection is on and the cells are locked. Do not mark the file for recalculation.

setProtectedRangeOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

deleteProtectedRangeOp.description: 删掉一条允许编辑区域。

insertChartSheetOp.limits: xlsx：id 不是 xlsx:workbook 报 InvalidId。name 非法报 InvalidField。与已有表重名（不分大小写）报 InvalidField。 找不到 dataSheet 报 IdNotFound。dataSheet 不是 worksheet，或省略时工作簿里没有 worksheet，报 InvalidField。 出现 from / to / anchor / 偏移 / kind / wrap 报 InvalidField。类型与系列限制与 insertChart 相同。
insertChartSheetOp.limitsEn: xlsx: an id that is not xlsx:workbook returns InvalidId. An illegal name returns InvalidField. A name that duplicates an existing sheet (case-insensitive) returns InvalidField. A missing dataSheet returns IdNotFound. If dataSheet is not a worksheet, or it is omitted and the workbook has no worksheet, InvalidField is returned. from / to / anchor / offsets / kind / wrap return InvalidField. Type and series limits are the same as insertChart.

dataFrom.description: dataFrom 是单个单元格地址，例如 A1。不要写范围（A1:E19），不要写表名（Sheet!A1）。它不是「图表去引用哪一块已有单元格」。series 里的分类和数值会按这个格子当左上角，写进工作表，挡住的格子会被盖掉。分类写在这一列的下一行起；每个系列的名字写在这一行、向右逐列；数值写在名字下面。气泡图每个系列占两列。已经手写了表格时，把 dataFrom 指到空区域，不要指到那张表的表头。

deleteChartSheetOp.limits: 找不到该表报 IdNotFound。id 不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。对 worksheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet 发此 op 报 InvalidId。 删掉工作簿里最后一张表报 InvalidField。删掉最后一张可见表报 InvalidField。 去掉 workbook 表项、chartsheet 部件及其 drawing / chart（无人引用则删），以及对应关系与内容类型。不删 dataFrom 那些单元格。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteChartSheetOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a sheet id returns InvalidId. This op on a worksheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet returns InvalidId. Deleting the last sheet in the workbook returns InvalidField. Deleting the last visible sheet returns InvalidField. Remove the workbook sheet entry, the chartsheet part and its drawing / chart (deleted if unreferenced), and the matching relationships and content types. Do not delete the cells from dataFrom. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertSheetOp.limits: xlsx：id 不是 xlsx:workbook 报 InvalidId。name 非法报 InvalidSheetName。与已有表重名（不分大小写）报 DuplicateSheetName。 after 找不到报 IdNotFound；不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。不要用本 op 新建图表工作表。 新建最小 worksheet 部件（空 sheetData，CT 与 create 相同），workbook 关系 Type 以 /worksheet 结尾，sheetId 取已有最大整数加 1。
insertSheetOp.limitsEn: xlsx: an id that is not xlsx:workbook returns InvalidId. An illegal name returns InvalidSheetName. A name that duplicates an existing sheet (case-insensitive) returns DuplicateSheetName. A missing after returns IdNotFound; an id that is not a sheet id returns InvalidId. Do not use this op to create a chart sheet. Create a minimal worksheet part (empty sheetData, the same content type as create). The workbook relationship Type ends with /worksheet. sheetId is the largest existing integer plus 1.

deleteSheetOp.limits: 找不到该表报 IdNotFound。id 不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。对 chartsheet 发此 op 报 InvalidId（请用 deleteChartSheet）。 对 dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 NotImplemented。删掉工作簿里最后一张表，或删掉最后一张可见表，报 InvalidField。 引用该表的公式、定义名和图表改成 #REF!；三维引用只去掉被删的一端。字符串和外部工作簿引用不改。引号不配对报 InvalidField，不写文件。
deleteSheetOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a sheet id returns InvalidId. This op on a chartsheet returns InvalidId (use deleteChartSheet). dialogsheet / macrosheet returns NotImplemented. Deleting the last sheet in the workbook, or the last visible sheet, returns InvalidField. Formulas, defined names, and charts that refer to the sheet become #REF!; a 3D reference only drops the deleted end. Strings and external workbook references stay. An unmatched quote returns InvalidField and nothing is written.

renameSheetOp.limits: 找不到该表报 IdNotFound。id 不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。对 dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 NotImplemented。 name 非法报 InvalidSheetName。与另一张表重名（不分大小写）报 DuplicateSheetName。已经是目标名（大小写相同）则空操作，仍计入 opsApplied。 只改大小写时仍改 sheet/@name。公式、定义名、图表和透视缓存里的旧表名改成新表名，引号按 Excel 的规则重算。字符串和外部工作簿引用不改。引号不配对报 InvalidField，不写文件。
renameSheetOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a sheet id returns InvalidId. dialogsheet / macrosheet returns NotImplemented. An illegal name returns InvalidSheetName. A name that duplicates another sheet (case-insensitive) returns DuplicateSheetName. If the name is already the target (same case), this is a no-op and still counts toward opsApplied. A case-only change still updates sheet/@name. Formulas, defined names, charts, and pivot caches replace the old sheet name with the new one, and quotes follow Excel's rule. Strings and external workbook references stay. An unmatched quote returns InvalidField and nothing is written.

moveSheetOp.limits: 找不到该表或 after 报 IdNotFound。id / after 不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。after 与 id 是同一张表报 InvalidField。 对 dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 NotImplemented。已经在目标位置则空操作。 只改 workbook.xml 里 sheets 子元素顺序，不改部件路径、sheetId 或关系 id。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
moveSheetOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet or after returns IdNotFound. If id or after is not a sheet id, InvalidId is returned. If after and id are the same sheet, InvalidField is returned. dialogsheet / macrosheet returns NotImplemented. If it is already at the target position, this is a no-op. Only the order of sheets children in workbook.xml changes. Part paths, sheetId, and relationship ids stay unchanged. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertSlicerOp.description: 把切片器或时间线视图写到目标工作表。
insertSlicerOp.descriptionEn: Write a slicer or timeline view onto the target worksheet.
insertSlicerOp.limits: 不在库里执行筛选，不刷新透视合计。
insertSlicerOp.limitsEn: This library does not run the filter and does not refresh pivot totals.

deleteSlicerOp.limits: 找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是切片器 id 报 InvalidId。摘 drawing 锚点、slicers 或 timelines 部件里对应视图。 该 cache 已无视图则摘 slicerCache 或 timelineCache、workbook 关系，以及 @name 与 cache 名相同的那条定义名。 slicers 部件删光则去掉该部件与工作表 slicerList 条目。timelines 部件删光则去掉该部件与工作表 timelineRefs 条目。
deleteSlicerOp.limitsEn: A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a slicer id returns InvalidId. Remove the drawing anchor and the matching view in the slicers or timelines part. If that cache has no views left, remove the slicerCache or timelineCache, the workbook relationship, and the defined name whose @name matches the cache name. When the slicers part is empty, remove that part and the worksheet slicerList entry. When the timelines part is empty, remove that part and the worksheet timelineRefs entry.

setSlicerSizeOp.description: 字段与 setPictureSize 的 xlsx 一侧相同。
setSlicerSizeOp.descriptionEn: Same fields as the xlsx side of setPictureSize.
setSlicerSizeOp.limits: id 必须是切片器 id（含时间线）。oneCell / absolute 改外层 xdr:ext。twoCell 不认 cx / cy（出现报 InvalidField），必须给 to。不按列宽行高去换算 EMU。留下 AlternateContent 与 xdr:clientData。对图 id 发此 op、对切片器 id 发 setPictureSize 仍报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSlicerSizeOp.limitsEn: id must be a slicer id (including a timeline). oneCell / absolute updates the outer xdr:ext. twoCell does not accept cx / cy (those return InvalidField) and requires to. EMU is not converted from column width or row height. AlternateContent and xdr:clientData stay. This op on a picture id, or setPictureSize on a slicer id, still returns InvalidId. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setSlicerViewOp.description: 改 slicer 或 timeline 视图部件上的标题、行高、列数、显示开关与样式名。
setSlicerViewOp.descriptionEn: Change the caption, row height, column count, display switches, and style name on a slicer or timeline view part.
setSlicerViewOp.limits: 不改 drawing 锚点，不改 cache，不执行筛选。
setSlicerViewOp.limitsEn: Do not change the drawing anchor, do not change the cache, and do not run the filter.

setSlicerFilterOp.description: 改切片器 cache 已勾选项，或时间线 cache 的筛选区间。
setSlicerFilterOp.descriptionEn: Change the checked items on a slicer cache, or the filter range on a timeline cache.
setSlicerFilterOp.limits: 不改 drawing，不改视图 @caption。不隐藏行。不重写透视缓存合计。不在库里执行筛选。
setSlicerFilterOp.limitsEn: Do not change the drawing, and do not change the view @caption. Do not hide rows. Do not rewrite pivot-cache totals. This library does not run the filter.

insertSparklineOp.description: 在该表 extLst 里追加一组 x14:sparklineGroup，组内一条 x14:sparkline。
insertSparklineOp.descriptionEn: Append one x14:sparklineGroup, containing one x14:sparkline, to that sheet's extLst.
insertSparklineOp.limits: 没有对应 ext 则按 CT_Worksheet 在末尾写 extLst / ext（uri 写成 Excel 16.0 另存的 {05C60535-1F16-4fd2-B633-F4F36F0B64E0}）， xmlns:x14 写在该 ext 上，xmlns:xm 写在 sparklineGroups 上。ref 必须是单格；闭区间报 InvalidField。非法 A1 报 InvalidRange。
insertSparklineOp.limitsEn: If the matching ext is missing, write extLst / ext at the end following CT_Worksheet (the uri is the one Excel 16.0 writes on save, {05C60535-1F16-4fd2-B633-F4F36F0B64E0}). xmlns:x14 is written on that ext, and xmlns:xm is written on sparklineGroups. ref must be a single cell; a closed range returns InvalidField. An illegal A1 returns InvalidRange.

setSparklineOp.limits: type、ref、formula 与新增可选字段至少给一个，否则报 InvalidField。该组若有多于一条 sparkline，给 ref 或 formula 报 InvalidField（仍可改 type、颜色与轴）。 ref 约束与 insert 相同，含重叠检查（排除自身）。formula 空串报 InvalidField，写入规则与 insert 相同。 colors 只覆盖给了的键，未点名的颜色子元素原样留。lineWeight 为 null 去掉该属性。 标记布尔为 false 去掉对应属性。轴约束与 insert 相同。
setSparklineOp.limitsEn: Give at least one of type, ref, formula, and the additional optional fields, or InvalidField is returned. If the group has more than one sparkline, giving ref or formula returns InvalidField (type, colors, and axes can still be changed). ref constraints match insert, including the overlap check (excluding itself). An empty formula returns InvalidField, and the write rules match insert. colors overwrites only the keys that were given; unnamed color children stay as they are. A null lineWeight removes that attribute. A marker boolean of false removes the matching attribute. Axis constraints match insert.

deleteSparklineOp.limits: 组删光则去掉 sparklineGroups 与该 ext；extLst 空则去掉 extLst。不改单元格值，也不动其它 ext。找不到报 IdNotFound。id 不是迷你图组 id 报 InvalidId。只能改 worksheet。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteSparklineOp.limitsEn: When no groups remain, remove sparklineGroups and that ext; if extLst is empty, remove extLst. Do not change cell values, and do not touch other ext elements. A missing id returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a sparkline-group id returns InvalidId. Only a worksheet can be changed. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

insertSheetTableOp.description: 往工作表追加一张 SpreadsheetML 表（ECMA-376 §18.5.1.2）。
insertSheetTableOp.descriptionEn: Append one SpreadsheetML table to the worksheet (ECMA-376 §18.5.1.2).
insertSheetTableOp.limits: 单元格数据仍在 sheetData 里。不实现结构化引用求值，不渲染表样式。
insertSheetTableOp.limitsEn: Cell data stays in sheetData. Structured-reference evaluation is not implemented, and table styles are not rendered.

setSheetTableOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

insertPivotTableOp.description: 往工作表追加一张 SpreadsheetML 透视表（ECMA-376 §18.10）。
insertPivotTableOp.descriptionEn: Append one SpreadsheetML pivot table to the worksheet (ECMA-376 §18.10).
insertPivotTableOp.limits: 库抄缓存并标 refreshOnLoad。多个行字段、多个列字段（一个行字段和一个值）、一个列字段加多个行字段或值、筛选、计数、平均值和合计占比会写入 sheetData。列字段再同时加多个行字段或多个值仍留给 Excel。
insertPivotTableOp.limitsEn: The library copies the cache and sets refreshOnLoad. Multiple row fields, multiple column fields with one row field and one value, one column field with several row fields or values, filters, count, average, and percent of total are written into sheetData. Column fields combined with both several row fields and several values are left for Excel.

setPivotTableOp.limitsEn: Only the fields that were given are changed.

setPrintSetupOp.description: 改工作表或图表工作表的页边距、纸张、方向、缩放、打印网格线、打印区域与手工分页符。
setPrintSetupOp.descriptionEn: Change margins, paper, orientation, scaling, print gridlines, the print area, and manual page breaks on a worksheet or chart sheet.
setPrintSetupOp.limits: 不改页眉页脚原文（仍走 setHeaderFooterText）。
setPrintSetupOp.limitsEn: Do not change header or footer text (that still goes through setHeaderFooterText).

setSheetViewOp.description: 改工作表或图表工作表默认视图的缩放、冻结窗格、拆分窗格与活动单元格。
setSheetViewOp.descriptionEn: Change zoom, frozen panes, split panes, and the active cell on the default view of a worksheet or chart sheet.
setSheetViewOp.limits: 不改分页预览 / 页面布局。
setSheetViewOp.limitsEn: Do not change page-break preview or page layout view.

setAutoFilterOp.description: 改工作表级自动筛选范围。
setAutoFilterOp.limits: 不改表格部件里的筛选，不写筛选条件，不隐藏行。
setAutoFilterOp.limitsEn: Do not change the filter inside a table part, do not write filter criteria, and do not hide rows.

setSortStateOp.limits: 不重排 sheetData，不隐藏行，不求值。不改表格部件里的排序。
setSortStateOp.limitsEn: Do not reorder sheetData, do not hide rows, and do not evaluate. Do not change the sort inside a table part.

groupRowsOp.descriptionEn: Increase the outline level of the specified rows by 1.
groupRowsOp.limits: 不写隐藏、不写折叠、不改汇总方向。
groupRowsOp.limitsEn: Do not write hidden, do not write collapsed, and do not change the summary direction.

ungroupRowsOp.descriptionEn: Decrease the outline level of the specified rows by 1.
ungroupRowsOp.limits: 减到 0 则去掉 @outlineLevel。范围内本来就是 0 的行不动。同步 outlineLevelRow。字段与错误与 groupRows 相同，op 必须是 "ungroupRows"。不写隐藏、不写折叠。
ungroupRowsOp.limitsEn: At 0, remove @outlineLevel. Rows in the range that are already 0 stay unchanged. Keep outlineLevelRow in sync. Fields and errors match groupRows, and op must be "ungroupRows". Do not write hidden or collapsed.

groupColsOp.descriptionEn: Increase the outline level of the specified columns by 1.
groupColsOp.limitsEn: Do not write hidden or collapsed.

ungroupColsOp.descriptionEn: Decrease the outline level of the specified columns by 1.
ungroupColsOp.limits: 减到 0 则去掉 @outlineLevel。字段与错误与 groupCols 相同，op 必须是 "ungroupCols"。
ungroupColsOp.limitsEn: At 0, remove @outlineLevel. Fields and errors match groupCols, and op must be "ungroupCols".

setOutlineOp.description: 改汇总方向，或按点名的细节范围折叠 / 展开。
setOutlineOp.descriptionEn: Change the summary direction, or collapse or expand the named detail range.

setRowHiddenOp.limits: 不改大纲级，不折叠汇总行。
setRowHiddenOp.limitsEn: Do not change the outline level, and do not collapse summary rows.

setColHiddenOp.limitsEn: Do not change the outline level.

setHeaderFooterTextOp.descriptionEn: Change the text in a header or footer.
setHeaderFooterTextOp.limits: 找不到该表报 IdNotFound。id 不是页眉槽位 id 报 InvalidId。对图 id、工作表 id 或单元格 id 发此 op 报 InvalidId。 worksheet / chartsheet / dialogsheet 都可以改文本。对 macrosheet 本期只读页眉原文，不新开写入。没有 headerFooter 则按 CT_Worksheet 顺序新建。
setHeaderFooterTextOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a header/footer slot id returns InvalidId. This op on a picture id, sheet id, or cell id returns InvalidId. worksheet / chartsheet / dialogsheet can all change the text. For a macrosheet this phase only reads the existing header/footer text and does not open a new write. If headerFooter is missing, create it in CT_Worksheet order.

setSheetHiddenOp.limits: 找不到该表报 IdNotFound。id 不是工作表 id 报 InvalidId。对 dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 NotImplemented。 把最后一张可见表改成隐藏报 InvalidField。true 写 state="hidden"（若原先是 veryHidden 也改成 hidden）。false 去掉 state。已经是目标可见性则空操作。 docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSheetHiddenOp.limitsEn: A missing sheet returns IdNotFound. An id that is not a sheet id returns InvalidId. dialogsheet / macrosheet returns NotImplemented. Hiding the last visible sheet returns InvalidField. true writes state="hidden" (veryHidden is also changed to hidden). false removes state. If visibility is already the target, this is a no-op. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

setSheetBackgroundOp.description: 设置或替换工作表背景图。
setSheetBackgroundOp.descriptionEn: Set or replace a worksheet background.
setSheetBackgroundOp.limits: id 必须是 sheet:工作表名。已有背景则换掉媒体，没有则新建 picture。对 chartsheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 InvalidField。单元格 id、图 id 或页眉图 id 报 InvalidId。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
setSheetBackgroundOp.limitsEn: id must be sheet:name. An existing background replaces the media part; otherwise a picture element is created. chartsheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet returns InvalidField. A cell id, picture id, or header-picture id returns InvalidId. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.

deleteSheetBackgroundOp.limits: id 必须是 sheet:工作表名/background。没有背景报 IdNotFound。对 chartsheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet 报 InvalidField。docx / pptx 上发此 op 报 InvalidField。
deleteSheetBackgroundOp.limitsEn: id must be sheet:name/background. A sheet with no background returns IdNotFound. chartsheet / dialogsheet / macrosheet returns InvalidField. This op on docx / pptx returns InvalidField.
